Both models recognized the entities and encoded their spatial relations (out-of-fold AUROC: 0.82 and 0.91), assigning higher hazard scores to near than far scenes in 79% and 73% of pairs. Nevertheless, 74% and 100% of far scenes were falsely classified as hazardous. Removing the worker reduced Qwen's hazard rate to 11%, while worker presence exerted 2.4- and 3.2-times greater influence on hazard scores than spatial proximity in the respective models. Attention-head interventions, neuron-level interventions, and activation steering failed to eliminate this co-occurrence bias. However, conditioning hazard decisions on the model's own spatial-relation representation improved Qwen's specificity from 0.36 to 0.58 at matched sensitivity, outperforming threshold recalibration. These findings reveal that VLM struck-by false alarms stem primarily from decision-making failures rather than deficiencies in object recognition or spatial encoding, suggesting that future efforts should prioritize conditioning hazard decisions on encoded spatial evidence rather than further improving visual recognition alone.

AI.tldr: 该研究用355对反事实"工人-挖掘机"场景（控制空间距离与移除工人）测试Qwen2.5-VL-7B与InternVL3.5-8B，发现"撞击"类危险误报主要源于决策阶段被共现先验主导，而非物体识别或空间关系编码失败。
AI.motivation: 视觉语言模型被越来越多用于施工危险监测，但误报频繁且成因不清。作者要区分误报来自：(1) 物体识别失败，(2) 空间关系编码失败，还是(3) 被学习到的共现先验主导的危险判定（决策失败）。
AI.method: 构建355对反事实工人-挖掘机场景（控制接近程度、含"移除工人"变体）；对两个VLM做行为分析、内部表征探针（out-of-fold AUROC）、因果干预（注意力头干预、神经元级干预、激活引导）以及决策校正（以模型自身空间关系表征为条件重新判定，并与阈值重校准对比）。
AI.result: 两模型均能识别实体并编码空间关系（AUROC 0.82/0.91），79%/73%的场景对中近距危险分高于远距；但74%/100%的远距场景被误判为危险。移除工人使Qwen危险率降至11%；工人存在对危险分的影响是空间距离的2.4倍/3.2倍。三类因果干预均未消除共现偏差；以自身空间表征为条件可将Qwen特异度在等敏感度下从0.36提升至0.58，优于阈值重校准。
AI.conclusion: VLM的撞击危险误报主要来自决策层面的失败，而非物体识别或空间编码缺陷；后续应把危险判定条件化于已编码的空间证据，而非仅提升视觉识别能力。可推广到具身/机器人安全监控中"表征已具备但决策未用"的通用问题。

title: An automated photometric pipeline for measuring the corotation radius of spiral galaxies
summary: The corotation radius R_CR of a spiral galaxy marks the radius where the angular speed of the spiral pattern matches the orbital speed of the disk material. Despite its importance for understanding spiral structure and galaxy evolution, very few galaxies have corotation measurements, often derived using heterogeneous techniques. We present an automated photometric pipeline that identifies corotation radii by tracking the azimuthal phase offset between young and old stellar populations. Building on the color-gradient framework of \citet{Puerari1997}, we extract azimuthal brightness profiles from deprojected dual-band images, fit periodic models to the profiles, and identify corotation candidates at radii where the phase difference between the two stellar tracers changes sign. Each candidate is assigned an adaptive uncertainty interval and reported with a goodness-of-fit metric. We benchmark the method against a cross-method literature compilation, scoring every technique -- including our own -- against a reference built from the published measurements alone and evaluated leave-one-out. Over the $90$ galaxies for which such a reference exists, the pipeline places a correct corotation radius in $80.0\%$ of them, recovers $63.6\%$ of their known corotation radii, and reaches a harmonic mean of recall and purity of $0.58$, the highest values of any method in the comparison. Unlike the published methods, each of which was applied to a small, curated set of galaxies, our pipeline is run on the entire reference sample without any pre-selection, a sample two to six times larger than existing methods. The pipeline is scalable to large surveys, flexible with respect to spiral mode, and naturally recovers multiple corotation radii in galaxies with complex spiral structure, providing a uniform framework for studying disk resonances across diverse galaxy populations.

AI.tldr: 提出自动化光度测量流程，通过追踪年轻与年老星族方位角相位差符号变化来识别旋涡星系共转半径，并在90个星系参考集上超越现有方法（纯度/召回调和均值0.58）。
AI.motivation: 共转半径R_CR对理解旋涡结构与星系演化至关重要，但实测数据极少，且已有测量依赖异构、非统一的技术，样本量小、经人工筛选，缺乏可扩展的统一框架。
AI.method: 基于Puerari (1997)颜色梯度框架，从去投影双波段图像提取方位角亮度剖面，拟合周期模型，在两星族示踪体相位差变号处确定共转候选；每个候选赋予自适应不确定度区间并报告拟合优度；与跨方法文献汇编对比，用留一法构建参考真值，对所有方法统一评分。
AI.result: 在90个有参考真值的星系上，流程为80.0%的星系给出正确共转半径，召回63.6%已知共转半径，召回与纯度调和均值0.58，为所比较方法中最高；且无需预筛选即在比现有方法大2–6倍的样本上运行。
AI.conclusion: 该流程可扩展至大型巡天、对旋涡模式灵活、能自然恢复复杂螺旋结构中的多个共转半径，为跨星系族群研究盘共振提供统一框架。

title: COSMIO: A Benchmark for Cross-Survey Modality Imputation
comment: Accepted at NeurIPS 2026. 34 pages, 8 figures
summary: Large-scale astronomical surveys define a heterogeneous, partially observed multi-survey learning setting: each object is observed by only a subset of surveys, while survey observations differ in resolutions, wavelength coverage, noise characteristics, and footprints. This setting gives rise to a natural machine learning problem: given observations of an object in some surveys, how to infer its appearance in other surveys. We formalize this as the problem of cross-survey modality imputation and introduce COSMIO, a multi-survey benchmark of aligned observations obtained by forward-rendered shared astrophysical scenes across LSST, Euclid, and Roman under survey-specific instrument characteristics. The benchmark enables systematic evaluation of imputation across source-target survey combinations and missing-survey patterns. We evaluate a broad range of machine learning methods for imputation, which reveal a clear domain gap: methods developed for existing imputation settings transfer poorly to the survey setting. We identify rare-event imputation as a central challenge. This regime arises in the early stages of new surveys, when rare but scientifically valuable phenomena may be available only from prior surveys. We use strong gravitational lensing, where light from a background galaxy is gravitationally deflected by a foreground galaxy, as a representative rare-event setting. We evaluate model performance on zero-shot imputation of gravitational lenses and on downstream scientific tasks using the imputed lens observations. On our constructed evaluation set of galaxy-galaxy strong lenses, performance degrades under rare-event distribution shift, and this degradation further propagates to the downstream lens-detection task. Code: this https URL .

AI.tldr: 提出COSMIO多巡天基准，把天文多巡天观测形式化为"跨巡天模态补全"问题，并评估现有补全方法，指出稀有事件（强引力透镜）补全的域差距。
AI.motivation: 天文巡天数据天然异质、部分观测：同一天体仅被部分巡天覆盖，且各巡天分辨率、波段、噪声、天区覆盖不同。核心问题是：已知某天体在部分巡天的观测，如何推断其在其他巡天的成像。
AI.method: 用共享天体物理场景经前向渲染生成LSST、Euclid、Roman三巡天特定仪器特性下的对齐观测，构建COSMIO基准，支持源-目标巡天组合与缺失模式系统评估；评测多种现成补全方法，并以星系-星系强引力透镜作为稀有事件代表场景做零样本补全及下游透镜检测。
AI.result: 现有图像/多模态补全方法迁移效果差，存在明显域差距；在稀有事件分布偏移下补全性能下降，且该退化传播至下游引力透镜检测任务。
AI.conclusion: 跨巡天模态补全构成独立且具挑战性的ML问题，稀有事件补全尤其困难，需专门方法设计；基准为后续研究提供评估平台。

title: Improving PI-RADS Prediction and Prostate Cancer Detection from Multiparametric MRI with Anatomical Guidance
summary: Accurate prediction of Prostate Imaging Reporting and Data System (PI-RADS) scores from multiparametric MRI (mpMRI) remains challenging, more so than clinically significant prostate cancer (csPCa) detection. Given the importance of lesion location in PI-RADS scoring, we evaluated whether incorporating prostate zonal masks improves PI-RADS prediction and csPCa detection across multiple architectures (3D ResNet-18, ResNet-50, and ViT) using a large-scale internal dataset. Anatomical guidance generally improved performance across architectures, with the best results achieved by ResNet-18 with 2-zone guidance for PI-RADS prediction (QWK = 0.511) and ResNet-50 with 5-zone guidance for csPCa detection (AUC = 0.809). Fine-tuned results on external datasets further demonstrated the benefits of anatomical guidance. Furthermore, models with anatomical guidance improved the utility of model-predicted PI-RADS scores for PI-RADS-based csPCa detection (positive defined as PI-RADS>=3). Combining model-predicted and expert-assigned PI-RADS scores significantly increased the AUC from 0.711 to 0.756 (p < 0.05), suggesting that AI-derived PI-RADS scores may provide complementary information to expert assessment for csPCa detection. Overall, our findings highlight the value of incorporating prostate zonal anatomy into deep learning-based prostate MRI assessment.

AI.tldr: 结合前列腺分区掩膜（2区/5区）作为解剖先验，在3D ResNet-18/50与ViT上联合预测PI-RADS评分与csPCa，解剖引导普遍提升性能，且AI预测的PI-RADS与专家评分互补可提升csPCa检测AUC（0.711→0.756）。
AI.motivation: 从mpMRI准确预测PI-RADS评分比检测临床显著前列腺癌（csPCa）更难，而病灶分区位置对PI-RADS判读至关重要；作者希望验证显式引入前列腺分区解剖信息能否在多架构下同时改善PI-RADS预测与csPCa检测。
AI.method: 在大规模内部数据集上，将前列腺分区掩膜作为额外通道/引导信号，输入3D ResNet-18、ResNet-50与ViT三类骨干，比较无引导、2区与5区引导三种设置的PI-RADS分类（QWK）与csPCa检测（AUC）；并在外部数据集上微调验证泛化性，最后将模型预测PI-RADS与专家PI-RADS结合（PI-RADS≥3为正）评估互补增益。
AI.result: 解剖引导在多数架构上带来提升：PI-RADS预测最佳为ResNet-18+2区引导（QWK=0.511），csPCa检测最佳为ResNet-50+5区引导（AUC=0.809）；外部数据集微调后同样受益；融合模型预测与专家PI-RADS使csPCa检测AUC由0.711升至0.756（p<0.05）。
AI.conclusion: 显式前列腺分区解剖先验可稳定提升深度学习PI-RADS预测与csPCa检测，且AI预测的PI-RADS与专家判读信息互补，具有辅助分诊与二次读片的潜在价值。

title: What Remains in Sight? Autoregressive Video Decoding as Representation-Guided Context Rewriting
summary: Long-horizon video generation is increasingly moving toward autoregressive rollout, where each newly generated segment becomes part of the evidence used for future prediction. Recent causal decoders, long-context training, and KV-cache mechanisms have extended feasible duration, but most inference pipelines still decide the visible past implicitly through recent windows, compressed caches, or external memory. This raises a direct question: \textbf{can the choice of which past frames or segments to show to the decoder be treated as an explicit test-time decision?} We answer this question with \textsc{ReCR}, a training-free method that formulates autoregressive video decoding as representation-guided context rewriting. At each step, \textsc{ReCR} builds a selected visible context from the generated history by using internal decoder representations to favor context units that match the global rollout state, avoid redundancy with the recent continuation, preserve temporal boundary coverage, and widen the range of spatial layouts in view. The selected units are then mapped onto a compact causal axis before decoding the next block. Across long-horizon text-to-video benchmarks, \textsc{ReCR} consistently improves multiple autoregressive backbones under matched visible-token budgets. Empirical analyses such as representation-space diagnostics and transition-count prompt switching further show that improving what remains visible is an effective path toward more stable long-video decoding.

AI.tldr: 提出免训练的ReCR，将自回归视频生成中"向解码器展示哪些历史帧/片段"显式化为测试时的表示引导上下文重写决策。
AI.motivation: 长时程自回归视频生成的推理管线多以固定近期窗口、压缩KV缓存或外部记忆隐式决定可见历史；作者追问：可见上下文的选择本身能否作为显式的测试时决策来优化。
AI.method: ReCR在每步利用解码器内部表示对历史候选上下文单元打分，偏好与全局rollout状态匹配、与近期续接不冗余、保持时间边界覆盖、扩大空间布局多样性的单元；随后将选中单元映射到紧凑因果轴再解码下一块。无需训练，兼容多种自回归骨干。
AI.result: 在同等可见token预算下，于多个长时程文生视频基准上持续提升多种自回归骨干；表示空间诊断与"转场计数随提示切换"的实验表明改善可见内容可带来更稳定的长视频解码。
AI.conclusion: 可见上下文的选择可作为有效的显式推理时控制手段，为长视频自回归解码稳定性提供免训练路径。

title: Say the Same, Act Differently: Diagnosing and Steering Text-Action Divergence in Reasoning VLAs
comment: Accepted to NeurIPS 2026. 23 pages, 3 figures, 8 tables
summary: Reasoning vision-language-action (VLA) models pair physical control with natural-language rationales that supervisors can read to monitor embodied safety. Prior attacks on VLA reasoning corrupt the rationale itself and leave visible evidence in the text. We show that visual perturbations can instead alter the physical action while keeping the generated rationale word-for-word identical. At the shared text/action interface of Alpamayo for driving and InstructVLA for manipulation, our text-neutral action-subspace (TNAS) diagnostic shows that the locally most action-sensitive direction is nearly orthogonal to the active text-loss gradients, with 1.87% and 5.28% norm overlap. At equal hidden-state perturbation norms across both models, interventions along this text-neutral residual shift actions 4.64x to 47.8x more than text-gradient perturbations, whereas text-gradient perturbations induce 21.2x to 277x more text drift. Steering visual perturbations along this direction reaches the same decoupling from the image. Across 154 obstacle-annotated driving scenes in Alpamayo, TNAS-guided attacks induce a new collision under a word-for-word identical rationale in 52.6% of scenes under full-image perturbations and 35.1% under a localized forward-camera patch, compared with 4.55% for unguided action attacks. Relative to a text-preserving baseline, TNAS guidance raises exact rationale preservation from 83.0% to 89.5% and cuts teacher-forced text drift by 68.4% at a comparable collision rate. In InstructVLA, TNAS guidance cuts text drift by 40.5% and preserves the exact response on 85.0% of examples alongside a 1.73-unit action-chunk shift. An unchanged rationale therefore cannot certify a safe action, so monitors for reasoning VLAs must verify the predicted action channel directly.

AI.tldr: 提出TNAS（text-neutral action subspace）诊断方法，证明对VLA模型施加视觉扰动可在生成文本理由逐字不变的情况下改变物理动作；在Alpamayo（驾驶）与InstructVLA（操作）上，动作最敏感方向与文本损失梯度近乎正交（范数重叠1.87%/5.28%），同等扰动范数下动作偏差扩大4.64x–47.8x，文本漂移小得多。Alpamayo 154个障碍场景中，TNAS引导攻击在理由完全一致前提下使52.6%（全图）/35.1%（局部前视相机补丁）出现新碰撞，无引导仅4.55%。
AI.motivation: 现有对VLA推理的攻击都会污染rationale本身，在文本中留下可见证据，因此"理由未变"被视为安全信号。作者质疑：视觉扰动能否在保持生成理由逐字不变的同时篡改动作，即文本通道监控是否足以认证动作安全。
AI.method: 在文本/动作共享接口处构造TNAS方向：寻找局部动作敏感度最高、但与活跃文本损失梯度近乎正交（即文本中性）的残差方向；在等隐状态扰动范数下比较沿TNAS方向与沿文本梯度方向干预的动作变化与文本漂移；进一步将视觉扰动引导至该方向（全图与局部前视相机补丁），并设文本保持基线对照；在Alpamayo（自动驾驶）与InstructVLA（操作）两个模型上评价碰撞率、逐字理由保持率、teacher-forced文本漂移和动作chunk偏移。
AI.result: 动作最敏感方向与文本梯度范数重叠仅1.87%（Alpamayo）与5.28%（InstructVLA），动作偏移放大4.64x–47.8x，而文本梯度扰动文本漂移大21.2x–277x。Alpamayo 154个障碍标注场景中TNAS引导攻击在逐字相同理由下引发新碰撞：全图52.6%，局部补丁35.1%，无引导动作攻击4.55%。相对文本保持基线，TNAS将逐字理由保持率从83.0%提升到89.5%，在相当碰撞率下teacher-forced文本漂移降低68.4%。InstructVLA文本漂移降40.5%，85.0%样本响应完全不变，同时动作chunk偏移1.73单位。
AI.conclusion: 视觉扰动可实现动作与rationale的完全解耦，未变的理由不能作为动作安全的认证依据；VLA推理监控器应直接验证预测动作通道，而非依赖文本解释。

title: ReconDreamer#: Self-Evolving Closed-Loop Synergy of Reconstruction and Generation for Dynamic Driving Scenes
summary: Dynamic driving scene reconstruction has made remarkable strides in recent years by leveraging generative priors, particularly in the quality of novel trajectory rendering. Nevertheless, a significant gap remains between the generated data and real-world sensor observations, severely hindering further improvements in reconstruction fidelity. In this paper, we present ReconDreamer#, a self-evolving framework that synergizes reconstruction and generation for dynamic driving scenes, which substantially bridges the gap between synthesized novel trajectory data and recorded real-world observations. Within this self-evolving closed-loop framework, the generative and reconstruction models mutually reinforce each other through iterative refinement, ultimately yielding a significant enhancement in the 3D representation capability of the reconstruction model. Additionally, we introduce a geometry-prior-based adaptive ground model to further enhance the rendering quality of the reconstruction model. To validate the effectiveness of the proposed method, we conduct comprehensive evaluations on Waymo, nuScenes, PandaSet, and EUVS benchmarks. Specifically on Waymo, at a 6-m lateral shift, ReconDreamer# improves NTA-IoU and NTL-IoU by 8.8% and 3.0%, respectively, and reduces FID by 15.1% relative to ReconDreamer++.

AI.tldr: ReconDreamer#：自进化闭环框架，重建与生成模型互相迭代增强，并加入几何先验自适应地面模型，缩小新轨迹合成数据与真实观测的差距，提升动态驾驶场景重建保真度。
AI.motivation: 动态驾驶场景新视角合成质量提升明显，但生成数据与真实传感器观测仍有显著差距，限制重建保真度进一步提升；需要让生成与重建协同演化以弥合该gap。
AI.method: 提出自进化闭环框架，重建模型与生成模型通过迭代精炼互相强化，逐步提升3D表征能力；引入基于几何先验的自适应地面模型（adaptive ground model）以改善渲染质量。在Waymo、nuScenes、PandaSet、EUVS上评测。
AI.result: Waymo上6米横向偏移下，相对ReconDreamer++，NTA-IoU提升8.8%、NTL-IoU提升3.0%，FID下降15.1%；四个基准全面验证。
AI.conclusion: 生成-重建互促的自进化闭环可有效弥合合成新轨迹数据与真实观测的差距，配合几何先验地面建模显著提升动态驾驶场景重建与新轨迹渲染质量。

title: Grasping and Stabilizing Tumbling Objects with Rotating-Base Multi-Arm Space Manipulators
summary: This paper presents an innovative guidance and control method for a space manipulator that actively maneuvers its base to hold a tumbling object stationary relative to the base during proximity operations. This simplifies motion planning, reduces collision risk, and enables impact-free capture using single- or multi-arm configurations, with or without predefined grasping interfaces. The proposed approach involves two phases. In the pre-grasping phase, a synchronization control aligns the target's center of mass (CoM) with the system's instantaneous center of rotation (ICR), virtually rigidizing the target-servicer system to keep the object stationary for reliable grasping. In the post grasping phase, a control strategy based on Hamiltonian dynamics and optimal control stabilizes the combined system by minimizing time, fuel, or energy, while respecting base torque limits and multiple grasping constraints. For structured targets, applied forces and torques stay within their bounds; for unstructured ones, friction constraints prevent slipping. A case study demonstrates the method's effectiveness in enabling both the subsequent grasping and detumbling phases.

AI.tldr: 提出空间机械臂"基座主动机动"引导控制方法：预抓取阶段用同步控制将目标质心对齐系统瞬时转动中心（ICR），使目标相对基座静止以便无冲击抓取；后抓取阶段基于哈密顿动力学与最优控制（最小时间/燃料/能量）稳定组合系统并满足基座力矩与抓取约束。
AI.motivation: 翻滚目标的近距离操作中，目标与基座相对运动复杂，导致运动规划困难、碰撞风险高、抓取冲击大。若能利用机械臂基座主动机动使翻滚目标相对基座"静止化"，可将目标-服务航天器视为准刚体，从而简化规划并实现无冲击捕获，并兼容单/多臂及有无预设抓取接口的情形。
AI.method: 两阶段控制框架。预抓取阶段：设计同步控制器驱动基座/机械臂运动，使目标质心与系统的瞬时转动中心（ICR）重合，从而虚拟刚化目标-服务航天器系统，实现目标相对静止。后抓取阶段：将组合系统建模为哈密顿系统，求解最优控制问题以最小化时间、燃料或能量，并施加基座力矩上限约束；对结构化目标施加力/力矩边界约束，对非结构化目标施加摩擦锥约束防止滑移。
AI.result: 案例研究（仿真）表明该方法可有效支撑后续抓取阶段与消旋（detumbling）阶段的执行；文中明确列出力/力矩与摩擦约束的满足条件，但摘要未给出定量指标或硬件实验验证。
AI.conclusion: 通过"基座机动+ICR对齐"将翻滚目标相对静止化，是简化空间翻滚目标捕获规划、降低碰撞风险与冲击的可行思路；结合哈密顿最优控制可在约束下稳定后抓取组合系统，为单/多臂、有无抓取接口的通用捕获提供统一框架。

title: Statistical Machine Learning for Medicinal Plant Leaves Classification
summary: Medicinal plants are usually identified using practitioners' experience, but reproducible, image based methods can complement this knowledge. We present MEDIPI (MEDIcinal Plant Identification), a statistical machine learning approach that classifies medicinal plant leaves from photographs. From each leaf image we extract 52 interpretable features covering shape, texture, color, and a new scagnostics category. We then classify leaves using a three level hierarchy: shape, then edge type, then species. We also release MedLEA, an open R package with 1,099 leaf images of 31 Sri Lankan medicinal plant species. On this dataset, a hierarchical Random Forest achieved the best overall accuracy (100%) in our comparison of hierarchical and non-hierarchical approaches and eight algorithms: Random Forest, XGBoost, Gradient Boosting, linear discriminant analysis, k-nearest neighbor, support vector machine, probabilistic neural network, and artificial neural network. Adding texture, color, and scagnostic features to shape features raised shape level accuracy from 90% to 97%. Linear discriminant analysis plots show how the trained model separates leaf shapes. Accuracy dropped sharply (23-50%) when training and test data came from different datasets, so generalization across datasets remains a challenge.

AI.tldr: MEDIPI：从药用植物叶片照片提取52个可解释特征（形状/纹理/颜色/新scagnostics类），按形状→边缘类型→物种的三级层次分类；发布MedLEA数据集（31种斯里兰卡药用植物、1099张叶片图像）。层次化随机森林取得100%准确率，特征扩展使形状层准确率由90%升至97%；跨数据集训练/测试时准确率骤降至23–50%。
AI.motivation: 传统药用植物识别依赖从业者经验，缺乏可复现性；作者希望用基于图像的统计机器学习方法提供可重复、可解释的补充手段，并填补斯里兰卡药用植物公开数据集的空白。
AI.method: 手工设计52个可解释图像特征，涵盖形状、纹理、颜色及新提出的scagnostics类别；构建三级层次分类流程（先形状、后边缘类型、最后物种）；对比层次与非层次两种框架下8种算法（随机森林、XGBoost、梯度提升、LDA、kNN、SVM、概率神经网络、人工神经网络）；以LDA投影可视化模型对叶片形状的区分能力；开源R包MedLEA。
AI.result: 在MedLEA上层次化随机森林取得最佳总体准确率100%；在形状特征基础上加入纹理、颜色与scagnostics特征使形状层准确率由90%提升到97%；但训练与测试数据来自不同数据集时准确率大幅下降至23–50%。
AI.conclusion: 层次化特征+集成分类在同源数据上可近乎完美地区分药用植物叶片，且特征具有可解释性；但方法对数据来源高度敏感，跨数据集泛化仍是主要瓶颈，未来需在数据多样性、标准化采集与域适应方向改进。

title: SettleSplat: Monocular Gaussian Mapping under In-View Scene Changes
comment: Accepted at WACV 2027
summary: Online 3D Gaussian mapping enables fast and high-fidelity novel view synthesis, with broad applications in augmented reality, robotics, and autonomous systems. However, many current methods assume static scenes or filter out dynamics as outliers. In this paper, we study in-view scene changes where objects are manipulated in front of the camera within a single online sequence, unlike prior works that detect changes outside the camera view or between separate captures. This setting entangles transient and persistent dynamics, as objects can be distractors while moving and persistent once they settle. While recent studies start to address distractors by removing them for clean static background, in-view scene changes remain underexplored. To resolve this, we present SettleSplat, a monocular mapping system that maintains up-to-date 3D Gaussian maps under such changes. Specifically, we lift coarse per-pixel uncertainty into Gaussian dynamicity field, then prune transient ones. For persistent changes, we derive geometric contradictions weighted by parameter-free rendered depth uncertainty to separate true changes from under-optimized regions. On Bonn and Co-Fusion, SettleSplat achieves consistent 3D Gaussian maps, outperforming current baselines on both full images and change regions while maintaining comparable speed.

AI.tldr: SettleSplat: 单目在线建图系统，在"视野内场景变化"（物体在相机前被移动/放置）下维护一致的3D高斯地图，通过"逐像素不确定性→高斯动态性场"剔除瞬态物体，并用无参数渲染深度不确定性加权的几何矛盾检测持久变化。
AI.motivation: 现有在线3DGS建图多假设静态场景或把动态当外点滤除；已有工作关注"视野外变化"或"跨次采集变化"，而相机视野内、单次在线序列中发生的物体移动/放置（瞬态干扰+持久改变纠缠）几乎未被研究。
AI.method: 1) 将粗粒度逐像素不确定性提升为高斯基元的动态性场（dynamicity field），据此剪除瞬态高斯；2) 对持久变化，利用无参数（parameter-free）的渲染深度不确定性加权几何矛盾度量，将真实场景变更与欠优化区域区分开；整体为单目在线高斯建图流水线。
AI.result: 在Bonn与Co-Fusion数据集上得到一致性的3D高斯地图，在整幅图像与变化区域的新视角合成指标上均优于现有基线，且保持相近的运行速度。
AI.conclusion: 为"视野内场景变化"下的在线单目高斯建图提供了可行方案：区分瞬态与持久变化是关键，不确定性驱动的动态性场与几何矛盾检验能同时抑制干扰并保留真实结构改变。

title: Impact of Input Resolution in Mammographic Mass Detection: A Controlled Multi-Architecture Study
comment: This work has been submitted to the IEEE for possible publication. Copyright may be transferred without notice, after which this version may no longer be accessible
summary: Deep-learning-based mass detectors usually downsample mammograms, trading fine image detail for lower computational cost. However, published studies cannot reveal how much accuracy this trade-off sacrifices, since they also differ in architecture, preprocessing, and evaluation protocol. In this work, we isolated the effect of input resolution in a controlled study on the VinDr-Mammo dataset, training 18 detectors at six input resolutions ranging from 512 x 416 to 1600 x 1280 pixels, for 108 model-resolution combinations. Whole mammograms were resized without cropping or tiling. For each model, preprocessing, model initialization, augmentation, and evaluation procedures were kept fixed across resolutions. Detection accuracy was evaluated by mAP50 on the 219 mass-positive images of the official test split, and 57 combinations with test mAP50 of at least 0.60 were analyzed. From the lowest to the highest resolution, median mAP50 rose from 0.626 to 0.660 and the best mAP50 from 0.670 to 0.709. The best result, achieved by DINO with a ConvNeXt-S backbone, is the highest mAP50 reported to date on mass-positive VinDr-Mammo images. Gains were concentrated in small masses: for the smallest third of lesions, median mAP50 rose by 0.074 (from 0.367 to 0.441), compared with 0.007 and 0.032 for medium and large masses. Median training time increased from 0.45 to 1.40 h, and median inference time from 23.6 to 113.7 ms per image. Therefore, higher input resolution mainly benefits the small masses that are hardest to detect, at a computational cost that remains practical.

AI.tldr: 在VinDr-Mammo上做受控实验，隔离输入分辨率对乳腺X线肿块检测精度的影响：18个检测器×6档分辨率共108组，mAP50随分辨率升高而提升，增益主要来自小肿块，代价是训练/推理时间增加。
AI.motivation: 现有深度学习肿块检测器普遍对乳腺X线图像降采样以降低计算成本，但已发表研究在架构、预处理、评估协议上各不相同，无法量化"分辨率换精度"的具体损失；本文希望单独隔离输入分辨率这一变量。
AI.method: 在VinDr-Mammo数据集上训练18个检测器，输入分辨率从512×416到1600×1280共6档，形成108个模型-分辨率组合；整幅图像直接缩放，不裁剪、不切片；每个模型的预处理、初始化、数据增强与评估流程在各分辨率间保持一致。以官方测试集219张肿块阳性图像的mAP50为指标，分析测试mAP50≥0.60的57个组合，并按肿块尺寸（小/中/大三分位）分组统计。
AI.result: 从最低到最高分辨率，中位mAP50由0.626升至0.660，最优mAP50由0.670升至0.709；最佳结果为DINO+ConvNeXt-S骨干，是迄今肿块阳性VinDr-Mammo图像上的最高mAP50。增益集中于小肿块：最小三分之一病灶中位mAP50提升0.074（0.367→0.441），中、大肿块仅提升0.007和0.032。中位训练时间由0.45 h增至1.40 h，中位单图推理时间由23.6 ms增至113.7 ms。
AI.conclusion: 提高输入分辨率主要惠及最难检测的小肿块，且计算代价仍在可接受范围内；为医学影像检测中分辨率选择的成本-收益权衡提供了受控证据。

title: Online iLQR-MPC with Whole-Body Control for Robust Humanoid Locomotion
summary: Humanoid locomotion requires deciding where to step and how to distribute contact forces. However, a disturbance can invalidate the nominal plan, requiring coordinated revision under constraints that switch with every footfall. To solve this online, the proposed approach employs the single-rigid-body model, which retains attitude dynamics and the full contact wrench. An iterative linear-quadratic-regulator MPC (iLQR-MPC) then jointly optimizes contact forces and footstep locations in a single receding-horizon problem, without a separate step planner. Specifically, contact and motion constraints are incorporated into the backward pass through augmented-Lagrangian and relaxed-barrier penalties. A whole-body controller subsequently maps the plan to joint torques at 500 Hz while preserving contact feasibility. The model-based formulation makes disturbance responses interpretable through explicit costs and constraints, and requires no platform-specific policy training. In MuJoCo simulations, the iLQR-MPC replans at 100 Hz (mean solve time 8.9 ms); the Unitree G1 sustains steady-state walking and recovers from impulsive 245 N forward and 175 N lateral pushes.

AI.tldr: 提出基于单刚体模型（含姿态动力学与完整接触力旋量）的iLQR-MPC，在单一滚动时域问题中联合优化接触力与落脚点，无需独立步态规划器；经全身控制器以500 Hz映射为关节力矩，Unitree G1在MuJoCo中100 Hz重规划并抗245 N前向/175 N侧向冲量扰动。
AI.motivation: 人形机器人运动需同时决定落脚位置与接触力分配；外部扰动会使名义规划失效，且约束随每次触地切换，需要在线协调重规划。作者希望避免分离式落脚规划器与平台特定的策略训练，同时保持响应的可解释性。
AI.method: 1) 单刚体动力学模型，保留姿态动力学与完整接触力旋量；2) iLQR-MPC在单个receding-horizon问题中联合优化接触力与落脚点，将接触/运动约束通过增广拉格朗日与松弛障碍罚函数注入反向传播；3) 全身控制器（WBC）以500 Hz将计划映射为关节力矩并维持接触可行性；4) 纯模型驱动，无需平台专属策略训练。
AI.result: MuJoCo仿真中iLQR-MPC以100 Hz重规划，平均求解时间8.9 ms；Unitree G1实现稳态行走，并能从245 N前向与175 N侧向的脉冲推力扰动中恢复。
AI.conclusion: 联合优化接触力与落脚点的模型式iLQR-MPC可实时在线重规划并具备抗冲量鲁棒性，响应可通过显式代价与约束解释；局限在于仅仿真验证，缺乏实机部署与真实扰动/不平地形证据。

title: LiSA: Linear Stochastic Attention for Long-Range Visual Modeling
summary: Self-attention has become the standard for modern sequence modeling, enabling Transformers to model long-range dependencies across a wide range of modalities. Despite these advances, its quadratic cost with respect to sequence length remains a significant computational bottleneck. Recent work addresses this limitation by introducing linear variants of self-attention, namely with kernel approximations of the softmax operator. However, their first-order aggregation restricts expressivity and struggles to capture higher-order structure. We propose Linear Stochastic Attention (LiSA), a linear attention plug-in module that enables higher-order token interactions via a stochastic diffusion process based on truncated random walks. LiSA incorporates adaptive locality, favoring semantically similar neighbors to preserve fine-grained structures, while maintaining stable and efficient training. We conduct extensive experiments on classification, semantic segmentation, and object detection tasks and show improved results over state-of-the-art methods.

AI.tldr: LiSA：基于截断随机游走随机扩散过程的高阶线性注意力插件，实现自适应局部性并保持训练稳定高效。
AI.motivation: Self-attention 的二次复杂度是长序列建模的瓶颈；现有线性注意力使用 softmax 的核近似，其一阶聚合限制了表达能力，难以捕获高阶 token 结构。
AI.method: 提出 Linear Stochastic Attention（LiSA），作为线性注意力的即插即用模块：以截断随机游走构造随机扩散过程，实现高阶 token 交互；并引入自适应局部性，偏向语义相似的邻居以保留细粒度结构，同时保证训练稳定与效率。
AI.result: 在图像分类、语义分割与目标检测任务上进行大量实验，结果优于现有最先进方法。
AI.conclusion: 通过随机扩散式高阶聚合可在维持线性复杂度的同时提升线性注意力的表达力，但验证限于 2D 视觉识别任务。

title: Reliability-Role Collaborative Learning for Semi-Supervised Cardiac Image Segmentation
comment: Accepted at IEEE BIBM 2026. 7 pages, 4 figures
summary: Semi-supervised cardiac image segmentation aims to exploit abundant unlabeled images together with limited annotations, but the reliability of pseudo-label supervision is highly uneven across spatial regions. In a dual-network setting, interior regions are usually more stable, whereas boundary regions, low-confidence areas, and disagreements between networks can introduce noisy supervision. However, existing methods typically impose uniform supervision on all unlabeled pixels, overlooking reliability differences and limiting discriminative learning in challenging areas. To address this issue, we propose R2CL (Reliability-Role Collaborative Learning), a framework for semi-supervised cardiac image segmentation. R2CL models confidence relationships between two networks to assign roles to unlabeled regions: mutually uncertain regions are used for entropy regularization, confidence-discrepant regions for directional knowledge transfer, and mutually confident regions as reliable supervision anchors. Reliability-Role Mixed Cross Learning (RR-MCL) implements these roles through region-mixed training, directional cross-network supervision, and entropy regularization over mutually uncertain regions. Reliability-Transition Prototype Contrastive Learning (RT-PCL) constructs query features from foreground-adjacent reliability-transition regions and learns network-specific class prototypes from mutually confident regions, improving feature discrimination around ambiguous boundaries. High-confidence Context Refinement (HCR) exploits reliable interior pixels and trusted dense blocks within mutually confident regions to complement stable contextual supervision. R2CL achieves stable improvements in region-overlap and boundary-related metrics across multiple datasets, with more evident advantages on the foreground-sparse MVAA-CT dataset.

AI.tldr: R2CL: 半监督心脏分割框架，按双网络置信度关系给无标注区域分配角色（互不确定→熵正则、置信差异→定向知识迁移、互置信→可靠锚点），配合区域混合交叉学习、可靠性过渡原型对比学习与高置信上下文精化。
AI.motivation: 现有半监督分割对所有无标注像素施加统一监督，忽略空间可靠性的显著差异，导致边界、低置信区与双网络分歧区的噪声监督，削弱挑战区域判别性学习。
AI.method: 双网络置信度建模划分三类无标注区域并赋角色；RR-MCL 通过区域混合训练、定向跨网络监督与互不确定区熵正则实现角色分工；RT-PCL 以前景邻近的可靠性过渡区构造查询特征、以互置信区学习网络专属类原型；HCR 利用可靠内部像素与互置信区可信密集块补充稳定上下文监督。
AI.result: 多数据集上区域重叠与边界相关指标稳定提升，在前景稀疏的 MVAA-CT 数据集上优势更明显。
AI.conclusion: 基于可靠性角色划分的非均匀伪标签监督可有效提升半监督心脏图像分割在边界与稀疏前景场景的表现。

title: Mamba3R: Fixed-Capacity Selective State Memory for Long-Sequence 3D Reconstruction
comment: 12 pages, 4 figures, 8 tables. The supplementary material referenced in the text is not included in this version
summary: Streaming 3D reconstruction must maintain geometric quality over long inputs within a fixed GPU budget. A pretrained recurrent model provides bounded state, but freezing its backbone also fixes its learned state-observation interactions. We introduce Mamba3R, a jointly designed state-memory adapter that provides a trainable adaptation path without updating the backbone or task heads. A selective state-space mixer jointly transforms native state features and a fixed-capacity auxiliary memory, explicit read and write paths carry information across frames, and a decomposed feedback path regulates what the added memory feeds back. Only 1.28 million adapter parameters are trained. Under a shared periodic-reset protocol, it lowers trajectory error and improves accumulated surface and depth accuracy over recurrent baselines on public indoor and outdoor datasets and robot-recorded traversals, gaining up to 40 percent on one metric. Matched comparisons support both the choice of the mixing operator and the utility of carrying the auxiliary memory across frames. Allocated memory remains unchanged and throughput moves by at most 1.4 percent from one to two thousand frames. Replaying its recorded traversals offline, the platform's RTX 4060 averages 11.7 frames per second within 5.1 GiB with the same checkpoint, a mean throughput covering the 10 Hz sensor rate.

AI.tldr: Mamba3R：在冻结的预训练循环式流式3D重建骨干上，外挂仅1.28M参数的选择性状态空间（Mamba）记忆适配器，实现长序列下的轨迹/深度/表面精度提升，显存与吞吐几乎不变。
AI.motivation: 流式3D重建需在固定GPU预算下长时间保持几何质量。预训练循环模型状态有界，但冻结骨干也冻结了其“状态—观测”交互方式，全部微调代价过高。
AI.method: 提出选择性状态空间混合器，共同变换骨干原生状态特征与固定容量辅助记忆；显式读/写路径跨帧传递信息，分解式反馈路径调节记忆回注；仅训练1.28M适配器参数，不改骨干与任务头。
AI.result: 在统一周期重置协议下，于公开室内外数据集及机器人采集序列上降低轨迹误差、提升累积表面与深度精度，单项指标最高提升约40%；消融支持混合算子选择与跨帧辅助记忆的必要性；内存分配不变，1k→2k帧吞吐变化≤1.4%；RTX 4060上11.7 FPS、5.1 GiB显存。
AI.conclusion: 轻量适配器可在不重训骨干的前提下有效扩展循环式流式3D重建的长程记忆能力，兼具实时性与部署可行性。

title: DiMuRe: Diagnosis-Guided Multilevel Recovery for Robotic Task Execution
comment: 15 pages, 3 figures, including appendices
summary: Disturbances can invalidate the conditions required by a robot's next action even when much of its task program remains useful. A recovery system must therefore choose a response suited to the current state. We present DiMuRe (diagnosis-guided multilevel recovery), a framework for robot-use agents that uses phase-specific evidence and method preconditions to select program reuse or predefined recovery skills, including bounded vision-language-action (VLA) grasping. After the original program exits, a multimodal large language model (MLLM) can generate corrective code from images and execution feedback. Local verification checks the outcome of each recovery attempt. We also introduce LIBERO-Disturb, a benchmark for robustness and recovery under mid-execution disturbances, supporting program-based agents and VLA policies. On 801 scheduled disturbed Encore development cases, Local DiMuRe (program reuse and recovery skills) achieves 77.65% complete-task success, compared with 58.68% for the original program under the same physical-step allowance. Full DiMuRe achieves 81.90% with terminal replanning, an additional step allowance, and early handoff. Local DiMuRe also uses fewer physical steps per scheduled episode than the original program.

AI.tldr: DiMuRe 用 MLLM 诊断+分阶段证据与技能前置条件，在机器人任务执行中遇扰动时选择程序复用、预定义恢复技能或有限度 VLA 抓取，并发布 LIBERO-Disturb 扰动基准。
AI.motivation: 执行中扰动会使下一步动作的前提条件失效，但任务程序大部分仍可复用；需要按当前状态选择合适响应的恢复机制。
AI.method: 结合相位特异性证据与各方法前置条件做诊断，在原程序退出后由多模态大模型基于图像与执行反馈生成纠正代码；恢复尝试的结果经局部验证；可调用有界 VLA 抓取技能；构建 LIBERO-Disturb 基准，支持程序式智能体与 VLA 策略。
AI.result: 801 个扰动开发用例上，Local DiMuRe 完整任务成功率达 77.65%，原程序同等物理步数预算下为 58.68%；Full DiMuRe 加终端重规划、额外步数预算与提前交接达 81.90%，且 Local DiMuRe 每回合物理步数更少。
AI.conclusion: 诊断引导的多层级恢复显著提升扰动下长程任务鲁棒性，且恢复后程序复用比盲目重规划更省步数。

title: LINDA: Low Resource Foot Ulcer Segmentation using Local Similarity and Iterative Neural Dynamics
summary: Foot ulcers are a leading cause of lower limb amputation, and the highest burden often falls on low and middle income regions where specialists and computing hardware are both scarce. Wound monitoring tools are most useful there when they are accurate yet small enough to run on ordinary devices, but accuracy usually comes from heavy networks. We present LINDA, a compact model that grounds segmentation in an explicit structural prior instead of raw intensity. A Local Self-Similarity (LSS) map, computed directly from the image and stable under local lighting changes, is fused into a ResNet-34 encoder, and a small Liquid Time-Constant module refines the boundary over four iterative steps. With every model trained under one protocol on the FUSeg 2021 dataset, LINDA obtains the best Dice (86.68\%), IoU (79.67\%), and boundary accuracy (HD95 6.37 pixels) in our comparison while using only 25.70M parameters, fewer than the U-Net and transformer baselines. As the LSS map is a fixed function of the input, it exposes the structural cues the model follows in a readable form. Together this makes LINDA an accurate, inspectable, and lightweight option for wound assessment in resource-constrained care.

AI.tldr: 提出轻量分割模型LINDA，以局部自相似性(LSS)结构先验替代原始强度信息，融合进ResNet-34编码器，并用小型Liquid Time-Constant模块迭代精修边界，在FUSeg 2021上以仅25.70M参数取得最优Dice/IoU/HD95。
AI.motivation: 足部溃疡是下肢截肢的重要诱因，负担最重的中低收入地区同时缺乏专科医师与算力硬件；伤口监测工具需兼顾精度与轻量，但高精度通常依赖大模型，二者矛盾亟需解决。
AI.method: 从原图直接计算局部自相似性(LSS)图作为显式结构先验（对局部光照变化稳定），将其与图像一同融合进ResNet-34编码器；解码端使用小型Liquid Time-Constant(LTC)模块，经4步迭代精修分割边界。所有模型在FUSeg 2021数据集上按统一协议训练与对比。
AI.result: 与U-Net、Transformer等基线在统一协议下比较，LINDA取得Dice 86.68%、IoU 79.67%、HD95 6.37像素，均为最优；参数量仅25.70M，少于所有基线。由于LSS图为输入的固定函数，其结构线索可以可读形式呈现，具备可解释性。
AI.conclusion: LINDA以显式结构先验+轻量迭代边界精修，在资源受限场景下实现精度、体积与可检视性三者的平衡，适用于医疗点伤口评估；但验证局限于单一医学数据集，缺少跨数据集与真实部署证据。

title: TCINet: Tissue-Conditioned Adaptive Cross-Branch Interaction Network for Nuclei Instance Segmentation
comment: Accepted by IEEE BIBM 2026 as a short paper
summary: Separating touching nuclei requires local boundary detail, while cell type classification requires broader morphological context. These requirements also vary with the surrounding tissue environment. We propose the Tissue-Conditioned Adaptive Cross-Branch Interaction Network (TCINet), a single-stage model with Task-Specific Feature Adapters (TSFA) and Tissue-Conditioned Task-Aware Cross-Branch Interaction (TC-TACBI). TSFA produces branch-specific features at skip connections, and TC-TACBI controls three asymmetric paths among nucleus-presence (NP), horizontal-vertical (HV), and nucleus-type (NT) branches using predicted tissue probabilities. On PanNuke under standard three-fold cross-validation, TCINet achieves multiclass and binary panoptic quality scores of 0.519 and 0.692, respectively. Zero-shot tests on MoNuSeg yield a detection F1 score of 0.876. On PanNuke fold 0, adding TC-TACBI increases mPQ from 0.505 to 0.525. Code is available at this https URL .

AI.tldr: TCINet：组织条件驱动的单阶段核分割与分类网络，用任务专用特征适配器和组织概率门控的非对称跨分支交互，联合完成细胞核检测、边界分离与类型分类。
AI.motivation: 粘连细胞核分离需局部边界细节，细胞类型分类需更大范围形态上下文，且两类需求随周围组织环境变化；现有多分支方法未按任务与组织类型自适应地调控特征流。
AI.method: 单阶段多分支架构：Task-Specific Feature Adapters 在跳跃连接处生成分支专用特征；Tissue-Conditioned Task-Aware Cross-Branch Interaction 以预测的组织概率控制 NP、HV、NT 三分支间三条非对称信息通路。
AI.result: PanNuke 三折交叉验证多类/二类 PQ 为 0.519/0.692；MoNuSeg 零样本检测 F1 0.876；fold 0 上加入 TC-TACBI 使 mPQ 由 0.505 升至 0.525。
AI.conclusion: 按任务和预测组织类型条件化调控跨分支交互可在单阶段框架内同时提升分割与分类，且零样本迁移能力较好；代码开源。

title: Improving Diffusion-Based Augmentation for Data-Scarce Image Classification via Mask-Guided Reference Attention and Repulsive Noise Optimization
comment: WACV2027 accepted
summary: Diffusion-based data augmentation has emerged as a powerful strategy for addressing data-scarce image classification. Recent pipelines typically adapt a pretrained text-to-image diffusion model to a limited number of class examples and subsequently sample synthetic images using diverse textual prompts. However, in extreme data-scarce regimes such as long-tailed single-sample settings, this approach suffers from a dual failure mode: the generated samples often lack discriminative foreground details crucial for classifier training, and the adapted class prior can bias the early denoising process, causing output images to exhibit similar patterns despite varying text prompts. To overcome these limitations, we propose a sampling-side framework of two complementary components that simultaneously enhance fine details and diversity. First, Mask-Guided Reference (MGR) Attention updates only foreground value tokens with reference features via zero-shot segmentation, limiting reference influence to the target object and mitigating excessive global feature injection. Second, Repulsive Noise Optimization (RNO) encourages initial noise trajectories to diverge from dominant generative modes of the adapted model, enabling target prompts to express broader contextual variation. Extensive evaluations show consistent improvements, with the largest gains in long-tailed single-sample settings of up to 2.50 and 2.94 points on CUB-LT IF100, and further robustness across few-shot and background-shift evaluations.

AI.tldr: 提出采样阶段的扩散数据增强框架：Mask-Guided Reference (MGR) Attention 仅用参考特征更新前景 value token，Repulsive Noise Optimization (RNO) 使初始噪声轨迹偏离适配模型主导生成模式，从而同时提升判别性细节与多样性。
AI.motivation: 在长尾单样本等极端数据稀缺场景下，基于预训练文生图扩散模型的合成增强存在双重失效：生成样本缺乏判别性前景细节；适配后的类别先验偏置早期去噪过程，导致不同文本提示下输出模式趋同。
AI.method: 采样端双组件框架。MGR Attention：借助零样本分割掩码，仅对前景 value token 注入参考特征，抑制过度全局特征注入；RNO：优化初始噪声，使其轨迹与适配模型主导生成模式分离，扩大上下文变化空间。
AI.result: 在长尾单样本设置（CUB-LT IF100）上提升最高 2.50 与 2.94 个点，并在 few-shot 与背景偏移评测中表现稳健。
AI.conclusion: 无需修改扩散模型权重，仅通过采样侧干预即可缓解细节缺失与模式坍缩，是数据稀缺分类增强的轻量有效方案。

title: CounterSketch: Physics-Grounded Counterfactual Reasoning for Sketch-to-Video Generation
summary: Counterfactual sketch animation explores how a static sketch evolves under a hypothetical intervention. We present CounterSketch, a physics-grounded framework that transforms natural-language ``What if...?'' queries into physically plausible sketch animations. The framework integrates VLM-guided scene grounding, causal event-chain reasoning, constraint-based trajectory generation, and verification. It models physical transitions to update the scene graph, computes continuous object trajectories, and validates them against physical, geometric, and semantic constraints. The verified trajectories are then projected into object-level motion bounding boxes to guide downstream sketch-video synthesis. Experiments on CounterSketchBench (80 questions) demonstrate that physics-grounded trajectories provide stronger motion guidance than direct VLM predictions.

AI.tldr: CounterSketch 将自然语言"What if...?"问题转化为物理合理的简笔动画：VLM 场景落地 + 因果事件链推理 + 约束式轨迹生成与校验，再用轨迹生成物体级运动包围盒引导下游素描视频合成。
AI.motivation: 静态素描本身不含物理动态，直接让 VLM 预测运动往往违反物理与几何约束；需要显式的、物理接地的假设干预推演框架来生成可信的运动指导。
AI.method: 四阶段流水线：(1) VLM 引导的场景图构建；(2) 因果事件链推理；(3) 基于物理过渡更新场景图并计算连续物体轨迹，用物理/几何/语义约束做校验；(4) 将验证后的轨迹投影为物体级运动包围盒，驱动素描视频合成。
AI.result: 在 CounterSketchBench（80 题）上，物理接地的轨迹比 VLM 直接预测提供更强的运动引导；论文仅报告相对比较，未见定量指标详情。
AI.conclusion: 把物理约束+因果推理与生成式视频管线解耦是有效的，轨迹级中间表示可作为视觉生成的可控信号；但缺乏物理世界/机器人验证与定量实验规模。

title: P-SER: Physical Consistency-Constrained Scattering Expandable Representation for Class-Incremental HRRP Target Recognition
summary: High-resolution range profiles (HRRPs) provide compact radar target representations but exhibit strong aspect sensitivity, complicating class-incremental recognition when historical data are unavailable. Changes in viewing aspect shift scattering-peak locations and amplitudes, while reflector groups may produce responses resembling ships. Existing dynamic expansion methods can also incur substantial parameter and memory overhead. To address these challenges, we propose P-SER, a Physical Consistency-Constrained Scattering Expandable Representation framework for exemplar-free class-incremental HRRP recognition. P-SER reconstructs dominant scattering points from complex-valued sum- and azimuth-difference-channel HRRPs and observation geometry. The reconstructed spatial structure, target extent, and energy distribution are used to derive class-level scattering prototypes and sample-level saliency priors, providing physically grounded constraints for feature learning and old-class knowledge retention. A primitive scatterer dictionary further characterizes local strong-scattering mechanisms and calibrates uncertain ship--reflector predictions at inference. Meanwhile, lightweight residual adapters are incrementally introduced into a shared HRRP backbone to learn new classes with limited model growth. Experiments on simulated and measured HRRP datasets show that P-SER delivers competitive recognition performance without retaining old-class exemplars, while maintaining physical consistency, interference robustness, knowledge retention, and model scalability.

AI.tldr: P-SER：面向无样本类增量HRRP识别的物理一致性约束散射可扩展表示框架，用散射点重建导出类级原型与样本级显著性先验，并以轻量残差适配器增量扩展共享骨干。
AI.motivation: HRRP表示紧凑但视角敏感，历史数据不可用时类增量识别困难：视角变化使散射峰位置与幅度漂移，反射体组合可产生类船响应；现有动态扩展方法参数量与内存开销大。
AI.method: 从复数域和通道与方位差通道HRRP及观测几何重建主导散射点；由空间结构、目标展布与能量分布导出类级散射原型和样本级显著性先验作为物理约束；引入基元散射体字典刻画局部强散射机制并在推理时校准船-反射体歧义预测；在共享HRRP骨干上增量加入轻量残差适配器。
AI.result: 在仿真与实测HRRP数据集上，无旧类样本条件下取得有竞争力的识别性能，并保持物理一致性、抗干扰性、知识保持与模型可扩展性。
AI.conclusion: 以散射物理先验约束增量特征学习，可在免样本类增量HRRP识别中兼顾精度与低模型增长，为雷达目标连续学习提供可解释路径。

title: ActOR: Ambient AI-Based Agentic Orchestration for Humanoid Autonomy in Operating Rooms
summary: Operating rooms (ORs) increasingly contain ambient sensing infrastructure to enable AI-based optimization of workflows and utilization. We pursue an alternative path: using ambient AI to guide robot action and optimize utilization. Deploying humanoids in the OR without ambient AI is severely limited by cumbersome de novo orientation and planning due to partial onboard observations. We posit that this can be achieved by coupling an ambient AI-based agentic orchestrator with the humanoid robotic actor, providing shared perception and execution feedback for humanoid autonomy in the OR. ActOR fuses a wall-mounted ambient camera and the robot's head-mounted camera into a shared object-level digital twin (DT). A large language model agent plans over the DT using pre-programmed locomotion and manipulation skills without task-specific training. During execution, DT updates and execution outcomes inform retries, alternative approaches, or replanning. We evaluated ActOR in simulated and physical environments. Across three tasks in two simulated ORs reconstructed from real rooms, ambient perception reduced exploration from 1.05 to 0.12 Explore calls per trial when targets were initially outside the robot's view. Closed-loop feedback increased success from 46.7% to 83.3% under nominal execution and from 8.3% to 51.7% under injected navigation, object-relocation, and grasp perturbations. In a physical mock OR with a humanoid, ActOR completed 14 of 20 single-object disposal trials and demonstrated replanning after scene changes. Ambient AI-based observations provide scene state that improves robot action planning, increasing success and reducing exploration compared with robot-only observations. Feeding skill outcomes and DT updates back to the planner improves multi-step task success. Our results show the feasibility of humanoid task autonomy for multi-step disposal tasks in a mock OR.

AI.tldr: ActOR 用"环境AI编排器 + 人形机器人执行器"耦合架构：融合壁挂环境相机与机器人头部相机为对象级数字孪生，LLM Agent在孪生上零样本规划 locomotion/manipulation 技能，并以执行结果闭环重试/换策略/重规划，在仿真与实体模拟手术室验证成功率与探索效率提升。
AI.motivation: 手术室已普遍部署环境传感基础设施，但人形机器人在无环境感知辅助时因机载观测局部性导致定向与规划困难。作者希望用 ambient AI 同时服务机器人动作引导与利用率优化，替代纯工作流优化的路线。
AI.method: ActOR = 环境感知 + Agentic 编排器 + 人形执行器。硬件侧融合墙面固定环境相机与头戴相机；表示侧构建对象级数字孪生（DT）；规划侧用 LLM Agent 在 DT 上基于预编程技能库规划，无需任务特定训练；执行侧将 DT 更新与执行结果作为反馈驱动重试、替代方案或重规划。
AI.result: 仿真（两间由真实房间重建的手术室、三类任务）：目标不在视野时探索呼叫由1.05降至0.12次/试；闭环反馈使成功率在标称条件下由46.7%升至83.3%，在导航、物体移位、抓取扰动注入下由8.3%升至51.7%。实体模拟手术室中20次单物体清运试验完成14次，并展示了场景变化后的重规划。
AI.conclusion: 环境AI观测提供了改善机器人动作规划的场景状态，相比仅机载观测显著提升成功率并减少探索；将技能执行结果与DT更新回馈规划器可改善多步任务成功率，验证了模拟手术室中多步清运任务的人形自主可行性。

title: ProGeo-RC: Prototype-guided Semantic Reliability and Geometric Error Calibration for Semi-supervised Cardiac Image Segmentation
comment: Accepted at IEEE BIBM 2026. 7 pages, 3 figures
summary: Semi-supervised medical image segmentation aims to train reliable segmentation models using limited labeled data and abundant unlabeled data. However, existing methods typically rely on prediction confidence or model consistency to estimate pseudo-label reliability, but these criteria are insufficient to characterize both semantic reliability and geometric plausibility. To address this issue, we propose ProGeo-RC, a prototype-guided semantic reliability and geometric error calibration framework for semi-supervised medical image segmentation. ProGeo-RC consists of two key modules: Prototype-guided Semantic Reliability Estimation (PSRE) and Structured Semantic-Geometric Error Calibration (S-SGEC). PSRE uses probabilistic class prototypes to estimate the semantic reliability of unlabeled predictions and calibrate pixel-wise teacher pseudo labels, while S-SGEC introduces signed-distance-field-based geometric constraints to refine ambiguous boundaries and suppress spurious foreground responses outside target structures. Experiments on the ACDC and MVAA-CT datasets show that ProGeo-RC achieves better performance compared with representative semi-supervised segmentation methods. Under the 10\% labeled setting on ACDC, ProGeo-RC improves DSC and Jaccard by 0.37\% and 0.49\% over the corresponding second-best results, while reducing 95HD and ASD by 0.61 and 0.21, respectively. These results indicate that joint semantic reliability estimation and geometric error calibration can provide more reliable pseudo supervision for semi-supervised medical image segmentation.

AI.tldr: ProGeo-RC：用概率类原型估计无标注预测的语义可靠性以校准教师伪标签，并用基于符号距离场的几何约束修正边界歧义与结构外虚假前景响应，实现半监督医学图像分割。
AI.motivation: 现有半监督医学分割方法仅依赖预测置信度或模型一致性来评估伪标签可靠性，难以同时刻画语义可靠性与几何合理性。
AI.method: 提出双模块框架：PSRE（原型引导语义可靠性估计）利用概率类原型估计无标注预测的语义可靠性并对像素级教师伪标签进行校准；S-SGEC（结构化语义-几何误差校准）引入基于SDF的几何约束，细化模糊边界并抑制目标结构外的虚假前景响应。
AI.result: 在ACDC与MVAA-CT上均优于代表性半监督分割方法；ACDC 10%标注下DSC/Jaccard分别提升0.37%/0.49%，95HD与ASD分别降低0.61与0.21。
AI.conclusion: 语义可靠性估计与几何误差校准联合可提供更可靠的伪监督信号，提升半监督医学图像分割性能。

title: Sketch-Omni: Instance-Level Sketch-Based Visual Prompting for Perception MLLMs
summary: Promptable perception, from GroundingDINO to Rex-Omni, puts one model behind one prompt interface and returns coordinates for any localisation task. Every model in that line was built for photographs; none has been given a sketch. We present Sketch-Omni, to our knowledge the first perception MLLM built to work on sketches and from them. On a sketch, the sketch is the image, and text prompts detect, point, resolve object and spatial referring expressions, and ground affordances in it. From a sketch, the sketch is the prompt, and a drawing of one object localises that object in a photograph, even among several of the same category, a query that neither a category name nor a photo exemplar can pose. Two obstacles stand in the way. A photo-trained model's attention is tuned to colour and texture, which a sketch does not have, and no dataset pairs a drawing with the one instance it depicts among others of its kind. We build the training data instead of collecting it. An edge detector turns every labelled photograph into a sketch-like drawing that keeps the photograph's labels, and two constructions produce sketch-to-photo instance pairs from existing data. On top of this, photo-guided relation alignment passes each photograph and its edge sketch through the same model and trains the sketch pass to reproduce how the photograph pass relates phrases to patches and patches to each other. Not one training label is drawn by hand. Sketch-Omni reaches 91.4 F1 on sketch-prompted localisation against 81.8 for the strongest general-purpose MLLM, with a lead that doubles when the photograph holds several instances of the queried category, and it is best in 39 of 40 evaluation cells across six tasks. Code, model, and a hand-annotated benchmark of 2754 sketch-to-photo links will be released.

AI.tldr: Sketch-Omni：首个面向手绘草图的可提示感知MLLM，既可"以草图为图像"做检测/指向/指代解析/可供性定位，也可"以草图为提示"实现草图到照片的实例级定位；通过边缘检测合成训练数据与照片引导的关系对齐训练，无需人工标注。
AI.motivation: 现有可提示感知模型（GroundingDINO、Rex-Omni等）全部基于照片训练，注意力偏向颜色与纹理，而草图无此线索；同时缺少"一张画对应照片中同类多实例中的特定一个"的配对数据，草图输入下的空间/指代/可供性 grounding 亦属空白。
AI.method: 1) 用边缘检测器把每张有标注照片转成草图式线条图，直接继承原标注；2) 两种构造方式从已有数据合成草图-照片实例配对；3) 照片引导的关系对齐：同一模型分别处理照片与其边缘草图，令草图通路复现照片通路中"短语-patch"与"patch-patch"的关系结构。全程零人工标注。
AI.result: 草图提示定位达 91.4 F1，最强通用MLLM为81.8；当照片中同类实例较多时领先幅度翻倍；在六个任务的40个评测单元中39个最优。将发布代码、模型及2754条草图-照片链接的人工标注基准。
AI.conclusion: 草图可作为一等公民的视觉提示与目标模态，通过合成式数据构建与跨模态关系对齐弥补纹理缺失与配对缺失，为草图驱动的实例级视觉指定提供了首个统一框架；对机器人领域，草图为人类提供低成本、免类别词的实例级指代接口。

title: Weight-Space Programming for Improving Image-Restoration Diffusion Models: Technical Conjectures and a Recursive Improvement Loop
comment: This manuscript is merely conjectural, intended to open a new subtopic within the field of image restoration
summary: Can an LLM directly edit the weights of a diffusion-based image-restoration model to \emph{improve} restoration quality---without gradients, paired data, or fine-tuning? Recent experiments show frontier LLMs can fix structural bugs by modifying as little as \(0.016\%\) of parameters, but cannot instill new capabilities. We ask whether weight-space programming (WSP) can move from \emph{debugging} to \emph{improvement} in the precise-regression setting of image restoration (deblurring, super-resolution, denoising, inpainting). Restoration diffusion UNets present a middle ground: low-level signal-processing layers are concentrated enough for targeted weight-direction edits, while high-level semantic layers remain distributed and resistant to sparse modification. We propose three technical conjectures: (C1) an LLM can localize the layer behind a quality gap (over-smoothing, color shift, hallucinated texture) within a 200 forward-pass budget; (C2) editing a small set of identified weight directions (e.g., scaling high-frequency filter norms, correcting output-bias channels) can measurably improve PSNR and perceptual quality; (C3) a recursive loop---diagnose \(\rightarrow\) edit \(\rightarrow\) evaluate \(\rightarrow\) re-diagnose---can compound gains across rounds, forming a minimal recursive self-improvement (RSI) loop for vision. We analyze the required AI capability (arguing targeted edits need not superintelligence, while general capability generation does) and detail the challenges of precise pixel-level regression. We provide a PyTorch-style deployment pipeline and outline a benchmark. This manuscript is conjectural, intended to open a new subtopic for image restoration.

AI.tldr: 提出"权重空间编程"(WSP)能否从"修bug"走向"提质"的猜想：让LLM在无梯度、无配对数据、无微调条件下直接编辑扩散式图像复原UNet的少量权重方向，用于去模糊/超分/去噪/修复，并给出三条技术猜想(C1定位/C2编辑/C3递归自改进)、能力分析与部署流水线及基准设计。
AI.motivation: 前沿LLM已能用<0.016%参数改动修复结构性bug，但难以注入新能力。作者想在图像复原这一"精确回归"场景验证WSP可否实现能力提升而非仅调试，并借此开启图像复原的新子方向。
AI.method: 概念/猜想型论文：以复原扩散UNet为对象，论证其低层信号处理层集中、适合定向权重编辑，高层语义层分布化、难以稀疏修改；提出C1(200次前向内定位导致过度平滑/色偏/幻觉纹理的层)、C2(编辑高频滤波范数缩放、输出偏置通道校正等少数权重方向以改善PSNR与感知质量)、C3(诊断→编辑→评估→再诊断的递归环路形成最小RSI环路)；并分析所需AI能力层级、像素级回归难点，给出PyTorch风格部署流水线与基准方案。
AI.result: 无实验结果，属manuscript为conjectural，仅提出假设、能力论证、流程草图与基准设想，尚无可验证的性能改进证据。
AI.conclusion: 权重空间编程在图像复原上或可从调试扩展为能力提升，但需实证；具体编辑手段(滤波范数缩放、偏置校正)本质接近手工信号处理调参，递归RSI环路尚缺证据支撑。

title: GroundSeek-CXR: Retrospective Evaluation-Guided Active Observation Framework for Multi-Label Chest Radiography Diagnosis
summary: Chest radiography (CXR) diagnosis is critical for thoracic disease assessment, yet challenged by the need to identify subtle lesions and co-occurring abnormalities across regions. While recent vision-language models can actively observe local regions, existing preference-based methods supervise each observation by its immediate effect on the current diagnosis, failing to capture how each observation and stopping decision contributes to the final diagnosis. To address this issue, we propose GroundSeek-CXR, an active CXR diagnosis framework that learns observation and stopping decisions by retrospectively evaluating them with the final diagnosis. Specifically, we first devise a Retrospective Diagnostic Evaluation (RDE) that scores observation and stop candidates from offline Monte Carlo tree search through independent continuations. Moreover, we design a Retrospective Gap-weighted Preference Optimization (RGPO) that learns from retrospective-score preferences weighted by their score gaps, prioritizing actions that improve diagnostic accuracy. Extensive experiments demonstrate that our GroundSeek-CXR framework outperforms state-of-the-art methods, and improves abnormal-image sample-F1 by 4.48% over immediate-score preference learning.

AI.tldr: 提出 GroundSeek-CXR，通过“最终诊断回顾性评估”来学习主动观察与停止决策：用离线 MCTS 产生的独立续写轨迹打分（RDE），并用分数差加权做偏好优化（RGPO），在胸片诊断上超过现有方法，异常样本 F1 提升 4.48%。
AI.motivation: 现有基于偏好的主动视觉-语言模型逐次观察的监督只看其对当前诊断的即时影响，无法反映某次观察或停止决策对最终诊断的真实贡献，因此难以捕捉细微病灶与跨区域共现异常。
AI.method: 1) Retrospective Diagnostic Evaluation：离线蒙特卡洛树搜索生成观察/停止候选，并对每个候选做独立续写（continuation）以最终诊断准确率打分；2) Retrospective Gap-weighted Preference Optimization：以回顾性分数的差值作为权重构造偏好对，优先优化能提升诊断准确率的动作，形成观察策略与停止策略的联合学习框架。
AI.result: 在胸片诊断实验中优于 SOTA；相较即时分数偏好学习，异常图像样本级 F1 提升 4.48%。摘要未报告更多定量指标或真实临床部署证据。
AI.conclusion: 将“终局回报式”的回顾性评价引入主动医学图像观察的策略学习，比即时奖励式偏好监督更贴合长程多步观察任务；思想可迁移到其他多步视觉推理/主动感知，但本身属医学领域 CV，与具身/3D 主线关联弱。

title: CLOCs-R: Radar-Assisted Camera-LiDAR Fusion for Long-Range Object Detection
summary: Long-range 3D object detection remains difficult for autonomous vehicles because LiDAR returns become sparse and camera evidence weakens with distance, while automotive radar keeps returning measurements far beyond both. We present CLOCs-R, an extension of the CLOCs candidate-level fusion framework that adds radar evidence to camera-LiDAR rescoring. Radar returns are accumulated over several sweeps, compensated for ego-motion, and associated with each pre-NMS 3D candidate through a range-dependent gate. Compact features summarizing support, Doppler speed and spread, range residual, and offset are then appended to every camera-LiDAR pair before a lightweight fusion network rescores the candidates. We first verify that our fusion implementation reproduces CLOCs on KITTI. We then evaluate on the daytime clear-weather subset of the aiMotive dataset, reporting distance-binned metrics out to 200 m with frozen SECOND and Cascade R-CNN detectors. Camera-LiDAR CLOCs improves on SECOND up to 50 m but degrades beyond it. A residual scoring variant, introduced post hoc, corrects SECOND's score instead of replacing it and recovers most of this loss. Radar consistently improves BEV AP at 30-50 m (0.857 to 0.870), but beyond 50 m its gain is small (+0.003 center-distance AP), within seed variation, and CLOCs-R with residual scoring is statistically tied with LiDAR-only SECOND. Our analysis attributes the limited long-range benefit to weak separation of true and false detections by radar features, scarce far-range training positives, poor camera evidence at distance, and missing LiDAR proposals that rescoring cannot recover. We report all as-designed and post hoc results side by side.

AI.tldr: CLOCs-R 将雷达多帧累积证据接入 CLOCs 的候选级融合重打分，提升 30-50 m 的 BEV AP，但 50 m 以外增益微弱，与 LiDAR-only 基线统计持平。
AI.motivation: 远距离 3D 检测中 LiDAR 点云稀疏、相机证据随距离衰弱，而车载雷达可远距持续回波，因此尝试把雷达证据引入相机-LiDAR 候选级融合以改善长距离检测。
AI.method: 在 CLOCs 框架上扩展：雷达多 sweep 累积并做自车运动补偿，通过距离相关门控与 pre-NMS 3D 候选关联；提取支持度、Doppler 速度与散布、距离残差、偏移等紧凑特征，与相机-LiDAR 特征拼接后由轻量融合网络对候选重打分。另提出事后（post hoc）的残差打分变体，在 SECOND 分数上做修正而非替换。
AI.result: 在 KITTI 上复现 CLOCs；在 aiMotive 白天晴天子集的 SECOND + Cascade R-CNN 冻结检测器上评估至 200 m：相机-LiDAR CLOCs 在 50 m 内优于 SECOND、之外变差；残差打分挽回大部分损失；雷达使 30-50 m BEV AP 从 0.857 升至 0.870，50 m 外仅 +0.003 中心距 AP，处于随机种子波动范围，CLOCs-R 与 LiDAR-only SECOND 统计持平。
AI.conclusion: 远距增益受限的成因包括：雷达特征对真伪检测分离度弱、远距正样本稀少、相机远距证据差、缺失的 LiDAR 提案无法被重打分找回。作者如实并列报告 as-designed 与 post hoc 结果。

title: FlowTranslator: Training-Free In-Image Machine Translation with Flow-Based Editing
summary: In-image machine translation (IIMT) replaces text in an image with its translation while preserving the surrounding visual context. Existing task-specific models achieve convincing performance but require massive paired training images before and after translation. As advanced text-to-image (T2I) models have reached a practically usable level of multilingual text generation, we argue that this capability can be transferred to IIMT and present FlowTranslator. It is a training-free IIMT framework that first employs an OCR model and an LLM to generate the translation prompt, which is injected into the T2I-based diffusion model. To optimize the accurate and natural generation of translated text, we introduce two trajectory controls: Region Coupling Release (RCR) partially decorrelates target-branch noise inside the text region early in the trajectory, while Coupling Expansion (CE) amplifies the emerging edit displacement mid-trajectory. Under the EasyOCR read-back protocol, FlowTranslator achieves average PRIM BLEU and COMET scores of 20.6 and 57.2, respectively, substantially outperforming the strong training-based baseline UniTranslator. On the more challenging and realistic whole-image ScenePair photographs translated into Chinese, it reaches 40.1\% exact-match accuracy and surpasses existing editing systems, some of which only address the text-rendering stage rather than the complete IIMT task. These results establish flow-based editing as a strong, fully training-free baseline for IIMT.

AI.tldr: FlowTranslator：免训练的图内机器翻译框架，用 OCR+LLM 生成翻译提示注入 T2I 扩散模型，并通过 Region Coupling Release 与 Coupling Expansion 两条轨迹控制提升译文的准确与自然渲染。
AI.motivation: 现有 IIMT 任务专用模型依赖大量译前/译后配对图像训练；而多语言文本生成的 T2I 模型已可用，因此希望把该能力迁移到 IIMT 并省去训练。
AI.method: 无训练流程：OCR 模型识别原图文字，LLM 产出翻译并构造提示，注入基于 T2I 的扩散模型；轨迹控制上，RCR 在轨迹早期对目标分支文本区域内的噪声做部分去相关，CE 在轨迹中期放大新出现的编辑位移。
AI.result: EasyOCR 回读协议下 PRIM BLEU 20.6、COMET 57.2，明显超过训练型基线 UniTranslator；在更难的整图 ScenePair 照片译成中文时精确匹配 40.1%，优于部分只做文本渲染阶段的编辑系统。
AI.conclusion: 表明流式编辑可作为 IIMT 强而完全免训练的基线，说明 T2I 多语言文本生成能力可有效迁移到图像文字替换任务。

title: Weather Adaptive Autonomous Driving
summary: Camera object detectors lose recall in rain, fog, snow and sand, and the confidence threshold at which a detector is deployed decides how many objects it misses and how many false alarms it raises. We study how a frozen detector should make this decision in adverse weather. We first reproduce SeqCRC, a conformal object detector whose first step calibrates the confidence threshold by conformal risk control (CRC), and use that step, calibrated separately in each weather condition, as our baseline. With YOLOv8x it keeps the held-out miss fraction within a 20% budget in every DAWN weather bin, where a single global threshold fails in fog, but the false alarms it needs are an output rather than a choice: from 1.6 to 117 per image across DAWN and BDD100K conditions. We then propose a calibrated trade-off dial. One setting, $\lambda$, the number of false alarms accepted to avoid one missed object, selects the expected-cost-optimal decision rule: either one score threshold, or a per-detection rule that keeps a box when its calibrated probability of being a real object, estimated by gradient-boosted trees from the detector's own per-box outputs, is at least $1/(1+\lambda)$. F-score preferences map onto the same dial, and CRC applied to $\lambda$ itself is planned to restore a per-condition miss guarantee. The dial is fitted once on BDD100K train and graded only on BDD100K val and DAWN.

AI.tldr: 提出"校准权衡旋钮"λ：以"可容忍1次漏检对应的误检数"为唯一参数，按期望代价最优选取决策规则（单一分数阈值或基于梯度提升树估计的逐框真实概率≥1/(1+λ)的逐检测规则），并以CRC将漏检风险约束迁移到λ上，实现恶劣天气下冻结检测器的可控漏检-误检权衡。
AI.motivation: 相机目标检测器在雨、雾、雪、沙尘中召回下降，部署阈值决定漏检与误检数量；既有共形风险控制方法(SeqCRC)能约束漏检比例，但产生的误检数是被动输出而非可选项，无法在变化天气下由用户按代价偏好做显式权衡。
AI.method: 1) 复现SeqCRC基线：对每个天气条件分别做共形风险控制以校准置信度阈值；2) 提出λ旋钮（接受λ个误检以避免1次漏检），在该代价下导出期望代价最优规则：单阈值方案；或对各检测框用梯度提升树从其自身输出预测"真实目标概率"p，p≥1/(1+λ)时保留；3)F-score偏好映射到同一λ；4) 对λ本身施加CRC以恢复逐条件漏检保证；5) 仅在BDD100K train上拟合一次，在BDD100K val与DAWN上评测（YOLOv8x）。
AI.result: SeqCRC基线在DAWN各天气桶中将留出漏检比例控制在20%预算内（全局单阈值在雾天失效），但误检数为不可控输出，DAWN与BDD100K各条件下为1.6–117个/图；λ旋钮给出显式的误检-漏检帕累托式选择，并统一解释F-score偏好。
AI.conclusion: 将阈值决策从"固定阈值/被动误检"转为可解释的单参数代价旋钮，是恶劣天气下冻结检测器可部署化的可行路径；但λ级CRC的逐条件漏检保证尚为计划中工作，跨数据集泛化证据（单次拟合+两数据集验证）与实时性、下游任务收益仍待补足。

title: SteelHuman: Predicting Operator Estimates of Steel-Scrap Composition from Sparse RGB Views
comment: 10 pages main paper and 6 pages supplementary material
summary: Steel scrap composition estimation is an important part of yield planning and fair supplier compensation. Measuring the composition of a multi-ton pile is an inherently laborious process, so the assessment is often left to trained human operators. Recent works tackle composition-level tasks, but require structured acquisition and multi-stage preprocessing. We study a simpler approach to steel scrap load assessment by aggregating features from sparse, handheld views of the pile. On 600 out-of-fold piles, frozen DINOv2 tokens aggregated uniformly across views reach 13.4% total variation (TV) distance against operator estimates. Most remaining error lies in allocation among four thickness-defined heavy melting scrap (HMS) classes, yet image-dependent allocation reduces within-HMS TV from 25.1% under a training-set split prior to 11.2%. Due to the lack of public datasets and benchmarks for predicting composition, external evaluation relies on the public DOES dataset intended for classification. A classifier using the same frozen features reaches 93.97% accuracy, exceeding the published results we compare against. The composition model also aligns with related DOES categories without adaptation.

AI.tldr: 用稀疏手持视角聚合冻结 DINOv2 特征估计废钢堆成分，并在 DOES 分类任务上验证特征质量。
AI.motivation: 多吨级废钢堆的成分测量费时费力，常由熟练操作员人工判定；现有成分级方法依赖结构化采集与多阶段预处理，成本高。作者希望探索更简单的采集与估计方案。
AI.method: 对废钢堆采集稀疏的手持视角图像，提取冻结的 DINOv2 token 特征，在跨视角均匀聚合后进行成分回归；对 HMS 厚度分类中的分配误差引入图像相关分配模块替代训练集先验；并用同一特征训练分类器在公开 DOES 数据集上做外部验证。
AI.result: 600 个折外（out-of-fold）废钢堆上，与操作员估计相比总变差距离 13.4%；HMS 类内分配将 TV 由训练集划分先验的 25.1% 降至 11.2%；DOES 分类准确率 93.97%，超过所比较的公开结果，且成分模型无需适配即与相关 DOES 类别对齐。
AI.conclusion: 冻结视觉基础模型特征 + 简单多视角聚合可在免结构化采集条件下给出可用的废钢成分估计，剩余误差主要来自 HMS 类内分配，可被图像相关分配显著降低。

title: Computing Invariant Reachable Sets through Sum-of-Squares Programming
comment: 8 pages, 3 figures, 3 tables. Submitted to IEEE Transactions on Control Systems Technology. Code: this http URL
summary: Funnels, time-varying invariant sets around nominal trajectories, certify that a closed-loop system tracks its plan, and can be composed into verified motion plans. Their computation by sum-of-squares (SOS) programming is well established in formulation but not in practice: the result depends on implementation choices such as the initial guess, Lyapunov function normalization, and termination rule, which the literature documents only briefly. This paper presents a self-contained treatment of SOS-based funnel computation, implemented in the open-source package computeSOSFunnels. We propose a minimum-volume formulation with inlet and outlet constraints under which funnels with coinciding nominal endpoints compose by construction. Numerical experiments on a unicycle, with timing studies on a cart-pole and a 12-state quadrotor, characterize the pipeline: infeasible initial guesses are partly decidable before solving, the certificate shows no violations among 39,000 boundary samples per funnel under the true dynamics, and constructing the semidefinite program, not solving it, dominates computation time.

AI.tldr: 该文系统化SOS（平方和）规划的funnel计算流程，提出最小体积+进出口约束形式使相邻funnel按构造可组合，并开源computeSOSFunnels，指出建模构建SDP而非求解是耗时瓶颈。
AI.motivation: funnel（时变不变集）可认证闭环跟踪并组合成可验证运动规划，但SOS求解结果高度依赖初值、Lyapunov归一化、终止准则等实现细节，文献缺乏系统讨论，导致实践不可复现、难落地。
AI.method: 给出自洽的SOS funnel计算理论推导，提出带入口/出口约束的最小体积（minimum-volume）优化形式，使标称轨迹端点重合的funnel按构造可组合；实现开源包computeSOSFunnels；在单轮车、cart-pole与12维四旋翼上做数值与计时实验，分析初值可行性预判、边界采样验证与计算时间分布。
AI.result: 部分不可行初值可在求解前判定；在真实动力学下每个funnel 39,000个边界采样无违背证书；时间剖析显示SDP建模构建（而非求解器）主导总耗时；给出单轮车、cart-pole、12状态四旋翼的实验结果。
AI.conclusion: SOS funnel计算的实践瓶颈在工程实现与建模而非求解，最小体积+端点约束是可行且可组合的推荐形式；提供开源实现与可复现流水线，为可认证跟踪与组合式运动规划提供实用基础。

title: RAIPAL: A Powerful and Agile Humanoid Arm for Human Tasks
comment: Published in IEEE Robotics and Automation Letters (RA-L), 2026. Supplementary video: this https URL
summary: This paper presents humanoid manipulator hardware designed specifically for human-level performance throughout its broad domain of tasks, from heavy payloads to highly dynamic motions. Unlike conventional designs targeting uniform workspace capability, the proposed approach derives force, speed, and endurance targets from published measurements of task-relevant human upper-limb performance. These targets guide the actuator, mechanism, and thermal design toward torque transparency and sustained operation. The platform integrates force-oriented upper-arm components, speed-oriented forearm components, and a posture-dependent elbow mechanism that shifts its torque-speed behavior. These components are driven by planetary actuators and compact actuator-embedded electronics. Experimental results validate broad task capability, demonstrating a peak payload of 20 kg (2.25x its own mass), an endpoint speed of 20.6 m/s, and continued operation under repeated hammering impacts. Thermal analysis further confirms that the robot's sustained operation capability exceeds the published human load--duration boundary across nearly the entire load spectrum. These findings show that hardware targets derived from human-task measurements narrow the human-to-humanoid capability gap. A supplementary video is available at this https URL

AI.tldr: 提出以人体上肢任务实测数据反推力/速度/续航指标的人形机械臂硬件设计：上臂力导向、前臂速度导向、肘部姿态相关变扭矩-转速机构，配行星减速执行器与嵌入式电子；实测峰值负载20 kg（2.25倍自重）、末端速度20.6 m/s、可重复锤击作业，热性能超越人类负载-时长边界。
AI.motivation: 传统机械臂设计追求全工作空间内性能均匀，导致在各具体任务上均非最优；作者希望摆脱"均匀能力"范式，直接以公开的人体上肢任务相关性能测量（力、速度、耐久）为设计输入，缩小人形机器人与人类能力差距。
AI.method: 从人体上肢性能数据导出力、速度与续航目标；据此进行执行器、机构与热设计，强调扭矩透明性与持续运行能力。整机由力导向的upper-arm模块、速度导向的前臂模块，以及随姿态改变扭矩-速度特性的肘部机构组成，采用行星齿轮执行器与紧凑的嵌入式驱动电子。实验包含负载测试、末端速度测试、重复锤击冲击试验与热分析（与人类负载-时长边界对比）。
AI.result: 峰值负载20 kg（自重2.25倍）；末端速度20.6 m/s；重复锤击冲击下可持续工作；热分析显示在几乎整个负载谱上，持续运行能力超过文献中人类负载-时长边界。
AI.conclusion: 以人类任务测量导出的硬件指标，可使单一平台同时覆盖重载与高动态任务，从而收窄人类与人形机器人之间的能力差距；验证了"任务导向而非均匀工作空间"的硬件设计范式在宽域任务中的有效性。

title: Mitigating Spatial Blindness in Multiple Instance Learning for Whole-Slide Image Analysis
summary: Whole-slide multiple instance learning can predict diagnostic and prognostic labels from tissue composition while making limited use of spatial organization. Providing coordinates or a graph does not establish that a trained predictor uses tissue neighborhoods. We examine this gap as spatial blindness and hypothesize that early composition learning can weaken supervision of a spatial pathway. We introduce ResTopoMIL, which freezes a learned composition predictor before training a graph residual with a coordinate-reassignment separation loss. Permutation and information analyses distinguish architectural symmetry, available spatial information and the proposed optimization mechanism. On a controlled spatial task, staged training achieved an AUC of 0.987, compared with 0.684 for the same jointly trained architecture. Performance remained high on a composition-only task. Across four WSI classification and five survival benchmarks, ResTopoMIL improved mean primary performance on eight tasks; four improvements remained significant after Holm-adjusted patient-cluster tests. Coordinate-free residual controls recovered some of the gains, while neighborhood destruction reduced performance close to the composition anchor. Neighborhood-preserving transformations and anatomy-stratified perturbations further characterized this dependence. These results support fixing a composition reference as a practical intervention for learning spatial corrections, while retaining additional appearance capacity as a contributing explanation.

AI.tldr: 提出ResTopoMIL：先冻结已学好的"组分预测器"，再以坐标重指派分离损失训练图残差分支，以缓解全切片MIL中的"空间盲"问题。
AI.motivation: 提供坐标或图结构并不保证训练好的预测器真正利用了组织邻域信息；早期组分学习可能削弱空间通路的监督信号（空间盲/spatial blindness）。
AI.method: 分段训练：冻结composition predictor作为锚点，在其残差上训练图网络；引入坐标重指派分离损失（coordinate-reassignment separation loss）；用置换分析与信息分析区分架构对称性、可用空间信息与优化机制；并做无坐标残差、邻域破坏、保持邻域变换与解剖分层扰动等对照。
AI.result: 受控空间任务AUC 0.987 vs 同一架构联合训练0.684；纯组分任务性能保持；4个WSI分类+5个生存分析基准中8个任务平均主指标提升，4项经Holm校正的患者簇检验仍显著；邻域破坏后退化至接近组分锚点。
AI.conclusion: 将固定的组分参考作为可操作干预，有助于学习空间修正；但外观容量的额外贡献仍是合理解释之一。

title: ReSMap: Recasting Satellite Priors for Robust and Accurate Online HD Map Construction
comment: Accepted to NeurIPS 2026. 24 pages, 9 figures, 11 tables. Project page: this https URL Code: this https URL
summary: Despite recent advances in camera-based online HD map construction, these systems remain susceptible to sensor failures due to their reliance on onboard cameras. In contrast, satellite images remain available independently of real-time sensing conditions as they are cached offline. Existing methods utilizing satellite images, however, primarily leverage them under nominal conditions, without explicitly addressing them as redundancy when a sensor degrades. To address this gap, we propose ReSMap, a redundancy-aware camera-satellite fusion framework for robust online HD map construction. Our framework explicitly leverages satellite images as a complementary source to improve robustness against camera failures. A Predict-then-Fuse (PTF) module fuses camera and satellite BEV features by using each branch's own prediction confidence as a per-pixel reliability weight, with no learned router. An Object-Centric Cooperative Multi-modal Query (OCMQ) decoder then extends this per-modality separation to the query level: each modality cross-attends only to its own BEV, and per-modality updates are merged through a learned per-token gate. Our model achieves state-of-the-art performance on nuScenes across all splits and range settings. More importantly, it also sets the new state-of-the-art under camera-failure scenarios, demonstrating that satellite images serve not only as a strong prior but as practical redundancy for robust online HD mapping.

AI.tldr: ReSMap：以卫星影像作为冗余源的相机-卫星BEV融合框架，用于鲁棒的在线HD地图构建。
AI.motivation: 纯视觉在线HD地图依赖车载相机，传感器退化时易失效；卫星影像可离线缓存、不依赖实时感知，但既有方法仅在正常工况下使用，未将其显式作为冗余源。
AI.method: Predict-then-Fuse (PTF) 模块以各分支自身预测置信度作为逐像素可靠性权重融合相机与卫星BEV特征（无学习式router）；Object-Centric Cooperative Multi-modal Query (OCMQ) 解码器将模态分离扩展到query层，各模态仅对自身BEV做cross-attention，并通过学习式per-token门控合并各模态更新。
AI.result: 在nuScenes全部split与range设置上达到SOTA；在相机失效场景下亦刷新SOTA，表明卫星影像不仅是有力先验，也是实用冗余。
AI.conclusion: 显式冗余感知的多模态融合可显著提升相机失效下的在线HD地图鲁棒性，卫星影像可作为离线冗余源实际部署。

title: EndoS3:Endoscopic Semantic Splatting SLAM
summary: Purpose: Despite advances in 3D surgical scene understanding, semantic simultaneous localisation and mapping (SLAM) remains under-explored for two key reasons. First, it requires solving three challenging tasks in parallel: camera pose tracking, high-fidelity deformable reconstruction, and semantic mapping, making progress particularly demanding. Second, the scarcity of datasets providing the necessary ground truth to evaluate all three tasks comprehensively under conditions that closely reflect real surgical procedures environments. Method: We propose EndoS3, a Gaussian Splatting-based semantic SLAM framework that uses instance masks to guide all three tasks. An instance-level motion decomposition module separates static and dynamic instances by evaluating residual flow after compensating for camera motion, accounting for flow noise and comparing motion across neighbouring instances. The camera is tracked against the static Gaussians, while an instance-aware warp field gives each dynamic instance its own control nodes and deformation network. A semantic node allocation module redistributes a fixed node budget across instances according to their size and non-rigidity. We also introduce CRCD++, an ex-vivo Cholecystectomy dataset with RGB-D frames, camera pose and instance annotations for full semantic SLAM evaluation. Results: EndoS3 surpasses all state-of-the-art general-purpose and surgical semantic SLAM methods in tracking, reconstruction and semantic mapping on the CRCD++ and SemSup datasets. Conclusion: Semantic-aware motion and deformation modelling is vital to surgical semantic SLAM. EndoS3 and CRCD++ offer a method and benchmark for improved geometric and semantic understanding in endoscopy.

AI.tldr: EndoS3：以实例掩码统一驱动跟踪、变形重建与语义建图的Gaussian Splatting语义SLAM框架，并提出CRCD++离体胆囊切除数据集。
AI.motivation: 内窥镜手术场景的语义SLAM面临两大障碍：需并行求解位姿跟踪、高保真可变形重建与语义建图三任务；且缺乏同时覆盖三者真值的、贴近真实术式的数据集。
AI.method: 以实例掩码贯穿三项任务：实例级运动分解模块通过补偿相机运动后的残差流，并考虑流噪声与邻域实例运动比较，分离静态/动态实例；相机仅对静态高斯进行跟踪；实例感知warp场为每个动态实例分配独立控制节点与变形网络；语义节点分配模块按实例尺寸与非刚性程度在固定节点预算内再分配。
AI.result: 在CRCD++与SemSup数据集上，跟踪、重建、语义建图三项指标均超越现有通用及手术专用语义SLAM方法。
AI.conclusion: 语义感知的运动与变形建模是手术语义SLAM的关键；EndoS3与CRCD++为内窥镜几何与语义理解提供方法与基准。

title: RAFT: Reasoning-Aligned Fine-Tuning Improves Robustness of VLA Post-Training
summary: Adapting a generalist vision-language-action (VLA) policy to a target task with limited demonstrations can improve nominal task success while reducing robustness to variations in appearance, objects, and instructions. We introduce reasoning-aligned fine-tuning (RAFT), a two-stage post-training procedure: RAFT first trains low-rank adapters on task-relevant reasoning annotations, then freezes them while fine-tuning the policy on action demonstrations. On a physical DROID robot, RAFT achieves $75.0\%$ out-of-distribution success, compared with $27.9\%$ for plain fine-tuning; on a multi-stage bimanual YAM task, it reaches $70.0\%$ mean success, compared with $36.0\%$ for the strongest baseline. RAFT also improves success under visual, object, and instruction shifts in simulated pick-and-place and open-drawer tasks. Compared with plain fine-tuning, RAFT policies place more attention on annotated task regions and yield higher linear-probe accuracy for object identity in later layers. A broader reasoning-data mixture further improves downstream success across demonstration budgets.

AI.tldr: RAFT：两阶段后训练——先在任务相关推理标注上训练低秩适配器并冻结，再微调动作策略，从而在少量示范下保持VLA的OOD鲁棒性。
AI.motivation: 通用VLA策略在少量示范上微调可提升名义任务成功率，却会损害对外观、物体与指令变化的鲁棒性（过拟合到窄分布）。
AI.method: 两阶段后训练：阶段一在任务相关推理标注上训练低秩适配器（LoRA）；阶段二冻结这些适配器，仅在动作示范上微调策略，实现"推理对齐+动作适配"解耦。
AI.result: 物理DROID机器人上OOD成功率75.0% vs 朴素微调27.9%；双臂YAM多阶段任务平均成功率70.0% vs 最强基线36.0%；仿真抓取放置与开抽屉在视觉/物体/指令偏移下均提升；注意力更集中于标注任务区域，后层物体身份线性探针准确率更高；更广泛的推理数据混合可跨示范预算继续提升。
AI.conclusion: 将推理对齐与动作微调解耦是缓解VLA微调后OOD退化的一种轻量有效后训练范式，且具备可扩展性（数据混合、示范预算）。

title: IGSW: Multi-Weather Urban Scene Reconstruction with Intrinsic-Decoupled Gaussian Splatting
summary: High-fidelity weather editing of 4D scenes can support end-to-end training and closed-loop simulation for autonomous driving. Combining generative image editing with dynamic Gaussian representations enables multi-weather scene reconstruction, but weather-edited images often contain structural distortions. Directly fitting their appearance may propagate errors from teacher images into the reconstructed 4D scene, compromising the original scene structure and temporal continuity. To address these challenges, we propose IGSW, a two-stage framework that combines intrinsic-decoupled 4D Gaussian scene modeling with structure-preserving weather refinement. In Stage I, background Gaussian appearance is decomposed into weather-shared albedo and normals and weather-specific irradiance and residuals. Weather teacher images generated by a diffusion-based image editing model and intrinsic maps estimated by a diffusion-based inverse renderer provide feature-level soft supervision for stable structure and illumination changes. In Stage II, a structure-preservation gate combines semantic conflicts with cross-weather intrinsic discrepancies to suppress unreliable teacher regions. Per-Gaussian weather transport variables and target-weather branches then strengthen the desired weather appearance over the intrinsic-decoupled scene. Experiments on nuScenes and Waymo show that IGSW achieves the highest content similarity and semantic consistency and the lowest temporal error among the compared methods, while retaining pronounced weather-dependent illumination and atmosphere. The project page is available at this https URL .

AI.tldr: IGSW：两阶段框架，将4D高斯场景分解为天气共享的本征量（albedo、法线）与天气相关量（辐照度、残差），并用结构保持门控筛选扩散教师图的不可靠区域，实现高保真天气编辑的4D场景重建。
AI.motivation: 用于自动驾驶端到端训练与闭环仿真的4D场景天气编辑：扩散图像编辑得到的天气图存在结构失真，直接拟合会把教师图像的误差传播进4D场景，破坏原始几何结构与时序连续性。
AI.method: Stage I：背景高斯外观解耦为天气共享的albedo与法线、天气特定的辐照度与残差；由扩散图像编辑模型生成天气教师图、扩散逆渲染器估计本征图，提供特征级软监督以稳定结构与光照变化。Stage II：结构保持门控结合语义冲突与跨天气本征差异抑制不可靠教师区域，再用逐高斯天气传输变量与目标天气分支强化期望外观。
AI.result: 在nuScenes与Waymo上，相比对比方法取得最高内容相似度与语义一致性、最低时序误差，同时保留明显的天气相关光照与大气效果。
AI.conclusion: 本征解耦加门控式教师监督可有效抑制扩散编辑失真向4D场景的传播，为自动驾驶提供可控天气的多天气4D高斯重建与仿真数据源。

title: Understanding Backdoor Attacks in Scene Graph Generation via Global Context Pathway
comment: Accepted by the 34th ACM International Conference on Multimedia (ACM MM 2026)
summary: Scene Graph Generation (SGG) produces structured scene representations, yet its training-time backdoor risk remains unexplored. Unlike classification, SGG exposes a pair-level attack surface that enables selective corruption of relations involving a designated object category. However, because SGG largely relies on localized evidence, globally placed triggers may face difficulty in manipulating such predictions. Recent SGG architectures increasingly incorporate global context to improve scene modeling, which may in turn facilitate such attacks.
