title: Multi-Path Mamba Diffusion for 3D Point Cloud Semantic Scene Completion
comment: Accepted by ICIPW 2025
summary: 3D semantic scene completion plays a critical role in enabling various downstream tasks within autonomous systems by estimating both missing geometric structures and semantic information in scene data. In this work, we introduce a unique neural framework that integrates state space modeling with diffusion-based generative approaches to enhance 3D point cloud semantic scene completion. We propose \textit{MPath Mamba} diffusion network, leveraging a skip-triple Mamba structure, dimensional decomposition residuals, and multi-directional dilations within multi-path data to efficiently process long-sequence data for feature extraction. The proposed method operates in the conditioned latent space of a variational autoencoder, enhanced by a state-space mechanism to improve 3D point cloud representation and reconstruction. Extensive experiments conducted on the SemanticKITTI benchmark demonstrate that our approach achieves highly competitive performance for 3D point cloud semantic scene completion.

AI.tldr: 提出 MPath Mamba 扩散网络，将状态空间建模与扩散生成结合，在 VAE 条件潜空间中完成 3D 点云语义场景补全，并在 SemanticKITTI 上取得有竞争力的结果。
AI.motivation: 3D 语义场景补全需同时推断缺失几何结构与语义标签，长序列点云特征提取效率与重建精度仍不足；作者希望借助状态空间模型的长程建模能力与扩散生成先验来改进补全质量。
AI.method: 构建 MPath Mamba 扩散网络：采用 skip-triple Mamba 结构、维度分解残差、多路径数据内的多方向膨胀卷积；在变分自编码器（VAE）的条件潜空间中执行扩散，并以状态空间机制增强 3D 点云表示与重建。
AI.result: 在 SemanticKITTI 语义场景补全基准上取得高度竞争的补全性能（摘要仅作定性表述，未给出具体指标与消融数据）。
AI.conclusion: 状态空间模型与扩散生成在潜空间中的结合是点云语义场景补全的有效路线，可作为自动驾驶感知下游任务的表示基础。

title: SparseGraph-I2P: Consistency-Guided Hypothesis Selection for Efficient Image-to-Point-Cloud Registration
comment: 20 pages
summary: Coarse-to-fine image-to-point-cloud (I2P) registration risks discarding correct but ambiguous patch pairs, while retaining more candidates repeats fine matching over overlapping patches. SparseGraph-I2P aims to improve registration recall by increasing the inlier ratio at the pose solver, using sensor or monocular depth. A Coarse Hypothesis Graph combines appearance with depth-derived first- and second-order compatibility to select a fixed budget of patch pairs. Sparse Fine Matching decodes each queried pixel once and skips pixel--point comparisons covered by an ancestor patch paired with the same point-cloud region. With sensor depth, depth-aware filtering ranks correspondences by SC2 spectral support for a single EPnP solve. With monocular depth, depth or inverse depth is calibrated from correspondence geometry before filtering. SparseGraph-I2P achieves the highest registration recall and lowest latency among the compared methods on RGB-D Scenes V2 and 7-Scenes with sensor depth. With predicted depth, it retains the highest recall on RGB-D Scenes V2 at an additional calibration cost. Code will be released.

AI.tldr: SparseGraph-I2P通过粗假设图（结合深度的一阶/二阶相容性）筛选固定预算的patch对，并采用稀疏细匹配只解码被查询像素，提升I2P配准内点率与召回、降低延迟。
AI.motivation: 粗到细I2P配准中，粗匹配会丢弃正确但有歧义的patch对；若保留更多候选，又会在重叠patch上重复精匹配，效率低。作者希望提升位姿求解器的内点比率以提高配准召回率。
AI.method: 1) Coarse Hypothesis Graph：融合外观与由传感器/单目深度导出的一阶、二阶相容性，选出固定预算的patch对；2) Sparse Fine Matching：每个查询像素只解码一次，并跳过已被祖先patch与同一点云区域配对覆盖的像素—点比较；3) 传感器深度下用SC2谱支撑度对对应关系排序，做单次EPnP求解；4) 单目深度下先由对应几何标定深度或逆深度再过滤。
AI.result: 在RGB-D Scenes V2与7-Scenes上有传感器深度时，取得对比方法中最高的配准召回率和最低延迟；使用预测深度时在RGB-D Scenes V2上保持最高召回，但增加标定开销。代码将开源。
AI.conclusion: 以图结构化的粗假设选择加稀疏细匹配，可在不增加精匹配重复计算的前提下提高内点比率，同时兼容传感器深度与单目预测深度，兼顾精度与实时性。

title: Sparse-View 3D Coronary Reconstruction from Vessel Segmentations Using a Diffusion Prior
comment: 10 pages, 5 figures, 2 tables
summary: Reconstructing three-dimensional (3D) coronary anatomy from sparse angiographic views could support percutaneous coronary intervention, but limited angular coverage and imperfect vessel segmentations introduce substantial geometric ambiguity. We propose a vessel-specific reconstruction framework combining a learned 3D diffusion prior, visual-hull initialization, and projection-based data consistency. The unconditional diffusion model is trained on coronary vessel masks without paired 2D--3D data and reused across different view counts without retraining. During inference, a scaled visual hull initializes reconstruction, while projection-based updates constrain diffusion refinement using patient-specific vessel observations. We evaluated the framework on simulated angiograms derived from ImageCAS computed tomography angiography volumes using two, four, and eight views at two contrast levels. Across 50 evaluation coronary-tree cases, the proposed method achieved higher mean Dice and clDice than visual hull, deep image prior (DIP), and hash-grid implicit neural representation (INR) at all view counts under reduced contrast. With eight views, improvements over DIP, the best-performing baseline at lower contrast, were approximately 0.13 in Dice and 0.22 in clDice. At higher contrast, performance remained competitive with hash-grid INR, the best-performing eight-view baseline. The preferred diffusion starting timestep depended on observation quality and view count, with excessive refinement reducing accuracy at higher contrast. Projection guidance improved both metrics across all conditions. Averaging stochastic reconstructions further improved accuracy, while sample disagreement localized errors with average-precision gains of 0.14--0.21 over error prevalence. These findings support diffusion-prior reconstruction from sparse vessel observations, although clinical validation remains necessary.

AI.tldr: 提出基于无条件3D扩散先验+视觉外壳初始化+投影数据一致性的血管特异性冠脉3D重建框架，适配稀疏视角且无需成对2D-3D数据。
AI.motivation: 稀疏冠脉造影视角下角度覆盖有限、血管分割不完美，导致3D几何高度歧义，需在无成对监督数据条件下实现可用重建以辅助PCI。
AI.method: 在冠脉血管掩码上训练无条件扩散模型作为3D形状先验；推理时用缩放视觉外壳（scaled visual hull）初始化，再通过基于投影的数据一致性更新约束扩散精化；同一模型跨2/4/8视角复用不重训。评估于ImageCAS CTA衍生的模拟造影，两档对比度，50例冠脉树，对比visual hull、DIP、hash-grid INR。
AI.result: 低对比度下所有视角数的均值Dice与clDice均优于基线；8视角相对最佳基线DIP提升约0.13 Dice、0.22 clDice。高对比度下与hash-grid INR竞争力相当。扩散起始时间步需随观测质量与视角数调整，过度精化会降低高对比度精度；投影引导在所有条件下均有增益；对随机重建取平均可进一步提升精度，样本分歧可定位误差（AP较错误率提升0.14–0.21）。
AI.conclusion: 扩散先验可在稀疏血管观测下实现有效3D重建，但仅限模拟数据，尚需临床验证。

title: Gradient-Guided Orientation Learning for Weakly Supervised Oriented Object Detection
comment: Accepted to WACV 2027. 10 pages, 4 figures, 7 tables
summary: Weakly supervised oriented object detection (WS-OOD) aims to reduce the annotation cost of rotated bounding boxes by leveraging cheaper annotations such as horizontal boxes or points. However, these weak annotations provide no explicit orientation information, forcing existing methods to infer object angles through indirect geometric consistency or equivariant constraints. Such indirect supervision often becomes ambiguous and unstable under real-world appearance variations, including illumination changes, color shifts, shadows, and background clutter. In this paper, we present a simple yet effective gradient-guided orientation learning strategy for WS-OOD. Motivated by the observation that the input image itself contains useful orientation priors, our method extracts dominant gradient-based orientation cues from object regions and converts them into pseudo-angle labels for auxiliary supervision, enabling the detector to learn orientation-aware representations without requiring rotated bounding box annotations or extra learnable parameters. Furthermore, since AP can mask substantial angular errors when spatial IoU remains high, we introduce an orientation-aware evaluation metric that incorporates angular discrepancies into the standard AP protocol. Extensive experiments on weakly supervised oriented detection benchmarks demonstrate that the proposed pseudo-angle supervision improves both detection performance and orientation estimation quality, while the proposed metric provides a more faithful assessment of angle prediction than conventional AP alone.

AI.tldr: 提出梯度引导的弱监督旋转目标检测(WS-OOD)方向学习策略：利用目标区域的主梯度方向生成伪角度标签做辅助监督，并提出融合角度误差的方向感知评估指标(Oriented AP)，在弱监督旋转检测基准上同时提升检测与角度估计精度。
AI.motivation: 弱监督旋转检测仅用水平框或点标注，缺少显式方向信息，现有方法依赖间接几何一致性或等变约束推断角度，在光照变化、色偏、阴影和背景杂乱等外观变化下监督信号模糊且不稳定；同时标准AP在空间IoU仍高时会掩盖较大的角度误差，评估不可靠。
AI.method: 1) 从输入图像目标区域提取主梯度方向线索（基于图像自身的方向先验），转化为伪角度标签，作为辅助监督训练检测器；2) 无需旋转框标注、不引入额外可学习参数，即可获得方向感知表示；3) 提出将角度差异并入标准AP协议的方向感知评估指标。
AI.result: 在弱监督旋转检测基准上的实验表明，伪角度监督同时提升了检测性能与方向估计质量；新指标比传统AP更能忠实反映角度预测精度。
AI.conclusion: 图像自身梯度即为廉价而有效的方向先验，可作为无需额外参数的辅助监督弥补弱标注的角度信息缺失；现有AP须辅以角度敏感指标才能真实评价弱监督旋转检测。

title: Polyp Matching Using Deep Learning
summary: A key challenge in colon capsule endoscopy (CCE) analysis is accurately identifying whether multiple images depict the same polyp, which is critical to avoid over-counting and unnecessary clinical interventions. Additionally, this prevents prolonged follow-up colonoscopies where endoscopists search for duplicate polyps without precise localization. This study presents a novel contrastive learning-based approach to polyp matching using a Siamese neural network architecture. The model was trained on a dataset from the Danish CareForColon2015 trial. The dataset comprises 5,103 image pairs of confirmed same polyp and 5,103 pairs of different polyps, annotated by experienced clinicians. The proposed model employs ResNet variants (ResNet18, ResNet34, ResNet50), DenseNet121 and EfficientNet B0/B3 as backbones and utilizes contrastive learning with cosine vector distance metric for classification. Experimental results demonstrate high classification accuracies of up to 92% and AUC values close to 0.98. These results suggest that automated polyp matching has the potential to reduce polyp over-counting, improve patient risk stratification, and reduce unnecessary follow-up colonoscopies.

AI.tldr: 基于孪生网络与对比学习的结肠胶囊内镜息肉配准方法，用ResNet/DenseNet/EfficientNet骨干+余弦距离，在CareForColon2015的10,206对标注图像上达到最高92%准确率、AUC≈0.98。
AI.motivation: 结肠胶囊内镜（CCE）中需判断多张图像是否为同一息肉，以避免重复计数、过度临床干预，以及因缺乏精确定位而导致的冗长随访结肠镜检查。
AI.method: 构建息肉配对数据集（同一息肉5,103对、不同息肉5,103对，由经验丰富临床医生标注）；采用孪生神经网络，骨干为ResNet18/34/50、DenseNet121、EfficientNet-B0/B3；使用对比学习训练，以余弦向量距离作为度量进行分类。
AI.result: 分类准确率最高约92%，AUC接近0.98，多骨干对比中表现稳定良好（摘要未给出各骨干具体数值与消融）。
AI.conclusion: 自动化息肉配准有望减少息肉重复计数、改善患者风险分层并减少不必要的随访结肠镜检查；属医学影像领域的相似度匹配应用，方法本身为常规孪生+对比学习组合，缺少方法学新意补充。

title: MambaHand: Local Identity and Behavioral Sequence Learning with Mamba for Dynamic Hand Gesture Authentication
summary: Dynamic hand gesture authentication (DHGA) is an emerging biometric technique that contains both physiological and behavioral identity characteristics. However, existing methods primarily rely on convolutional networks or manually designed motion representations, making it difficult to jointly capture fine-grained local identity differences and long-range behavioral dependencies during hand gesture execution. To address these challenges, we propose a two-stream identity representation learning framework, MambaHand Net, to combine CNNs with Mamba for DHGA. The proposed framework consists of a Local Identity Stream (LIS) and a Behavioral Sequential Stream (BSS). The LIS extracts frame-wise local identity cues with a convolutional network, while the BSS preserves spatial tokens from intermediate visual features and constructs first-order and second-order temporal difference sequences to model multi-order behavioral variations. Moreover, the bidirectional Mamba is incorporated into the BSS to model semantic motion across different spatial locations, enabling efficient long-range modeling of hand gesture execution habits. Finally, attention-guided spatial token aggregation and a two-stream fusion strategy are used to integrate local identity cues and multi-order behavioral patterns into a discriminative identity representation. Our method achieves state-of-the-art (SOTA) average performance on the SCUT-DHGA benchmark dataset, demonstrating that combining CNNs with Mamba is an effective new solution for DHGA.

AI.tldr: MambaHand Net 提出双流框架（CNN 局部身份流 + 双向 Mamba 行为序列流）用于动态手势认证，在 SCUT-DHGA 上取得 SOTA 平均性能。
AI.motivation: 现有 DHGA 方法依赖卷积网络或手工运动表征，难以同时刻画细粒度局部身份差异与手势执行过程中的长程行为依赖。
AI.method: Local Identity Stream 用 CNN 提取逐帧局部身份线索；Behavioral Sequential Stream 保留中间特征的 spatial tokens，构造一阶与二阶时序差分序列建模多阶行为变化，并引入双向 Mamba 在空间位置上建模语义运动以高效长程建模；最后用注意力引导的 spatial token 聚合与双流融合策略得到判别性身份表征。
AI.result: 在 SCUT-DHGA 基准上取得 SOTA 平均性能，验证 CNN 与 Mamba 结合是 DHGA 的有效新方案。
AI.conclusion: CNN 局部表征与 Mamba 长程时序建模的互补融合可有效提升动态手势生物特征认证性能。

title: ReXMo: End-to-End Video Character Replacement with Expression and Motion Preservation
comment: Preprint
summary: Video character replacement aims to replace actors while preserving facial expressions, motions, and scene dynamics. Existing methods typically rely on masked generation with pose guidance, limiting fine-grained expression and motion preservation in complex scenes. We propose ReXMo, an end-to-end framework that supports single-, multi-, and selective character replacement scenarios. ReXMo introduces paired triplet supervision, where synthesized driving videos and original videos share identical performances but different identities, enabling scalable training through synthetic data generation. An In-Context Diffusion Transformer learns identity transformation by jointly conditioning on driving videos, reference identities, and text prompts, while an Expression Enhancement Adapter improves facial expression preservation in multi-person scenes. Extensive experiments demonstrate that ReXMo outperforms existing methods in identity fidelity, motion consistency, expression preservation, and visual quality. Our dataset and code will be publicly released.

AI.tldr: ReXMo：端到端视频角色替换框架，通过配对三元组监督与In-Context Diffusion Transformer，支持单/多/选择性角色替换并保持表情与运动。
AI.motivation: 现有视频角色替换依赖掩码生成+姿态引导，在复杂场景中难以细粒度保留面部表情与运动；且缺乏可扩展的成对身份训练数据。
AI.method: 提出ReXMo端到端框架；构造合成驱动视频与原始视频"同表演、异身份"的配对三元组监督，实现可扩展合成数据训练；用In-Context Diffusion Transformer联合以驱动视频、参考身份与文本提示为条件学习身份变换；并加入Expression Enhancement Adapter改善多人场景表情保持。
AI.result: 在身份保真度、运动一致性、表情保持与视觉质量上均优于现有方法（摘要未给具体指标）。
AI.conclusion: 以配对三元组数据与上下文扩散Transformer替代掩码生成范式，是视频角色替换的有效路线；数据集与代码将开源。

title: Therapy-FIS: A Dataset for Assessing Facilitative Interpersonal Skills in Psychotherapeutic Setting
summary: Facilitative Interpersonal Skills (FIS) is a performance-based assessment method that provides a structured framework for evaluating the interpersonal competencies of mental health professionals. However, existing FIS assessment relies heavily on human observer ratings, making the evaluation process labor-intensive, costly, and difficult to scale. Progress toward automated FIS assessment has also been constrained by the lack of publicly available professional data in psychotherapy settings. To address this limitation, we introduce Therapy-FIS, a dataset for automated FIS assessment in standardized psychotherapy tasks. To our knowledge, Therapy-FIS is the first publicly available dataset in this domain. It contains facial, acoustic, and textual signals derived from standardized therapist responses to standardized mock patient stimulus clips, based on 890 therapist video recordings and 8 patient videos, and is rated with eight FIS subscale ratings and an overall FIS score. Built on Therapy-FIS, we further establish a benchmark with two downstream tasks: Therapist Performance Rating and Joint Therapist--mock-Patient Performance Rating. We also introduce a competitive baseline, DyadicFIS, with gated fusion and routed readout under therapist-only and dyadic settings. DyadicFIS obtains the best macro CCC(Concordance Correlation Coefficient) scores on both tasks (0.2807 and 0.3299). Therapy-FIS offers a reproducible resource for data-driven automated assessment of therapeutic interpersonal skills in mental health.

AI.tldr: Therapy-FIS：首个公开的心理治疗标准化任务FIS（促进性人际技能）自动评估数据集，含890段治疗师视频与8段模拟来访者视频的面部、声学、文本信号及8个子量表+总分标注，并给出双任务基准与DyadicFIS融合基线（macro CCC 0.2807/0.3299）。
AI.motivation: 现有FIS评估依赖人工观察者打分，耗费人力、成本高、难以规模化；自动化FIS研究又受限于心理治疗场景缺乏公开专业数据。
AI.method: 构建Therapy-FIS数据集：采集标准化治疗师对标准化模拟来访者刺激片段的响应视频，提取面部、声学、文本多模态信号，标注8个FIS子量表分与总体FIS分；建立两个下游任务（治疗师表现评分、治疗师—模拟来访者联合表现评分）；提出DyadicFIS基线，采用门控融合与路由读出（routed readout），支持仅治疗师与双人（dyadic）两种设置。
AI.result: DyadicFIS在两个任务上取得最佳macro CCC，分别为0.2807与0.3299；数据集为领域首个公开资源，具备可复现性。
AI.conclusion: Therapy-FIS为心理健康领域治疗性人际技能的自动化数据驱动评估提供了可复现资源与基准，但绝对性能仍偏低，自动化FIS评估尚有较大提升空间。

title: BhopalMLS: A LiDAR Dataset for Semantic Scene Understanding in Heterogeneous Urban Environments
comment: Accepted at WACV 2027 (Evaluations and Datasets Track). 37 pages: main paper, references and supplementary material. Project page: this https URL
summary: We introduce BhopalMLS, a large-scale Mobile Laser Scanning (MLS) dataset from a dense, heterogeneous urban environment in Bhopal, India, with mixed traffic, informal structures, and narrow unplanned streets. It spans approximately 10 km of road corridors with over 1.2 billion points and 19,518 annotated instances across 62 fine-grained static categories, grouped into 12-class and 21-class benchmark taxonomies; 6 optional moving-class subclasses support dynamic-object analysis. Existing 3D datasets, collected in well-planned cities, are structurally more uniform than such unplanned settings, and lack their subtype diversity. On semantic and instance segmentation at both granularities, fine-tuned foundation models surpass supervised baselines: Utonia(L) reaches 71.28% mIoU (vs. PTv3's 68.04% from scratch) and 44.07% mAP50 on the 12-class benchmark. Cross-region experiments against four established datasets (Ke-MLS, Toronto-3D, Paris-Lille-3D, SemanticKITTI) reveal a consistent asymmetric transferability: models trained on BhopalMLS transfer better than the reverse on every pair, for both Utonia(L) and Concerto(L) (mean 21.5, up to 36 mIoU points), holding even when the target is denser. Factor-controlled retraining at a fixed label budget, repeated on both models, attributes this to the coverage of BhopalMLS's subtype inventory rather than to dataset size or corridor geometry: collapsing each class to a single subtype costs 13.0 and 13.3 mIoU points for Utonia(L) and Concerto(L). BhopalMLS therefore offers a testbed for 3D perception beyond well-planned cities. Data and an interactive viewer are at this https URL .

AI.tldr: 发布印度Bhopal大规模城市MLS数据集BhopalMLS（约10km道路、12亿点、62类细粒度标注、19518实例），并揭示其细粒度子类覆盖带来的非对称跨域迁移优势。
AI.motivation: 现有3D点云数据集多采集于规划良好的城市，结构均质、子类型多样性不足，无法代表非规划、高异质（混合交通、非正规建筑、狭窄街巷）的城市场景，缺乏面向此类环境的3D感知基准。
AI.method: 构建Mobile Laser Scanning数据集：约10 km走廊、>1.2B点、19,518个标注实例、62个细粒度静态类别，并映射为12类和21类基准分类体系，另设6个可选运动目标子类；在语义/实例分割两个粒度上评测微调基础模型（Utonia、Concerto）与从头训练的监督基线（PTv3等），并进行跨4个数据集（Ke-MLS、Toronto-3D、Paris-Lille-3D、SemanticKITTI）的双向迁移实验与固定标签预算下的子类折叠消融。
AI.result: Utonia(L)在12类基准上达71.28% mIoU（全程训练的PTv3为68.04%）与44.07% mAP50；跨区域迁移呈一致非对称性：BhopalMLS训练模型迁移到其他数据集优于反向，平均高21.5、最高36 mIoU（目标更密集时亦成立）；控制标签预算的子类折叠实验使Utonia(L)/Concerto(L)分别下降13.0与13.3 mIoU，说明增益源于子类型覆盖而非数据规模或走廊几何。
AI.conclusion: BhopalMLS可作为超越规划城市的3D感知测试平台，其细粒度子类型多样性是提升跨域泛化的关键因素；数据与交互式查看器已公开。

title: Phase-DGS: Phase-guided Dynamic Gaussian Splatting from Unsynchronized Multi-view Video
comment: Accepted to NeurIPS 2026. Project page: this https URL
summary: Spatiotemporal scene reconstruction with Dynamic Gaussian Splatting (DGS) fundamentally depends on perfect temporal synchronization across all cameras, an assumption rarely achievable in practice. Industry-standard synchronization requires expensive specialized hardware and complex setup, while data-driven alternatives including audio-based alignment, geometry matching, and pose tracking remain limited by restrictive environmental or scene-specific assumptions. To overcome these limitations, we propose Phase-DGS, a framework that replaces conventional timestamps with a semantic phase representing each frame's inherent state within the underlying motion cycle. Frames capturing the same motion state share the same phase regardless of which camera records them or when, naturally establishing spatiotemporal correspondence across unsynchronized cameras. We validate Phase-DGS under temporal offsets, frame drops, and camera freezes, achieving up to +8.5 dB PSNR improvement over baselines while enabling seamless integration with existing DGS backbones including RealTime-4DGS and FreeTimeGS.

AI.tldr: 提出 Phase-DGS，用"语义相位"替代时间戳，为每帧在运动周期内分配内在状态，实现非同步多相机动态高斯泼溅重建。
AI.motivation: 动态 Gaussian Splatting（DGS）重建隐含要求多相机严格时间同步，实际难以满足；硬件同步昂贵，音频对齐、几何匹配、位姿跟踪等数据驱动方案受环境或场景假设限制。
AI.method: 以表征帧在底层运动周期中的语义相位取代传统时间戳；相同运动状态的帧共享同一相位，与拍摄相机和时间无关，从而天然建立非同步相机间的时空对应，可无缝接入 RealTime-4DGS、FreeTimeGS 等现有 DGS 骨干。
AI.result: 在时间偏移、丢帧、相机冻结三种失同步情形下验证，相较基线最高提升 +8.5 dB PSNR。
AI.conclusion: 相位化时间表示可作为鲁棒替代时间戳的方案，提升非同步动态重建实用性与对现有 4DGS 框架的兼容性。

title: Just Between Us? Exploring a Wearable-Mediated Channel for Discreet Human-Agent Interaction in a Shared Game Setting
comment: Accepted in 25th International Conference on Mobile and Ubiquitous Multimedia (MUM) 2026
summary: In shared settings, social robots may need to exchange information with an individual while limiting co-present others' access to or interpretation of that information. Publicly observable speech and gestures may not adequately support such exchanges. We investigate a wearable-mediated channel for discreet interaction that combines in-ear audio messages with deliberate rightward head tilts as responses. To examine its feasibility and participants' experiences, we studied 20 pairs (40 participants) playing a card game with a screen-based conversational agent representing a social robot, controlled by a researcher in a Wizard-of-Oz setup. Each pair played with and without the channel. One participant wore the device (the wearer), while the other (the non-wearer) was informed about the channel after gameplay. The channel conveyed information that could help the wearer or robot character select an opponent they could defeat. The information exchange and subsequent opponent selection occurred as intended in 39 of 40 channel-mediated turns. Wearers reported low perceived pressure/tension in both conditions, with no statistically significant difference between conditions, and favorable usability immediately after use. Retrospective interviews, however, revealed varied accounts of noticing the interaction among non-wearers and contrasting perceptions of teamwork and unfairness. These findings support the feasibility of wearable-mediated exchanges within this game and identify awareness and fairness as considerations for future designs.

AI.tldr: 研究一种可穿戴中介的隐蔽交互通道：耳内音频消息 + 有意的向右头部倾斜作为回应，在20对参与者的卡牌游戏中以Wizard-of-Oz方式验证其可行性与用户体验。
AI.motivation: 共享场景中社交机器人需与某个体交换信息，同时限制在场他人对该信息的获取或解读；公开可见的语音与手势难以满足此类隐蔽交流需求。
AI.method: 20对（40名）被试与屏幕对话代理（代表社交机器人，由研究者以Wizard-of-Oz控制）进行卡牌游戏，每对分别在有/无该通道两种条件下游戏；一人佩戴设备（wearer），另一人为non-wearer且游戏后才告知通道存在。通道传递可帮助佩戴者或机器人角色选择可击败对手的信息。通过行为编码（信息交换与对手选择是否按设计发生）、感知压力/紧张量表、可用性问卷与回顾性访谈评估。
AI.result: 40次通道中介回合中39次按预期完成信息交换与对手选择；两种条件下佩戴者报告的感知压力/紧张均较低且无统计显著差异；使用后即时可用性评价良好；但回顾访谈显示非佩戴者对交互是否被察觉的陈述存在差异，且对团队合作与公平性的看法相互对立。
AI.conclusion: 该研究支持可穿戴中介信息交换在此游戏情境中的可行性，并指出"察觉度"与"公平性"是未来隐蔽交互设计需重点考虑的因素。

title: CLARA: A Cognitively-Driven Clarification Framework for Grounding Ambiguous Requests
comment: Work conducted in early 2025
summary: Robotics and AI systems are increasingly deploying large vision-language models (LVLMs) to follow high-level instructions, from routine household chores to more complex organizational tasks. Yet, broad directives like "clean the room" or "organize the desk" frequently omit crucial details about user preferences and specific arrangement of objects that influence the desired outcome. Without any further guidance, such models tend to overestimate their grasp of ambiguous instructions and frequently assume they have sufficient understanding despite missing important details. In this paper, we propose CLARA (Conversational cLArification for Robotic Arrangement), a cognitively-driven clarification framework that proactively elicits key information from users, in a similar fashion as humans' clarification seeking behavior. Through targeted questioning, CLARA refines ambiguous requests into structured, detailed instructions describing precisely how objects should be organized or rearranged, according to the user's preferences. These clarifications then guide a diffusion-based image generation pipeline, producing realistic visual renderings of the final, desired scene. This final rendering also serves as a visual confirmation of the system's understanding from the user. Experimental results and user studies demonstrate that CLARA leads to more accurate and consistent outcomes compared to another State-of-the-Art LVLM system, highlighting the importance of interactive clarification for bridging the gap between vague directives and fully grounded task specifications.

AI.tldr: CLARA：面向机器人整理任务的认知驱动对话澄清框架，通过主动提问把模糊指令细化为结构化对象摆放规范，并用扩散模型生成目标场景渲染图作为视觉确认。
AI.motivation: 高层指令（如"整理桌面"）缺失用户偏好与对象摆放细节，LVLM往往高估自身理解、不做澄清即执行，导致结果不一致。
AI.method: 模仿人类澄清行为的多轮提问策略，抽取缺失的关键信息；将澄清结果转成结构化的整理/重排指令；再驱动扩散式图像生成管线渲染最终目标场景，作为对系统理解的可视化确认与用户反馈闭环。
AI.result: 实验与用户研究表明，相比另一个SOTA LVLM系统，CLARA产生更准确、更一致的整理结果；澄清环节显著缩小模糊指令与可落地任务规格之间的差距。
AI.conclusion: 交互式澄清是LVLM机器人指令理解的关键补偿机制；渲染式视觉确认可作为验证与对齐手段。局限在于以生成图替代真实执行验证，缺少实机操作闭环。

title: Learning from Unlabeled Photographs for General Oral Image Analysis
summary: Oral photographs contain rich clinical information and hold significant potential for artificial intelligence applications; however, most models are trained for individual tasks and rely on costly expert annotations. We hypothesized that self-supervised training on unlabeled oral photographs could produce transferable visual representations for heterogeneous vision tasks. To test this hypothesis, we developed DOVE (Dental Optical Visual Encoder) by domain-adaptive self-supervised pretraining on approximately 530,000 unlabeled oral photographs collected from publicly accessible sources. DOVE was benchmarked against 3 established baselines across 5 classification datasets and 4 segmentation datasets, covering both frozen backbone evaluation and end-to-end finetuning. DOVE achieved the strongest overall performance, ranking best in few-shot transfer and label efficiency on most benchmarks. Under the 20-shot frozen-backbone protocol, DOVE outperformed the second best DINOv3 by 4.37 percentage points in mean macro-F1 across classification datasets and by 4.49 percentage points in mean macro-Dice across segmentation tasks. Under end-to-end finetuning, DOVE achieved at least 80% of the strongest full-data baseline's performance across most evaluation datasets using only 10% of the labeled training data. Qualitative retrieval and feature analyses further indicated better organization of image-level and spatial representations. These findings support DOVE as a generalizable and label-efficient backbone for oral vision research.

AI.tldr: DOVE：用约53万张无标注口腔照片做领域自适应自监督预训练，构建可迁移、标签高效的通用视觉编码器（Dental Optical Visual Encoder）。
AI.motivation: 口腔照片蕴含丰富临床信息，但现有模型多为单任务定制且依赖昂贵的专家标注；作者假设无标注口腔照片上的自监督训练能产生可迁移表征。
AI.method: 在约53万张公开来源无标注口腔照片上进行领域自适应自监督预训练；与3个成熟基线（含DINOv3）在5个分类、4个分割数据集上对比，涵盖冻结骨干评估与端到端微调，并做少样本迁移、标签效率、检索与特征定性分析。
AI.result: 整体性能最佳：20-shot冻结骨干协议下，分类平均macro-F1领先次优的DINOv3 4.37个百分点，分割平均macro-Dice领先4.49个百分点；端到端微调仅用10%标注数据即可在多数数据集达到最强全量基线的≥80%性能。
AI.conclusion: DOVE可作为口腔视觉研究中可泛化、标签高效的基础骨干网络；属领域专用的医学自监督预训练范式。

title: DenseTwins: Dense Modality Decoupling for Multimodal Self-Supervision
summary: Multimodal perception is central to many computer vision applications, including robotics and autonomous driving, where different sensing modalities provide complementary cues. Self-supervised learning offers a scalable solution for exploiting large amounts of unlabeled multimodal data. However, existing methods either neglect modality-specific information by enforcing feature-space alignment between modalities or learn only global representations without preserving spatial structure. We propose DenseTwins, a multimodal self-supervised framework that learns dense representations by explicitly decoupling the dense feature space into shared and modality-specific components. The proposed approach combines dense cross-modal correspondences with redundancy-reduction objectives, enabling the model to capture both shared semantics and modality-specific cues within a structured dense embedding space. DenseTwins jointly optimizes an intra-modal objective across augmented views and a cross-modal objective that aligns shared features while decorrelating modality-specific information. We evaluate DenseTwins across multiple multimodal benchmarks and sensing setups, achieving state-of-the-art or competitive performance across multimodal self-supervised baselines. Code available at: this https URL .

AI.tldr: 提出 DenseTwins 多模态自监督框架，将稠密特征空间显式解耦为共享与模态专属两部分，结合稠密跨模态对应与冗余削减目标学习稠密表示，在多模态基准上达到 SOTA 或竞争力表现。
AI.motivation: 现有跨模态自监督要么通过强制特征对齐而丢弃模态专属信息，要么只学全局表示而破坏空间结构，无法在机器人、自动驾驶等多传感器场景中同时保留共享语义与模态特有线索。
AI.method: 在稠密特征空间中显式解耦出共享子空间与模态专属子空间；联合优化两项目标：(1) 增强视图间的模态内稠密目标；(2) 跨模态稠密对应目标，对齐共享特征同时通过冗余削减（去相关）约束模态专属信息，形成结构化的稠密嵌入。
AI.result: 在多个多模态基准与多种传感配置上取得 SOTA 或与多模态自监督基线相当的性能；代码已开源。
AI.conclusion: 稠密解耦式跨模态自监督是可行且有效的方向，能在保留空间结构的前提下兼顾共享语义与模态特异性，可迁移到机器人、自动驾驶等感知任务。

title: Cycle WAM: Coupling Action and Video through Cycle Consistency
summary: Recent advances in video modeling have driven substantial progress in world action models (WAMs). Existing approaches exploit pretrained video priors by decoding actions from latent representations or inferring them from generated videos. The underlying link is causal: robot actions produce changes in the scene, and video observations of these changes provide evidence for inferring the actions that produced them. However, existing training formulations do not by themselves ensure that actions and their predicted visual consequences are consistent, potentially limiting the use of pretrained capabilities. We treat video and action as paired modalities linked by this causal relationship and learn their correspondence through a unified training framework designed to better exploit pretrained video priors. Cycle WAM first augments video-action co-training with bidirectional conversion to reinforce cross-modal correspondence and recover forward and inverse dynamics. It then introduces a differentiable cycle-reconstruction objective to further couple the two mappings. The resulting model supports both forward and inverse dynamics, with the potential to improve performance through more effective use of pretrained video priors. Cycle WAM achieves state-of-the-art performance among comparable methods on LIBERO-Pro and substantially improves DreamZero on DROID. Comparisons with UWM characterize its inverse-dynamics performance and show sharper visual detail in the displayed forward-dynamics predictions.

AI.tldr: Cycle WAM 将视频与动作视为由因果关系配对的两种模态，通过双向转换（前向/逆向动力学）与可微循环重建目标，统一训练以强化跨模态一致性并更好地利用预训练视频先验。
AI.motivation: 现有世界动作模型虽借助预训练视频先验，但训练目标本身并不保证「动作」与其「预测视觉后果」的一致性，削弱了预训练能力的迁移与利用。
AI.method: 以视频—动作的因果配对关系为核心，在视频-动作联合训练上加入双向转换（动作→视频、视频→动作）以恢复前向与逆向动力学；再引入可微循环重建损失，将两个映射进一步耦合，使模型同时支持前向与逆向动力学。
AI.result: 在 LIBERO-Pro 上取得同类方法中的 SOTA；在 DROID 上显著优于 DreamZero；与 UWM 对比显示其逆向动力学性能更强，且前向动力学预测的视觉细节更锐利。
AI.conclusion: 通过显式建模视频-动作的因果一致性与循环耦合，可更充分地利用预训练视频先验，统一提升世界动作模型的预测与推断能力。

title: VISAGE: Vertex-based Intrinsic Surface Appearance GEneration via Dual-Stream Diffusion for Arbitrary 3D Heads
summary: Recovering identity-faithful, physically based surface appearance for 3D human heads from sparse images remains challenging. Existing methods often rely on UV-based pipelines, introducing seam artefacts, or operate in image space, limiting surface consistency. We present VISAGE, Vertex-based Intrinsic Surface Appearance GEneration, a surface-based conditional diffusion framework that synthesises per-vertex albedo and roughness directly on arbitrary mesh topologies, without requiring consistent UV parameterisation at training time. VISAGE combines global spectral processing with local geodesic K-Nearest-Neighbour refinement, enforcing structural coherence while restoring detail beyond the truncated spectral basis. Multi-view RGB images condition the network via visibility-aware cross-attention, enabling occlusion-robust synthesis across the full head surface. Region-specific modules specialise in semantically demanding and distinct areas (eyes, mouth, skin and hair), while a tangent-space output projection recovers fine iris detail. We further introduce a scalable procedural augmentation pipeline that enriches raw geometry scans with physically plausible albedo, roughness and normal maps for training. The predicted attributes render directly as a single RGBA vertex-colour channel. VISAGE reduces FID by 42.7% on NPHM and 22.5% and 4.4% on zero-shot FaceVerse and i3DMM, respectively, relative to the strongest baseline, with a 7.2M-parameter core network.

AI.tldr: VISAGE：基于顶点的表面条件扩散框架，直接在任意网格拓扑上生成逐顶点反照率与粗糙度，无需UV参数化，用多视图可见性感知交叉注意力与区域专用模块实现身份保真的人头外观重建。
AI.motivation: 从稀疏图像恢复3D人头身份一致、物理化的表面外观仍然困难：UV流程产生接缝伪影，图像空间方法缺乏表面一致性。需要直接在网格上生成无接缝的逐顶点材质属性。
AI.method: 表面级条件扩散：(1) 全局谱域（spectral）处理 + 局部测地KNN精修，在截断谱基之外恢复细节并保证结构连贯；(2) 多视图RGB经可见性感知交叉注意力条件化，实现全头表面遮挡鲁棒合成；(3) 眼、口、皮肤、发四个区域专用模块，切线空间输出投影恢复虹膜细节；(4) 可扩展的程序化增强流水线，为原始几何扫描合成物理合理的albedo/roughness/normal监督；输出直接渲染为单一RGBA顶点色通道。核心网络7.2M参数。
AI.result: 相对最强基线，FID在NPHM下降42.7%，零样本FaceVerse降22.5%、i3DMM降4.4%，核心网络仅7.2M参数。
AI.conclusion: 直接在网格顶点空间做材质扩散可规避UV接缝并保持表面一致性，配以区域专用与切线空间细节恢复，可在稀疏视图下获得高保真、可微渲染的人头外观；同时提出了可规模化的程序化材质数据增强方案。

title: SPOD: Recovering Suppressed Temporal Evidence in Video-LLMs via Single-Pass Orthogonal Decomposition
comment: 10 pages, 4 figures, 1 table. Accepted to ACM Multimedia 2026 (MM '26)
summary: Video Large Language Models (Video-LLMs) have achieved strong performance on many video understanding tasks, yet remain vulnerable to temporal hallucination in time-sensitive reasoning scenarios such as scene transition understanding and event ordering. Existing solutions either require costly retraining or introduce inefficient multi-pass inference and external supervision at test time. In this work, we show that temporal evidence is already encoded in Video-LLM hidden representations but is not fully exploited during standard inference. Motivated by this observation, we propose Single-Pass Orthogonal Decomposition (SPOD), a training-free framework that recovers suppressed temporal evidence through analytical hidden-state manipulation in a single forward pass. SPOD consists of two components: Frame Distinctiveness Analysis (FDA), which identifies salient frames from middle-layer hidden-state geometry, and Temporal Delta Subspace (TDS), which constructs orthogonal temporal and prior subspaces from weighted inter-frame hidden-state differences. By decomposing final hidden states into temporal, prior, and residual components and rescaling them independently, SPOD enhances dynamic information, suppresses static appearance bias, and preserves complementary information. Experiments on VidHalluc, EventHallusion, and VideoMMMU show that SPOD consistently outperforms strong inference-time baselines across temporal reasoning tasks and model architectures while retaining near-vanilla inference efficiency. These results suggest that improving temporal reasoning in Video-LLMs may depend not only on additional supervision, but also on recovering temporal evidence already present in their internal representations. Our code is available at this https URL .

AI.tldr: 提出免训练单次前向的SPOD框架，通过分析式隐状态操作恢复Video-LLM中被抑制的时间证据，缓解时间幻觉。
AI.motivation: Video-LLM在场景切换理解、事件排序等时间敏感推理中易产生时间幻觉；现有方案要么需昂贵重训练，要么在测试时引入多轮推理与外部监督，效率低。
AI.method: SPOD含两部分：帧区分度分析（FDA）利用中间层隐状态几何识别显著帧；时间差分子空间（TDS）由加权帧间隐状态差构建正交的时间子空间与先验子空间。将末层隐状态分解为时间、先验、残差分量并分别重缩放，增强动态信息、抑制静态外观偏置、保留互补信息，全过程单次前向、免训练。
AI.result: 在VidHalluc、EventHallusion、VideoMMMU上，跨多种时间推理任务与模型架构均稳定优于强推理时基线，且推理效率接近原始模型。
AI.conclusion: Video-LLM时间推理的提升不必只依赖额外监督，可通过恢复其内部表示中已存在但被抑制的时间证据来实现，为免训练推理时干预提供了可解释的新范式。

title: TEXMET: A Deep Learning Benchmark for Archaeological Textile Reconstruction
comment: 26 pages, 14 figures, 14 tables. Accepted version of the article published in ACM Journal on Computing and Cultural Heritage (2026). Dataset: this https URL
summary: The reconstruction of fragmented historical textiles presents a significant challenge in computational archaeology. The Oseberg ship burial, dating to 834 CE, yielded hundreds of degraded textile fragments that have resisted systematic computational analysis. While deep learning has revolutionized image-based puzzle solving, progress on archaeological textiles has been limited by the lack of domain-specific datasets and systematic evaluation of modern architectures. To address this gap, we present TEXMET, a curated dataset of 18,644 historical textile images from the Metropolitan Museum of Art's Open Access collection, representing the first textile-specific benchmark for puzzle-solving research. Using TEXMET, we conduct a systematic evaluation of three state-of-the-art puzzle-solving models: JPDVT, FCViT, and DiffAssemble. Our experiments reveal that the transformer-based models pre-trained on standard datasets fail to generalize to textiles, but domain-specific fine-tuning proves highly effective. The graph-based DiffAssemble model, when fine-tuned on TEXMET, achieves 85.89% puzzle accuracy on textile data. Most significantly, applying this fine-tuned model to 45 highly degraded Oseberg fragments yields a performance increase from 26.67% to 64.44% puzzle accuracy. These results establish TEXMET as a new benchmark for textile reconstruction and demonstrate that domain adaptation is essential for applying puzzle-solving methods to imagery of real archaeological materials.

AI.tldr: 提出TEXMET——首个面向历史纺织品的拼图求解基准数据集（18,644张图），系统评测三种拼图模型，并证明领域微调对退化考古织物碎片重构至关重要。
AI.motivation: 考古纺织品碎片（如834 CE Oseberg船葬出土的退化织物）缺乏领域数据集与系统性模型评估，导致深度学习拼图方法难以直接迁移。
AI.method: 构建TEXMET数据集（取自大都会艺术博物馆开放获取藏品的18,644张纺织图像）；在同一基准上对JPDVT、FCViT、DiffAssemble三种SOTA拼图求解架构进行系统评测，并考察域微调与图结构建模的作用。
AI.result: 通用预训练的Transformer类模型对织物泛化失败；基于图的DiffAssemble经TEXMET微调后达85.89%拼图准确率；迁移至45块高度退化的Oseberg碎片时，准确率由26.67%提升至64.44%。
AI.conclusion: TEXMET建立了纺织品重构的新基准，表明领域自适应是将拼图求解方法应用于真实考古材料图像的必要条件。

title: Mass Scaling Laws for Energy-Optimal Horizontal Multirotor Flight
comment: Accepted to IEEE Robotics and Automation Letters, October 2026
summary: Multicopters are a type of aerial robot seeing extensive real-world applications but with range and endurance as critical bottlenecks. Optimization of its energy efficiency through energy-aware flight planning (e.g. cruise speed-scheduling) has hence been an important topic. The mass of the multicopter is an important factor to consider, as it has a significant impact on efficiency, and many common applications are subject to frequent mass variation due to payload change. This work derives closed-form scaling relationships between the energy-optimal steady horizontal flight behavior of a multicopter and its vehicle mass, and validates them experimentally on two multirotor platforms. Specifically, for mass-only variation, i.e., when payload changes the vehicle mass while the airframe geometry, aerodynamic characteristics, and rotor configuration remain unchanged, we show through a combination of numerical simulation, theoretical derivation, and experimental validation that (1) the energy-optimal velocity is proportional to the square root of vehicle mass; (2) the energy-optimal pitch angle is constant with respect to mass; and (3) the optimal energy per meter is proportional to mass. The analysis shows that these three relationships arise from a common mass-similarity property of the steady-state flight and rotor-aerodynamic equations. Furthermore, the obtained scaling relationships enable simple yet effective cruise-speed planning to optimize energy efficiency and extend the range and endurance of the multicopter.

AI.tldr: 本文推导并实验验证了多旋翼无人机在仅质量变化（载荷变化）情形下，能量最优稳态平飞行为与机体质量的闭式标度关系：最优速度∝√m、最优俯仰角与质量无关、单位距离最优能耗∝m，并据此给出简单有效的巡航速度规划方法。
AI.motivation: 多旋翼航程与续航是实际应用的关键瓶颈，而许多任务中载荷频繁变化导致质量波动，质量对能效影响显著。既有能量感知飞行规划（如巡航速度调度）通常未系统刻画质量变化下的最优飞行行为如何缩放，缺少可直接用于速度规划的解析规律。
AI.method: 针对仅质量变化（气动外形、旋翼配置不变）设定，结合理论推导、数值仿真与两架多旋翼平台的实验验证，从稳态飞行与旋翼气动方程出发，导出能量最优水平飞行行为与质量的闭式标度关系，并指出三者源于共同的“质量相似性”性质。
AI.result: 实验与仿真一致支持三项结论：(1) 能量最优速度与机体质量的平方根成正比；(2) 能量最优俯仰角与质量无关、为常数；(3) 单位距离最优能耗与质量成正比。基于这些标度关系的巡航速度规划可有效提升能效。
AI.conclusion: 该工作给出了简洁、可解释且经实验验证的质量—能效标度规律，为载荷变化场景下的多旋翼巡航速度调度提供了轻量化的解析规划依据，有利于延长航程与续航；但结论限于仅质量变化且稳态平飞的假设。

title: Bounded AUKS: A Novel Evaluation Metric for Anomaly Detection via Bounded Area Under the Kolmogorov--Smirnov Curve
summary: Recent literature widely used global metrics such as AUROC and AUPRO to quantify the detection performance. AUROC and AUPRO scores are approaching 100% in some public datasets such as MVTec AD dataset and VisA dataset, which misleadingly suggests that the pixel-level anomaly detection task has already been solved. Threshold-independent metrics represented by AUROC inherently ignore the threshold selection process, which is inevitable in practical applications. Although AUPRO restricts the False Positive rates (FPRs) to an acceptable range, extremely low FPRs can lead to increased false negative rates (FNRs). We argue that there is a lack of metrics capable of quantifying the separation between the anomaly score distributions of normal and anomalous samples, which hinders advancements in anomaly detection. In response, we propose the Bounded Area Under the Kolmogorov--Smirnov curve (Bounded AUKS), a partial integral metric that integrates the difference between TPR and FPR within a data-driven bounded range. Specifically, we introduce AUKS from KS integral as a direct measure of separability between the anomaly score distributions. The bounded range is determined only by score distributions of normal test samples. Lower bound excludes the uninformative high-FPR region. Upper bound avoids evaluation in extreme regions that aggressively push FPR towards zero, which result in a very low recall. Our experiments on 9 models across MVTec AD and VisA datasets show that Bounded AUKS can address the limitations of existing metrics and has a better performance in evaluating unsupervised anomaly detection models.

AI.tldr: 针对AUROC/AUPRO接近饱和且忽略阈值选择的问题，本文从KS积分导出有界AUKS（Bounded AUKS）部分积分指标，仅在由正常样本分数分布确定的数据驱动区间内积分TPR-FPR之差，以衡量正常/异常分数分布的可分性。
AI.motivation: 现有AUROC、AUPRO等与阈值无关的全局指标在MVTec AD、VisA上已接近100%，给人"像素级异常检测已被解决"的误导；AUROC忽略实际应用中不可避免的阈值选择，AUPRO虽限制FPR范围但极低FPR会导致召回率大幅下降。缺少能刻画正常与异常分数分布分离程度的指标。
AI.method: 将KS积分推广为AUKS，并以数据驱动方式确定积分区间：区间仅由正常测试样本的分数分布决定；下界剔除无信息的高FPR区域（分数分布接近基线处），上界避免为把FPR压向零而进入低召回的极端区域，从而得到有界AUKS部分积分度量。
AI.result: 在MVTec AD与VisA两个数据集、9个模型上进行实验，Bounded AUKS能够规避现有指标的局限，在无监督异常检测模型评估中表现出更好的区分与评价性能。
AI.conclusion: 现有阈值无关全局指标存在饱和与饱和性误导，Bounded AUKS作为有界可分性度量提供了更合理的评价方式，为异常检测方法改进提供可靠评测基础。

title: iMED: A Multi-Endoscope Dataset for Surgical 3D Perception
comment: Published at ECCV 2026. 25 pages, including supplementary material. Code and dataset: this https URL
summary: We introduce iMED, the first synchronized multi-endoscope dataset for robot-assisted minimally invasive surgery (RAMIS), designed to address a fundamental limitation in surgical vision benchmarking: the absence of independent held-out viewpoints. Existing surgical datasets capture single-trajectory sequences from a single endoscope, making it impossible to distinguish geometric generalization from photometric interpolation along a narrow forward-facing path. iMED provides 340 sequences ~170K synchronized timepoints with 4 views per timepoint) recorded simultaneously from two independent stereo endoscopes across ex vivo, postmortem, and live surgical settings, spanning 14 specimens with diverse anatomical regions and motion regimes. The dataset includes calibrated camera intrinsics, ArUco-based frame-wise pose estimates with uncertainty quantification, instrument segmentation masks, and rich clinical metadata. Using a train-on-one-endoscope, test-on-another evaluation protocol, we benchmark 23 state-of-the-art methods across rigid and deformable novel view synthesis, pose estimation, feature matching, and monocular depth estimation. Our experiments show that methods relying primarily on photometric supervision degrade substantially under this held-out-endoscope setting, while methods with explicit geometric regularization are more robust across views in our benchmark. Notably, large-scale foundation models transfer surprisingly well to surgical imagery, often outperforming domain-specific models, suggesting pitfalls in current fine-tuning protocols. iMED establishes a new evaluation protocol for geometric generalization in surgical vision.

AI.tldr: iMED是首个面向机器人辅助微创手术的双内窥镜同步数据集（340序列、约17万同步时刻、每时刻4视角，含外体、尸检与活体场景，附标定内参、ArUco逐帧位姿及不确定度、器械分割掩膜），并提出"单镜训练—另一镜测试"的几何泛化评测协议，基准23个SOTA方法。
AI.motivation: 现有手术视觉数据集均为单内窥镜单轨迹序列，缺少独立留出视角，无法区分几何泛化与沿前向窄路径的光度插值，导致新视角合成、位姿估计等任务的评测存在根本缺陷。
AI.method: 双独立立体内窥镜同步采集，覆盖14个标本与多种运动模式；提供相机内参标定、基于ArUco的逐帧位姿与不确定度量化、器械分割与临床元数据；采用train-on-one-endoscope/test-on-another协议，评测刚性/非刚性新视角合成、位姿估计、特征匹配、单目深度估计共23种方法。
AI.result: 依赖光度监督的方法在留出内窥镜设定下性能显著退化；带显式几何正则的方法跨视角更鲁棒；大规模基础模型迁移效果出人意料地好，常优于领域专用模型，提示现有微调协议存在陷阱。
AI.conclusion: iMED为手术视觉中的几何泛化建立了新的评测范式，揭示光度监督的脆弱性与基础模型的迁移潜力。

title: Beyond Local Refinement: Wide-Area Precise Cross-View Localization
comment: Project page: this https URL
summary: Fine-grained cross-view localization aims to precisely localize a ground camera against geo-referenced aerial imagery, but current methods typically assume a narrow geographic prior, substantially limiting their applicability when upstream localization remains coarse. To bridge this gap, we study this task over much larger aerial regions. However, this seemingly simple extension fundamentally changes the localization problem: the growing disparity in spatial extent between ground and aerial views makes reliable cross-view matching difficult to establish directly, while the increasing number of look-alike locations in larger regions introduces substantial visual ambiguity. To address these challenges, we propose RingMatch, a search-and-verification framework for wide-area cross-view localization. RingMatch first leverages predictive uncertainty to uncover plausible locations and progressively zooms into their surroundings to obtain increasingly fine-grained evidence, yielding a compact set of promising candidates. We then introduce the depth ring, a novel geometric representation that reveals subtle variations in the spatial layout around a location and serves as a view-shared spatial signature for an LVLM verifier to resolve residual ambiguity. To benchmark this setting, we construct VIGOR-Pro by composing VIGOR aerial tiles into contiguous regions with spatial extents of up to 400 m. Experiments show that RingMatch maintains strong localization performance as the aerial region expands, consistently outperforming representative end-to-end and retrieval-based methods.

AI.tldr: RingMatch提出“搜索-验证”框架用于广域（大范围航拍区）细粒度跨视角定位：先用预测不确定性产生候选并逐级放大细看，获得紧凑候选集；再用“深度环”几何表征作为视角共享的空间签名，交由LVLM验证器消解残余歧义。并构建VIGOR-Pro基准（航拍区域拼接至约400 m）。
AI.motivation: 现有跨视角定位方法假设地理先验很窄，上游粗定位不精确时失效；而直接把搜索范围扩展到更大航拍区域会根本改变问题：地面与航拍视图的空间尺度差异导致难以直接匹配，同时大量外观相似地点带来视觉歧义。
AI.method: RingMatch：(1) 基于预测不确定性发现可行位置，并逐步对其周边区域“放大”以获取更细粒度证据，得到紧凑候选集；(2) 深度环(depth ring)——刻画位置周边空间布局细微变化的几何表示，作为视角共享空间签名，供LVLM验证器解决残余歧义；配套基准VIGOR-Pro由VIGOR航拍瓦片拼接成连续区域。
AI.result: 在VIGOR-Pro上，随航拍区域扩大，RingMatch仍保持较强定位性能，持续优于代表性端到端方法和基于检索的方法。
AI.conclusion: 通过搜索-验证范式与几何签名加LVLM验证，可在宽区域条件下实现鲁棒的细粒度跨视角定位；为更贴近实际的大范围定位设定提供了新基准与新方法。

title: Pixel-space video generation with U-JiT
summary: Latent diffusion and flow matching models are ubiquitous in state-of-the-art generative video models. While highly effective, relying on pretrained autoencoders to compress the data into a lower-dimensional latent space also comes with drawbacks. First, training proceeds in two stages: autoencoder pretraining, with compression and reconstruction objectives, followed by latent generative model training, precluding fully end-to-end training. Second, autoencoders also lead to an inherent loss of signal, and the trade-off between reconstruction quality and generative performance in the latent space is still an active area of research. In this paper we explore the viability of generative video models directly in pixel space. We analyze recent approaches in pixel-space generative modeling of images that rely on basic transformer designs, and identify several shortcomings that limit their effectiveness for the high-dimensional pixel-space video generation. To overcome these limitations, we propose a UNet-like transformer architecture along with improvements to the training recipe and sampling strategy. We conduct controlled experiments, training latent and pixel-space models from scratch on Kinetics-600. For the standard frames-to-video task at 128 resolution, our U-JiT model improves generative FVD by 27% over prior state-of-the-art results, and by 14% against the JiT pixel-space baseline. Scaling to higher 256 resolution, we find the improvement over pixel-space and latent-based models grows as we increase the spatiotemporal compression rate up to $64 \times 64 \times 8$. Finally, we find that U-JiT improves per-frame FID by 27% over latent models and 61% over pixel-space models on class-to-video generation, with respectively 9% and 56% reduction in FVD.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出 U-JiT，一种 UNet 式 Transformer 架构，并改进训练配方与采样策略，直接在像素空间做视频生成，取代预训练自编码器的两阶段流程；在 Kinetics-600 上像素空间模型超越潜空间与 JiT 基线。
AI.motivation: 潜扩散/流匹配依赖预训练自编码器，导致：(1) 两阶段训练无法端到端；(2) 必然的信号损失，重建质量与生成性能之间存在难以调和的权衡。作者希望验证直接在像素空间训练生成式视频模型的可行性。
AI.method: 分析近期像素空间图像生成中基于基础 Transformer 的做法，指出其在高维像素视频生成上的不足；据此提出 UNet 式 Transformer（U-JiT），并改进训练配方与采样策略。在 Kinetics-600 上从头训练潜空间与像素空间模型做受控对比实验，覆盖 128 与 256 分辨率及不同时空压缩率（至 64×64×8）。
AI.result: 128 分辨率帧到视频任务上，U-JiT 相比此前 SOTA 提升 FVD 27%，相比 JiT 像素基线提升 14%；扩展至 256 分辨率并提高时空压缩率时，相对潜空间模型的优势进一步扩大。类到视频生成中，逐帧 FID 比潜空间模型优 27%、比像素空间模型优 61%，FVD 分别降低 9% 与 56%。
AI.conclusion: 像素空间视频生成在合适架构与训练策略下可超越潜空间方案，且优势随分辨率与压缩率提升而扩大，为免自编码器的端到端视频生成提供可行路径。

title: LIPS-PC: Learning Illumination Patterns for Single-Pixel Classification
comment: 9 pages, 8 figures, comments are welcome
summary: In single-pixel (ghost) imaging, known illumination patterns probe an object and a detector with no spatial resolution returns one number per pattern. Each measurement costs acquisition time and photons and, for ionizing probes, contributes to delivered dose. Motivated by automated radiographic defect screening, where a class label suffices, we introduce Learning Illumination Patterns for Single-Pixel Classification (LIPS-PC). The patterns are learned end-to-end while the measurement operator remains one fixed linear matrix, identical for every input. We parameterize it as a residual correction to a two-dimensional discrete cosine transform (2D-DCT), $D=D_{\mathrm{base}}+\Delta$, and jointly train the correction and a compact classifier using cross-entropy, without a reconstruction objective. This yields a task-driven linear embedding through optimization. We evaluate LIPS-PC numerically on MNIST and Fashion-MNIST under a controlled protocol, then on RIAWELC, a real industrial X-ray weld-radiograph dataset. Across five budgets, $M\in{8,16,32,64,128}$, corresponding to sampling ratios from below 1% to 12.5%, the learned operator outperforms the best tested fixed transform by 9-15 percentage points at $M=8$ on all three datasets. Its eight-measurement accuracy requires roughly 16-32 measurements with the best fixed transform, indicating a $2\times$ to $4\times$ saving at comparable accuracy. The advantage generally shrinks as $M$ increases, with a small reversal on RIAWELC at higher budgets. These results show that learning what to measure is especially valuable when measurements are scarce.

AI.tldr: LIPS-PC 将单像素成像的照明图案参数化为 2D-DCT 基底的残差修正矩阵，与紧凑分类器端到端联合训练（无重建目标），实现任务驱动的线性嵌入，在低采样预算下显著提升分类精度。
AI.motivation: 单像素/鬼成像中，每次测量都消耗时间与光子，电离辐射探针还带来剂量成本；工业射线探伤只需类别标签而非重建图像，因此应"学习测什么"而非固定使用通用变换基底。
AI.method: 保持测量算子在所有输入间共享的单一固定线性矩阵 D = D_base + Δ（D_base 为 2D-DCT），联合优化残差修正 Δ 与轻量分类器，交叉熵损失，不含重建项；MNIST/Fashion-MNIST 受控实验 + 真实工业 X 射线焊缝射线图像数据集 RIAWELC。
AI.result: M∈{8,16,32,64,128}（采样率 <1% 至 12.5%）五档预算下，M=8 时相对最佳固定变换提升 9–15 个百分点，三个数据集一致；8 次测量的精度需固定变换 16–32 次测量才能达到，即 2–4 倍测量节省；优势随 M 增大而收窄，RIAWELC 高预算档出现小幅反转。
AI.conclusion: 学习"测量什么"在测量稀缺时价值最大；任务驱动的线性嵌入可替代通用变换基底，为低剂量、快速的单像素分类筛查提供实用路径。

title: NightIQA: A Comprehensive Dataset and Benchmark for MLLM-Based Nighttime Image Quality Assessment
comment: Accepted to WACV 2027. 25 pages including supplementary material
summary: Nighttime images are inherently susceptible to complex, compound degradations, making accurate quality assessment exceptionally challenging. Score-based IQA methods condense quality into a single number, lacking the multi-dimensional, language-grounded reasoning required for nighttime evaluation. Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) offer a more comprehensive alternative, yet remain constrained by a critical data gap: existing real-world IQA datasets are overwhelmingly daytime-centric and often built from outdated captures, while synthetic alternatives lack nighttime-specific degradation modeling, yielding artifacts far removed from authentic nighttime conditions. To bridge this gap, we present NightIQA, a dataset and benchmark suite purpose-built for MLLM-based nighttime IQA. It comprises three core components: NightIQA-Real, a real-world dataset of 1,769 high-resolution images that we captured ourselves with modern equipment, encompassing six canonical distortion types and structured multi-dimensional annotations; NightIQA-Bench, a benchmark of 1,078 visually grounded multiple-choice questions tailored to MLLM-based nighttime IQA, organized around a four-level evaluation hierarchy spanning Perception, Technical Assessment, Localization, and Reasoning; and NightIQA-Syn, an inherently scalable, scene-aware synthesis pipeline that jointly models global-level and instance-level degradations, with an initial release of 80k high-fidelity images alongside the full generation code. Fine-tuned on NightIQA with Supervised Fine-Tuning (SFT) and Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO), Qwen3-VL-8B outperforms open-source IQA methods and achieves higher overall accuracy than leading closed-source models, highlighting the value of domain-specific data and structured supervision.

AI.tldr: 提出NightIQA：面向MLLM夜间图像质量评估的数据集与基准，含真实数据集NightIQA-Real（1769张自采高分辨率图，6类失真+多维标注）、多层评测基准NightIQA-Bench（1078道视觉接地选择题，覆盖感知/技术评估/定位/推理）、以及场景感知合成流水线NightIQA-Syn（联合建模全局与实例级退化，初始80k图+代码）。Qwen3-VL-8B经SFT+GRPO微调后超越开源IQA方法并在总体准确率上超过领先闭源模型。
AI.motivation: 夜间图像存在复杂复合退化，评分式IQA将质量压缩为单一数值，缺乏语言化多维推理；MLLM虽更全面，但现有真实IQA数据集以白天为主且多为陈旧采集，合成数据又缺少夜间特有退化建模，存在关键数据缺口。
AI.method: 构建三部分数据/基准体系：真实夜间数据集（自采现代设备、六类典型失真、结构化多维标注）；按四级评测层级（感知、技术评估、定位、推理）组织的视觉接地多选题基准；场景感知的可扩展合成流水线，联合建模全局级与实例级退化。以SFT与GRPO对Qwen3-VL-8B进行领域微调。
AI.result: 微调后Qwen3-VL-8B在夜间IQA上优于开源IQA方法，整体准确率超过领先闭源模型，验证了领域专用数据与结构化监督的价值。
AI.conclusion: 夜间IQA需要多维语言化推理而非单一评分；自采真实数据+分层基准+可扩展合成管线是弥合数据缺口的有效路径。

title: Radial distortion homography estimation from affine-covariant or orientation-covariant features
summary: We present minimal solvers for joint homography and radial distortion estimation using affine- or orientation-covariant features. The core contribution is a set of novel constraints that exploit local feature geometry inherent to affine descriptors, enabling solvers that require fewer correspondences than point-based methods. Using modern robust estimation frameworks, we demonstrate that the proposed solvers are advantageous to the current state-of-the-art with a significant speed-up in the presence of outliers while maintaining comparable or superior estimation accuracy. The proposed solvers are tested on both synthetic and real images containing challenging fisheye distortions.

AI.tldr: 提出利用仿射/方向协变特征内在局部几何的新约束，构造联合单应与径向畸变估计的最小求解器，在离群点下显著加速且精度相当或更优。
AI.motivation: 传统基于点对应的方法估计单应+径向畸变需要较多对应点，最小求解器样本数较大导致RANSAC效率低；仿射描述子携带的局部几何信息此前未被充分利用。
AI.method: 从仿射描述子（affine- 或 orientation-covariant features）的局部几何出发推导一组新约束，构建需要更少对应点的最小求解器；嵌入现代鲁棒估计框架（RANSAC类）进行联合单应与径向畸变估计。
AI.result: 在合成数据与含强鱼眼畸变的真实图像上验证：离群点存在时相较SOTA有显著加速，估计精度相当或更优。
AI.conclusion: 利用仿射特征局部几何可降低最小求解器的对应点需求，从而提升鲁棒估计效率；适用于鱼眼等强畸变场景的单应估计。

title: Coordinating Humanoid Loco-Manipulation through Action-Conditioned Latent Foresight
comment: 10 pages, including supplementary material
summary: Humanoid loco-manipulation requires coordinated body motion and hand interaction over time, and a plausible-looking command sequence can still drop a held object or leave an interaction incomplete. We present action-conditioned latent foresight, a latent world-action model (WAM) that evaluates proposed command sequences before execution. An action generator proposes joint motion-hand command sequences from vision, language, and the robot state. An action-conditioned endpoint predictor estimates the visual features each sequence prefix reaches and measures progress toward a demonstration-derived subgoal, while a joint temporal prior scores temporal consistency given the robot state and preceding commands. The robot executes the first commands of the best-scoring sequence and replans from the next observation. During training, action consistency regularization reconstructs the first demonstrated command from observed and predicted feature changes, encouraging the predictor to retain action-relevant information. On ten tasks in the humanoid loco-manipulation simulation benchmark SIMPLE, our method achieves 89.7% average success, compared with 73.7% for Psi-Zero and 82.0% for DiT4DiT. On seven real-robot tasks, it achieves 85.7% under standard conditions and 65.7% under unseen object configurations, while GR00T N1.7 achieves 70.0% and 48.6%, respectively. Project page: this https URL

AI.tldr: 提出动作条件潜空间预测（latent WAM）：动作生成器从视觉、语言与机器人状态提出联合躯干-手部指令序列，由动作条件终点预测器估计前缀达到的视觉特征并与示教子目标比对进度，联合时序先验评估时序一致性，执行最优序列前若干指令后重规划。
AI.motivation: 人形loco-manipulation需长时间协调身体运动与手部交互；看似合理的指令序列仍可能导致掉落物体或交互未完成，因此需要在执行前评估候选指令序列。
AI.method: 潜世界-动作模型（WAM）：(1) 动作生成器以视觉/语言/本体状态为输入生成躯干-手联合动作序列；(2) 动作条件端点预测器估计各序列前缀的视觉特征并度量向示教导出子目标的进度；(3) 联合时序先验结合机器人与前序指令打分时序一致性；滚动时域执行+重规划；(4) 训练时动作一致性正则：由观测与预测特征变化重建示教首条指令，保留动作相关信息。
AI.result: SIMPLE仿真基准10任务平均成功率89.7%（Psi-Zero 73.7%，DiT4DiT 82.0%）；真机7任务标准条件85.7%、未见物体构型65.7%，对比GR00T N1.7的70.0%与48.6%。
AI.conclusion: 在执行前用潜空间前向预测+子目标进度+时序先验对候选动作序列打分，可显著提升人形loco-manipulation的成功率与未见构型泛化，并优于现有基线。

title: PrimeSim: A Generalist World Model Simulator from Large-Scale Cross-Embodiment Demonstrations
summary: A robot world model that serves as a simulator must do more than generate plausible videos: it must faithfully follow commanded actions, maintain consistency across camera views, and sustain coherent long-horizon rollouts. We present PrimeSim, an action-conditioned, multiview world model simulator that addresses these challenges through progressive midtraining and posttraining. Starting from a pretrained video generator, we midtrain on 30,110 hours of robot demonstrations spanning 22 platforms. To improve action following, we introduce a unified cross-embodiment action representation and frame-aligned dual-path conditioning to strengthen action-frame correspondence. To maintain multiview consistency, we develop view-aware interleaved attention with explicit camera identities, enabling cross-view information exchange while preserving view-specific representations. We further introduce a fast-video, slow-memory posttraining framework that transforms the bidirectional video generator into an efficient autoregressive simulator. By combining fast causal generation, self-rollout training, and hierarchical temporal memory, PrimeSim mitigates error accumulation from self-generated histories and supports coherent long-horizon simulation. PrimeSim runs at 10.1 FPS, remains stable over long-horizon rollouts on rigid and deformable manipulation tasks, and transfers to held-out platforms within 100 to 200 gradient steps where the pretrained backbone does not. Against five open-source action-conditioned world models it leads four of the five WorldSimProbe suites and posts the best overall EWMBench score, while fine-grained local calibration still trails the field; its rollouts are faithful enough to support GRPO-based policy optimization. We release the model weights, inference code, and training code.

AI.tldr: PrimeSim：动作条件多视角机器人世界模型模拟器，通过跨平台中训练（统一动作表示+帧对齐双路条件、视角感知交错注意力）与"快视频-慢记忆"后训练，实现10.1 FPS的自回归长时程稳定rollout。
AI.motivation: 作为模拟器的机器人世界模型不能只生成"看似合理"的视频，还需忠实遵循指令动作、保持多视角一致性、并维持长时程rollout的连贯性；现有视频生成器在这三点上均不足。
AI.method: 从预训练视频生成器出发，在22个平台、30,110小时机器人演示数据上做渐进式中训练：引入统一跨具身(跨embodiment)动作表示与帧对齐双路条件增强动作-帧对应；采用带显式相机ID的视角感知交错注意力实现跨视角信息交换同时保留视角特征。后训练阶段提出fast-video/slow-memory框架，结合快速因果生成、自rollout训练与分层时序记忆，将双向生成器转为高效自回归模拟器。
AI.result: 10.1 FPS运行；刚性及可变形操作任务长时程rollout稳定；迁移到留出平台仅需100–200梯度步（预训练骨干无法做到）；对比五个开源动作条件世界模型，在WorldSimProbe五套评测中四项领先，EWMBench总体最佳，但细粒度局部校准仍落后；rollout可支撑GRPO策略优化。开源权重、推理与训练代码。
AI.conclusion: 渐进式中训练+后训练可有效把视频生成器转化为可靠的动作条件多视角世界模拟器，并具备下游策略优化价值；局限在于局部精细校准不足。

title: Physics-Based Plausibility Assessment of AI-Predicted Vehicle Parameters for Automotive Radar in Pre-Crash Scenarios
summary: Automotive radar is a key sensing modality for safety-critical vehicle functions due to its robustness under adverse weather and lighting conditions. Recent advances in AI-based radar perception enable the direct estimation of object parameters from a single radar measurement cycle. However, the internal decision process of data-driven models is typically not explicitly linked to the underlying radar sensing physics. Consequently, object estimates may achieve high statistical accuracy while remaining physically inconsistent with the measured radar signature, particularly in previously unseen scenarios. Such inconsistencies are especially critical for heading estimation, as they directly affect trajectory prediction and collision assessment in pre-crash scenarios. This paper presents a physics-based consistency assessment framework for validating AI-derived vehicle hypotheses in automotive radar perception. The proposed approach generates an expected radar signature from AI-estimated object parameters using a physics-based reference model that incorporates occlusion-dependent edge visibility, aspect- and angle-dependent RCS modeling, and characteristic wheel-induced MD signatures. The expected signature is compared with the observed radar point cloud using a Wasserstein-distance-based consistency metric computed from three complementary features: the spatial distribution of detections along object edges, the local detection count, and the radar reflection intensity. In this way, physically implausible object hypotheses can be identified and corrected independently of the underlying neural network architecture and without model retraining or architectural modifications. The proposed consistency module is integrated as a cascaded post-processing stage for vehicle heading estimation.

AI.tldr: 提出基于雷达物理模型的"一致性评估"框架，用遮挡相关边缘可见性、方位/角度相关RCS和轮毂微多普勒特征生成AI估计目标的期望雷达签名，并以Wasserstein距离在三个互补特征上度量与实测点云的一致性，作为级联后处理修正车辆朝向估计。
AI.motivation: 数据驱动雷达感知模型内部决策与雷达物理机理脱耦，导致参数统计精度高但物理不自洽，尤其在新场景下朝向估计错误会误导轨迹预测与前碰撞评估。
AI.method: 构建物理参考模型由AI估计参数生成期望雷达签名（含遮挡依赖边缘可见性、角度相关RCS、轮毂MD特征），再用基于边缘空间分布、局部检测数与反射强度的Wasserstein一致性度量与观测点云计算偏差；无需重训练或改网络结构，作为级联后处理模块。
AI.result: 摘要未给出具体实验数值，仅声明��识别并修正物理上不合理的目标假设，且方法与网络架构无关、可独立集成到朝向估计后处理。
AI.conclusion: 将感知输出与雷达物理先验显式对齐是一种可插拔、模型无关的验证与纠错范式，对安全关键的汽车雷达感知具有实用价值。

title: Trusting Imagined Futures: Auditing Imagined Rewards for VLA Post-Training
summary: Video world models enable candidate actions to be evaluated through imagined outcomes, but high predicted rewards can favor trajectories with poor execution quality. We introduce Trusting Imagined Futures (TIF), an offline supervision selection method for vision-language-action (VLA) post-training that audits predicted rewards using execution feedback. A multidimensional reward model predicts a utility score for candidate ranking and five dimensions of execution quality. An auditor uses reward predictions and uncertainty to identify overestimation patterns learned from paired imagined videos and real executions. TIF accepts the candidate with the highest predicted utility when its advantage over the existing trajectory exceeds a margin and its audit risk passes a threshold; otherwise, it retains the existing supervision. The retained real trajectories then supervise behavior cloning. Across four LIBERO suites and three training seeds, TIF achieves a mean success rate of 76.25%, improving over training on the existing trajectories by 3.00 percentage points with the same trajectory count and training budget. Adding audit gating yields 1.47 percentage points with the reward model and advantage margin held fixed. The gains persist against advantage ranking and logistic regression risk selection at matched replacement counts. On recorded videos from three real robot tasks, TIF increases clean completion among selected trajectories from 58.33% to 70.00% across 60 candidate pools.

AI.tldr: TIF：用执行反馈审计想象视频预测奖励的离线监督筛选方法，提升VLA后训练轨迹质量与成功率。
AI.motivation: 视频世界模型可通过想象结果评估候选动作，但高预测奖励可能偏向执行质量差的轨迹；需将奖励预测与真实执行质量对齐。
AI.method: 多维奖励模型给出效用分及五个执行质量维度；审计器结合奖励预测与不确定性，基于成对的想象视频—真实执行学习过估计模式；仅当候选效用相对现有轨迹优势超过margin且审计风险低于阈值时替换，否则保留原轨迹；用筛选后的真实轨迹做行为克隆。
AI.result: LIBERO四套件、三个种子平均成功率76.25%，较原轨迹提升3.00pp（同等轨迹数与训练预算）；审计门控单独贡献1.47pp；优于advantage ranking与逻辑回归风险选择；三个真机任务60个候选池中干净完成率58.33%→70.00%。
AI.conclusion: 显式审计想象奖励过估计可有效提升VLA后训练监督选择质量，兼具仿真与真机视频证据。

title: OCR in the Foundation Model Era: From Specialist Models to Unified Models
comment: 21 pages, 7 figures, 7 tables. Resources: this https URL
summary: Optical Character Recognition (OCR) is among the oldest and most widely deployed applications of artificial intelligence. This survey reviews its development, focusing on the Foundation Model Era. We define OCR through faithful transcription: within a specified visual scope, OCR should completely reconstruct the text, notation, and document structure observable in the source image, and every textual, notational, or structural element in the output must be verifiable from visual evidence in that image. We trace the development from specialist OCR models toward unified models, examining joint text detection and recognition, structured sequence generation, and the use of pretrained vision-language models (VLMs). We organize contemporary OCR systems into five coexisting families: modular toolkits and task-specific models, specialized document VLMs, hybrid workflows, general-purpose VLMs, and commercial products and managed services. We compare their architectures, data, and training, examining hallucination and omission, insufficient spatial grounding, and inference cost in generative OCR. We review evaluation from character and scene text recognition to parsing individual structural elements and full-page transcription, highlighting gaps in consistent output definitions, attribution of performance to individual components, and coverage of real capture conditions and visible content and structure. Finally, we summarize the challenges facing OCR and discuss directions for future research. We continuously track related work at this https URL .

AI.tldr: OCR综述：以“忠实转录”定义OCR，梳理从专用模型到统一模型的演进，归纳五大类当代系统（模块化工具、专用文档VLM、混合流程、通用VLM、商业服务），并讨论幻觉/漏检、空间定位不足、推理成本与评测缺口。
AI.motivation: 基础模型时代的OCR范式（生成式端到端转录、文档VLM、通用VLM）快速发展，原有任务定义、系统分类与评测体系已不一致，缺少统一的“忠实转录”视角与批判性梳理。
AI.method: 综述性研究：以“输出中每个文本/符号/结构元素都能由图像视觉证据验证”为核心准则重新界定OCR；沿检测识别联合、结构化序列生成、预训练VLM三条技术脉络追踪演进；对五类系统在架构、数据与训练上做对比分析，并系统检视生成式OCR的幻觉、漏检、空间grounding不足与推理开销。
AI.result: 给出五类共存系统谱系的分类与对比框架；识别出生成式OCR的典型失效模式；指出评测层面的三项缺口：输出定义不一致、性能难以归因到单个组件、对真实拍摄条件及可见内容/结构覆盖不足；并维护持续更新的相关工作报告。
AI.conclusion: OCR正由专用流水线走向统一的多模态生成模型，但“忠实转录”的可验证性、细粒度空间定位与低成本推理仍是关键挑战，未来需在定义、归因与真实场景评测上建立一致标准。

title: VisSearch-Bench: Evaluating Long Horizon Visual Search in Multimodal Agents
comment: 41 pages, 22 figures
summary: Multimodal agents use web and image tools to answer questions beyond their internal knowledge. Some search tasks use images mainly to identify an initial entity, then rely on text retrieval. These tasks offer limited insight into how agents connect information across images, objects, and search steps. We therefore focus on visual context management. This involves organizing and using visual information and linking it to other findings during search. Visually intensive tasks require agents to combine object appearance, local details, or spatial relations with external information. We introduce VisSearch-Bench, with 204 human-written tasks across 7 main domains and 25 subdomains. It covers Set-wise Visual Search, Sequential Visual Search, Hybrid Wide-Deep Search, Competitive Visual Disambiguation, and Visual-Structure-Guided Search. Each task provides a reference answer, traceable evidence, and scoring rules. Accuracy measures complete task success, while Process Score measures the correctness and completeness of individual results and subquestion answers. Across 16 multimodal models, the best system fully solves only 26.47% of tasks, even with search tools. These results highlight the challenge of linking visual evidence with search results to produce complete answers.

AI.tldr: 提出VisSearch-Bench，含204个人工编写任务、7大领域25个子域，覆盖集合式/序列式视觉搜索、宽深混合搜索、竞争性视觉消歧、视觉结构引导搜索，用Accuracy与Process Score双重评估多模态智能体的视觉上下文管理能力。
AI.motivation: 现有多模态智能体搜索任务多用图像仅定位初始实体，随后依赖文本检索，无法揭示智能体如何跨图像、物体与搜索步骤连接信息。作者因此聚焦"视觉上下文管理"——组织、使用视觉信息并在搜索过程中与其他发现关联，构建视觉密集型、需结合物体外观/局部细节/空间关系与外部信息的评测。
AI.method: 构建VisSearch-Bench：204个人工编写任务，覆盖7个主领域、25个子域，分五类任务（Set-wise、Sequential、Hybrid Wide-Deep、Competitive Visual Disambiguation、Visual-Structure-Guided Search）。每任务提供参考答案、可溯源证据与评分规则；指标为衡量完整任务成功的Accuracy与衡量子问题/中间结果正确性与完备性的Process Score，并在16个多模态模型上评测（含带搜索工具设置）。
AI.result: 即使配备搜索工具，16个多模态模型中最佳系统也仅完全解决26.47%的任务，表明将视觉证据与搜索结果关联并给出完整答案仍极具挑战。
AI.conclusion: 该基准暴露了视觉上下文管理能力的显著缺口，为多模态搜索智能体提供细粒度过程评估范式。

title: Heads That Write, Not Just Point: Image Retrieval Heads in Vision-Language Models
comment: Accepted to NeurIPS 2026
summary: Large vision-language models (LVLMs) can process interleaved text and multiple images in a single context, but how they internally identify the image relevant to a question remains poorly understood. We study this grounding step as in-context image retrieval and introduce ICIR-MCQ, a controlled probe for head-level analysis of image retrieval. Using each head's attention mass over image-token spans, we first identify sparse pointer heads that reliably point to the target image. These heads transfer beyond the probe: a single pointer head is competitive with external vision-language retrievers on a naturalistic multi-image retrieval benchmark, showing that LVLMs contain a strong internal image retrieval signal. Attention alone, however, shows where a head reads from, not what its output passes on to later layers, so we introduce a complementary output-side analysis. For each head, we train a lightweight image retriever on its value-weighted output and use it to identify writer heads, whose outputs contain enough information to identify the target image. Surprisingly, the pointer and writer criteria select substantially different head sets, with only 35 to 47 heads overlapping among the top-100 heads under each criterion. Targeted set-partition ablations show that the heads most important for standard multi-image inference are concentrated in this pointer-writer intersection, while heads selected by only one criterion show less consistent separation from random-head controls. The most consistent causal effects arise from heads selected by both the attention-based pointer and output-side writer criteria. Code and data: this https URL .

AI.tldr: 该论文将LVLM多图上下文中的"定位相关图像"步骤视为上下文图像检索（ICIR），提出ICIR-MCQ探针，从注意力侧（pointer heads）与输出侧（writer heads）两个角度定位负责图像检索的注意力头，并发现两者重叠很少，但因果上最关键的头集中在交集。
AI.motivation: LVLM可在单一上下文处理交错文本与多图，但其内部如何识别与问题相关的图像（grounding步骤）机制不清。
AI.method: 构建受控探针ICIR-MCQ；用每个头在图像token跨度上的注意力质量识别稀疏pointer heads；再对每个头的value加权输出训练轻量图像检索器以识别writer heads；做集合划分消融验证因果重要性。
AI.result: 单个pointer head在自然多图检索基准上可与外部视觉-语言检索器竞争；pointer与writer仅35–47/100重合；标准多图推理最重要的头集中在交集中，仅满足单一判据的头与随机对照区分不明显。
AI.conclusion: 注意力与输出侧提供互补信息，须联合两类判据才能识别真正因果关键的头；LVLM内部存在强图像检索信号。

title: MiCaDe: Online LiDAR-Camera Miscalibration Change Detection for Autonomous Driving
summary: Reliable multi-sensor perception in autonomous vehicles requires accurate calibration between cameras and LiDAR. However, calibration drift is often unavoidable in long-term deployments: vibrations, thermal effects, and minor mechanical shocks may alter the relative pose between sensors, leading to systematic errors in downstream fusion tasks. We propose MiCaDe (Miscalibration Change Detection), an online solution detecting when the extrinsic LiDAR-camera calibration parameters are no longer accurate by means of sequential change detection. MiCaDe requires no calibration targets, or modification of the perception stack, providing low false-alarm rates with negligible computational overhead. Our key insight is that 3D and 2D bounding boxes produced by standard object detectors should remain geometrically consistent under correct calibration. By matching cross-modal detections, we derive geometric consistency metrics that serve as sensitive indicators of extrinsic drift. These metrics are aggregated into fixed-size batches and scored against a reference distribution, producing a likelihood stream that is monitored by a Change Point Model (CPM). Crucially, the CPM accumulates statistical evidence over time, enabling detection of subtle drifts that would otherwise go unnoticed. Experiments on multiple long-sequence datasets and on a real-world dataset with physically induced miscalibration confirm reliable detection under diverse conditions. Code available at: this https URL .

AI.tldr: MiCaDe：利用2D/3D检测框跨模态几何一致性构造似然流，结合变点模型（CPM）在线检测LiDAR-相机外参标定漂移，无需标靶、无需改动感知栈。
AI.motivation: 自动驾驶长期部署中，振动、热效应与轻微机械冲击会导致LiDAR-相机外参漂移，产生下游融合的系统性误差；而在线监测手段缺乏，传统标定需标靶且需重标定流程。
AI.method: 基于标准检测器输出的3D框与2D框在正确标定下应保持几何一致这一假设：跨模态匹配检测结果，导出几何一致性指标作为外参漂移的敏感信号；将指标按固定批量聚合，与参考分布比较得到似然流（likelihood stream），再由变点模型（CPM）监测，通过随时间累积统计证据来检出微弱漂移。无需标定靶标，也不改动感知栈，计算开销可忽略。
AI.result: 在多个长序列数据集以及一个物理注入失配的真实世界数据集上，在多种条件下均实现可靠检测，虚警率低、计算开销可忽略。
AI.conclusion: 感知级几何一致性信号经序贯变点检测可有效实现对LiDAR-相机外参漂移的在线监测，为长期部署的自动驾驶系统提供低成本、易集成的自检能力。

title: EP-LVMQA: Evidence-Preserving Coarse-to-Fine Localization for Low-Quality Long Video Moment Question Answering
comment: 9 pages, 4 figures
summary: Long instructional videos are increasingly used in medical education, industrial training, and procedural knowledge transfer, yet their evidence is often incomplete or unreliable: subtitles may be missing, ASR noisy, OCR sparse, and decisive actions briefly shown without narration. Existing VideoQA systems typically return labels or free-form text, making answer support difficult to inspect. We study Long Video Moment Question Answering (LVMQA), where a system returns timestamped answer-supporting evidence. We propose EP-LVMQA, an evidence-preserving coarse-to-fine framework comprising an Uncertainty-Aware Multimodal Evidence Timeline, a Coarse Evidence Planner, and an Evidence-Conditioned Fine Localizer. An evidence card transfers planner scores, matched cues, source-confidence proxies, modality-specific evidence, neighboring context, and a temporal prior between the latter two modules. On MedVidQA, EP-LVMQA achieves 26.1 R1@0.5 and 31.8 mIoU, improving the strongest non-ours results by 6.3 and 5.1 points. It raises Suff.@2 and Ver.@2 to 25.4 and 22.6, gains of 9.5 and 8.8 points. Under matched low-quality perturbations, average relative degradation is reduced from the strongest non-ours value of 14.6% to 11.1%. On Ego4D-NLQ and QVHighlights, EP-LVMQA remains broadly comparable to established task-specific localization methods.

AI.tldr: 提出 EP-LVMQA 证据保留式由粗到细框架，用于长视频时刻问答（LVMQA），返回带时间戳的证据片段；在 MedVidQA 上显著超过基线，并在低质量扰动下更鲁棒。
AI.motivation: 长教学/流程类视频（医学教育、工业培训）的多模态证据常不完整或不可靠（字幕缺失、ASR 噪声、OCR 稀疏、关键动作无旁白）；现有 VideoQA 只输出标签或自由文本，答案依据难以核查。动机是让系统输出可检验的时间戳证据。
AI.method: EP-LVMQA：①不确定性感知多模态证据时间线（融合字幕、ASR、OCR 等并估计源置信度）；②粗粒度证据规划器给出候选片段打分；③通过"证据卡"（规划器分数、匹配线索、源置信代理、各模态证据、邻域上下文、时间先验）传递给证据条件化的细粒度定位器，实现由粗到细的时间定位。
AI.result: MedVidQA 上 R1@0.5=26.1、mIoU=31.8，较最强非本文基线提升 6.3/5.1 点；Suff.@2=25.4、Ver.@2=22.6，提升 9.5/8.8 点；匹配低质量扰动下平均相对退化从 14.6% 降至 11.1%。Ego4D-NLQ 与 QVHighlights 上与既有专用定位方法大体相当。
AI.conclusion: 证据保留式粗到细检索/定位在长视频、弱多模态证据场景中有效且更鲁棒；但泛化性局限于域内（MedVidQA），在通用时序定位基准上仅持平，未见代码或机器人/具身应用证据。

title: Behind Video Generation: Observations and Insights on Multimodal Understanding from Kling
summary: Video generation has progressed from isolated clips to coherent short-form audiovisual sequences, and the bottleneck is shifting from rendering to semantic control. This report summarizes the observations and insights on multimodal understanding gained from successive generations of Kling. We argue that generation quality is the projection of multimodal understanding through the entire data--conditioning--alignment--evaluation chain, and we examine this chain module by module. Kling-MLLM, a shared multimodal foundation model that unifies image, video, audio, synchronized audio--video, and interleaved inputs, is specialized for each downstream module. Because a DiT is trained on far fewer training samples than a language model, we treat captioning as a semantic contract that maximizes description density, and extend it to reference-grounded captioning that makes reference bindings explicit. Prompt enhancement translates user intent into this caption distribution: basic PE is derived from captions of compelling videos and refined with text-level and generator-in-the-loop reinforcement learning, while agentic PE refines the story and retrieves compelling examples. We show that a reliable text encoder comes from perceptual training rather than from stronger language ability, and that candidates can be screened from text alone before end-to-end training. Reward modeling pairs a general reward model for explainable, localized critiques with a decision reward model for fast multidimensional scoring, treating perceptual bandwidth as a first-class design parameter. Finally, we review task-specific automatic evaluation, focusing on protocols that expose scoring shortcuts and help trace failures to their upstream source. We hope these lessons offer practical guidance for building the understanding stack behind controllable video generation.

AI.tldr: 本文是Kling系列的多模态理解技术报告，提出生成质量是"数据—条件—对齐—评估"全链条多模态理解能力的投影，并逐模块介绍共享多模态基座Kling-MLLM、契约式视频描述、两阶段提示增强（含生成器在环RL）以及双层奖励模型。
AI.motivation: 视频生成已从孤立片段走向连贯的短时音视频序列，瓶颈正由渲染质量转向语义控制；因此需要系统总结多模态理解侧的经验，为可控视频生成构建"理解栈"。
AI.method: 以统一图像、视频、音频、音视频同步及交错输入的共享多模态基座模型Kling-MLLM为核心，为各下游模块做专门化：将captioning视为"语义契约"并扩展为参考锚定的描述；提示增强（基础PE由优质视频描述蒸馏并用文本级与生成器在环强化学习优化，agentic PE负责情节精修与样例检索）；论证文本编码器能力来自感知训练而非语言能力，并支持仅凭文本预筛候选；奖励建模采用通用奖励模型（可解释、定位式点评）加决策奖励模型（多维快速打分），将感知带宽视为一阶设计参数；最后梳理任务专属自动评测协议以暴露评分捷径并追溯失败来源。
AI.result: 报告形式给出的是经验性观察与技术主张而非定量基准结果：指出DiT训练样本远少于语言模型、故需高密度描述；文本编码器可靠性源于感知训练；可由文本先筛候选降低端到端训练成本；双层奖励模型兼顾可解释性与效率。
AI.conclusion: 可控视频生成的上限由数据、条件、对齐、评估全链条的多模态理解质量共同决定，需要一个统一且模块化专门化的理解栈来支撑。

title: VISTA: Vision-Language Integrated Semantic Triage Architecture for Online Face Clustering in Long Videos
comment: Accepted at ACM Multimedia 2026 (MM '26). 17 pages, including 8 pages of supplementary material
summary: Clustering faces by identity in long, continuous video streams is a challenging task that serves as a building block for human-centric video analysis. The majority of existing face clustering models are offline, i.e., they assume the entire data to be available altogether. In many practical scenarios, however, the entire data is either unavailable or poses computational challenges to be processed in its entirety. A handful of online methods that exist rely on geometric visual features and simple thresholding techniques, which fail when the faces exhibit significant appearance variations in long, unconstrained videos. To this end, we present VISTA, the first vision language framework for online face clustering in long videos. VISTA leverages semantic reasoning in a controlled, uncertainty aware fashion to maintain both high cluster purity and long range identity continuity.
