This makes it robust to the variations in illumination, pose, and costume changes that the faces and characters exhibit in long real world videos. Extensive experiments on the VPCD benchmark dataset (with 15 full episodes from The Big Bang Theory [2007-2019], Buffy the Vampire Slayer [1997-2003], and Sherlock [2010-2017]) demonstrate that VISTA achieves a robust precision and recall balance, consistently improving over the strongest matched online unsupervised baseline (COFC) under identical detector, embeddings, and evaluation protocol. Code and supplementary material: this https URL .

AI.tldr: VISTA 是首个面向长视频在线人脸聚类的视觉-语言框架，利用受控、不确定性感知的语义推理维持高聚类纯度与长程身份连续性。
AI.motivation: 现有离线人脸聚类需全量数据；少量在线方法依赖几何视觉特征与简单阈值，在长且无约束的视频中面对光照、姿态、服装剧变时失效。
AI.method: 在线框架，结合视觉嵌入与视觉-语言模型的语义推理，以不确定性感知方式控制更新决策，从而在流式场景下判断新检测人脸是否归属已有身份簇。
AI.result: 在 VPCD 基准（《生活大爆炸》《吸血鬼猎人巴菲》《神探夏洛克》共 15 集完整剧集）上，在相同检测器、嵌入与评测协议下，精度/召回平衡稳定优于最强匹配在线无监督基线 COFC。
AI.conclusion: 语义推理可有效提升长视频身份聚类的鲁棒性，为以人为中心的视频分析提供可用的在线构建模块。

title: Robustness Verification against Patch Attacks via Group-Lasso Semidefinite Relaxation
summary: Robustness verification is essential for ensuring the safety and security of neural networks, but current methods focus heavily on norm-ball attacks, which do not adequately model typical real-world threats that present physical perturbations, known as patch attacks. A naive approach requires computationally prohibitive enumeration of all possible patch positions. To address the challenge, we propose a novel neural network verification method specialized to the patch-attack threat. Instead of enumerating patch locations, we first model the patch attack with group-wise sparsity and formulate its verification methods as a mixed-integer semidefinite program (MISDP) by applying SDP relaxation to the neural network. We then propose three relaxations, including Group-Lasso relaxation, that remove the integer variables while preserving the sparse, group-wise structure of the original attack, enabling substantially efficient verification. Our empirical analysis demonstrates that the proposed relaxations require less than 3% of the computation time of the original MISDP, while the Group-Lasso relaxation incurs only a 0.34\% average increase in the objective value over the original formulation. Furthermore, Group-Lasso achieves a verified rate of 91%, compared with under 70% for prior methods.

AI.tldr: 提出针对 patch（局部块）攻击的神经网络鲁棒性验证：用组稀疏建模攻击，构造混合整数半定规划（MISDP），并提出三种消去整数变量的松弛（含 Group-Lasso 松弛）以实现高效验证。
AI.motivation: 现有验证方法以范数球攻击为主，难以刻画真实世界中的物理扰动（patch 攻击）；而直接枚举所有 patch 位置计算代价过高。
AI.method: 将 patch 攻击表示为组稀疏扰动，结合网络 SDP 松弛得到 MISDP；提出 Group-Lasso 等三种松弛，去掉整数变量同时保留组稀疏结构，从而高效求解。
AI.result: 松弛方法计算时间不足原 MISDP 的 3%，Group-Lasso 的目标值仅平均增加 0.34%，验证通过率达 91%，而此前方法低于 70%。
AI.conclusion: 面向 patch 攻击的组稀疏松弛验证在效率与精度间取得良好权衡，显著优于已有方法。

title: HTNN-MSC: Multi-view Subspace Clustering with a Hyperbolic Tangent Tensor Low-Rank Surrogate
comment: Preprint. Experiments on 23 benchmark datasets
summary: High-order dependencies among views can be modeled by tensor singular value decomposition (t-SVD) in multi-view subspace clustering. However, the tensor nuclear norm often used with this framework assigns the same asymptotic marginal penalty to singular values of different magnitudes, which may excessively shrink dominant components that encode cluster structure. We propose HTNN-MSC, which replaces this norm with a bounded hyperbolic tangent tensor rank surrogate. The surrogate is strictly concave on the positive half-axis and has a Lipschitz continuous derivative. Its marginal penalty decreases as singular values grow. We develop an alternating direction method of multipliers solver in which the tensor subproblem decomposes into scalar frequency-domain shrinkage problems. Safeguarded multi-start Newton iterations and candidate-objective comparison implement the resulting hyperbolic tangent thresholding operator. The shape parameter is scaled by the input spectrum. We also establish o-minimal definability of the augmented objective. Under explicit boundedness, descent, relative-error, and exact-block conditions, the Kurdyka-Lojasiewicz framework guarantees convergence of the full sequence to a KKT point. On 23 datasets, HTNN-MSC achieves a mean clustering accuracy of 0.8404 and an average accuracy rank of 2.78 against nine representative methods. Friedman tests and Holm-adjusted Wilcoxon comparisons reveal significant overall differences, although several pairwise differences remain nonsignificant. HTNN-MSC records 19 wins, one tie, and three losses against the convex t-SVD-MSC skeleton. A same-skeleton ablation also shows that the proposed surrogate does not uniformly outperform alternative nonconvex penalties.

AI.tldr: 提出HTNN-MSC：以有界双曲正切张量秩代理（凹、边际惩罚随奇异值增大而递减）替代t-SVD多视图子空间聚类中的张量核范数，构造ADMM+频域标量收缩+多起点Newton阈值算子，并用KL框架证明收敛性。
AI.motivation: 多视图子空间聚类中t-SVD框架常用的张量核范数对所有奇异值施加相同的渐进边际惩罚，会过度收缩编码簇结构的主成分，破坏判别信息。
AI.method: 设计严格凹且导数Lipschitz的bounded tanh张量秩代理，边际惩罚随奇异值增大而减小；ADMM求解，张量子问题分解为频域逐元素标量收缩，用带保护的multi-start Newton与候选目标比较实现tanh阈值算子；形状参数按输入谱尺度缩放。理论上证明增广目标的o-minimal可定义性，在明确的有界性、下降、相对误差与精确块条件（intra/inter）、相对误差与精确块条件（inter/intra）下用Kurdyka-Łojasiewicz框架证全序列收敛到KKT点。
AI.result: 23个数据集上平均聚类精度0.8404，对9种代表性方法平均精度排名2.78；Friedman检验与Holm校正Wilcoxon检验显示总体差异显著，但部分成对差异不显著；与凸t-SVD-MSC骨架相比19胜1平3负；同骨架消融显示该代理并非一致优于其他非凸惩罚。
AI.conclusion: 非凸有界张量秩代理在t-SVD多视图聚类中有效且带收敛保证，但优势有限且依赖骨架与数据；属于方法学改进型工作，与具身智能主线关联较弱。

title: Learning Where to Look: Observation Policy Optimization for Thinking with Images
comment: Accepted at NeurIPS 2026. Project page: this https URL
summary: Complex visual question answering often requires vision-language models to think with images, i.e., actively acquire local visual evidence by zooming into informative regions of high-resolution images. Our error analysis shows that many failures in this setting originate from incorrect observation actions, where the model fails to localize key regions or obtain crops that contain sufficient evidence for answering. We further observe that bounding-box tokens exhibit substantially higher generation entropy than ordinary language tokens, indicating high uncertainty when the model decides where to look. However, existing reinforcement learning methods based on final-answer rewards provide only trajectory-level feedback, making it difficult to assign precise credit to the observation actions. We propose Observation Policy Optimization (OPO), an RL algorithm for optimizing observation actions in tool-augmented thinking with images. OPO consists of two core modules. First, Uncertainty-Guided Observation Branching (UOB) treats each image zoom-in tool call as an observation event and selectively branches at high-uncertainty, low-redundancy events during rollout, enabling efficient exploration of alternative cropping decisions and their resulting visual evidence. Second, Evidence-Localized Advantage Attribution (ELAA) compares sibling branches using local evidence-sufficiency rewards and assigns credit only to the corresponding observation-action tokens. By decoupling observation-action optimization from trajectory-level outcome supervision, OPO improves visual evidence acquisition and further enhances visual reasoning performance. Experiments show that OPO consistently improves Qwen3-VL models across scales and achieves competitive performance against larger models and tool-augmented baselines. Code is publicly available.

AI.tldr: 提出观察策略优化OPO，用不确定性引导的分支与证据局部化优势归因，为"以图思考"中的图像缩放动作提供token级信用分配。
AI.motivation: 复杂VQA中视觉语言模型需主动放大高分辨率图像以获取局部证据，但错误分析显示大量失败源于错误的观察动作（定位错误或裁剪证据不足）；且边界框token的生成熵显著高于普通语言token，说明"看哪里"的决策高度不确定。现有基于最终答案奖励的RL只提供轨迹级反馈，难以对观察动作精准信用分配。
AI.method: OPO包含两个模块：(1) 不确定性引导观察分支(UOB)：将每次图像放大工具调用视为观察事件，在rollout中对高不确定性、低冗余的事件选择性分支，高效探索替代裁剪决策及其视觉证据；(2) 证据局部化优势归因(ELAA)：用局部证据充分性奖励比较兄弟分支，仅对相应观察动作token分配信用，从而将观察动作优化与轨迹级结果监督解耦。
AI.result: 实验表明OPO在多个规模的Qwen3-VL上一致提升性能，并与更大模型及工具增强基线相比具有竞争力；代码已开源。
AI.conclusion: 通过将观察动作优化从结果监督中解耦，OPO提升视觉证据获取质量并进一步增强视觉推理，为工具增强的 thinking-with-images 提供细粒度信用分配范式。

title: How Well Does Webcam Eye Tracking Work "in the Wild"? A Large-Scale Validation of Chiasm and a Comparison with WebGazer
comment: 37 pages, 21 figures, 2 tables
summary: Webcam eye tracking can greatly accelerate data collection in basic and applied research by reaching large, diverse samples of participants online. However, its spatial performance is considered well below that of hardware-based systems, limiting its use. We evaluated the first-generation Chiasm webcam eye tracker in a large online study ($N = 505$) spanning diverse participants, devices, and recording conditions. Chiasm achieved a mean spatial accuracy of 2.39 cm ($\approx 2.28^\circ$ at 60 cm), spatial precision (SD) of 1.05 cm ($\approx 1.00^\circ$ at 60 cm), and sample-to-sample precision (RMS-S2S) of 1.29 cm ($\approx 1.23^\circ$ at 60 cm). For the 91% of participants who met a 3 cm calibration criterion, spatial accuracy was 2.15 cm ($\approx 2.05^\circ$ at 60 cm). After three minutes of a task that encouraged head movement, spatial accuracy declined by 0.59 cm, while the gaze center at each target shifted by a mean distance of only 0.37 cm. On the validation block, the offset was 0.30 cm larger for men than for women. Age, region of residence, face luminance, and Michelson contrast showed no reliable relationship with spatial accuracy. A higher eye aspect ratio, a more open eye, was associated with a smaller offset. Wearing glasses decreased spatial accuracy on every validation block. In a comparison between a random subsample ($N = 101$) and a separate sample tested with the open-source tracker WebGazer ($N = 101$) using an identical protocol, Chiasm showed better spatial accuracy (2.18 vs. 4.51 cm) and spatial precision (SD; 1.01 vs. 1.55 cm). WebGazer showed better sample-to-sample precision (RMS-S2S; 0.79 vs. 1.26 cm), which likely reflects conservative, over-smoothed estimates rather than superior stability. These results suggest that Chiasm is narrowing the gap between webcam and hardware-based eye tracking, making large-scale gaze research "in the wild" a reality.

AI.tldr: 大规模在线研究（N=505）评估第一代 Chiasm 网络摄像头眼动追踪器：平均空间精度 2.39 cm（约 2.28°@60cm），空间精密度 SD 1.05 cm，样本间精密度 RMS-S2S 1.29 cm；满足 3 cm 校准标准的 91% 受试者精度达 2.15 cm。与 WebGazer 同协议对比（各 N=101）中 Chiasm 精度与 SD 更优（2.18 vs 4.51 cm；1.01 vs 1.55 cm），但 RMS-S2S 较差。
AI.motivation: 网络摄像头眼动追踪可在线触达大样本、多样化被试，显著加速基础与应用研究的数据采集；但其空间性能长期被认为远低于硬件式追踪器，限制了实用性。作者希望量化新一代（第一代 Chiasm）系统的真实场景性能边界，并识别影响精度的被试与环境因素。
AI.method: 在多样化被试、设备与录制条件下开展大规模在线研究（N=505），报告空间精度、空间精密度（SD）与样本间精密度（RMS-S2S），并用 3 cm 校准标准筛选子集。设计含鼓励头部运动的 3 分钟任务，量化漂移（精度下降 0.59 cm、注视中心位移 0.37 cm）。分析性别、年龄、居住地区、面部亮度、Michelson 对比度、眼睛纵横比（EAR）、是否戴眼镜与验证块偏移的关系。另以随机子样本（N=101）与 WebGazer（N=101）在完全相同协议下做对照比较。
AI.result: 整体精度 2.39 cm（≈2.28°@60cm）、SD 1.05 cm、RMS-S2S 1.29 cm；合格子集精度 2.15 cm。头部运动任务后精度下降 0.59 cm，但各目标注视中心仅平均偏移 0.37 cm。验证块上男性偏移比女性大 0.30 cm；年龄、地区、面部亮度与对比度无可靠关联；EAR 更高（眼睛更睁开）与更小偏移相关；戴眼镜在每个验证块均降低精度。对比 WebGazer：Chiasm 精度（2.18 vs 4.51 cm）与 SD（1.01 vs 1.55 cm）更优，RMS-S2S 更差（1.26 vs 0.79 cm），作者认为后者源于 WebGazer 过度平滑的保守估计而非更优稳定性。
AI.conclusion: Chiasm 类网络摄像头眼动追踪正在缩小与硬件式系统的性能差距，使"in the wild"大规模注视研究具备可行性；同时提示头部运动漂移、戴眼镜与眼睛张开度是需控制的关键误差源。

title: PATTS: Parallel-Aware Test-Time Scaling for Thought-Image Generation in Multimodal Discrete Diffusion LLMs
comment: Accepted in WACV 2027
summary: Test-time scaling (TTS) improves generative models by allocating additional inference-time computation to sampling, search, and verification. Existing image generation approaches, however, typically rank completed images or image-centric intermediate states. We study TTS for parallel multimodal discrete diffusion language models, in which reasoning tokens and image tokens are decoded jointly within a single generation trajectory. We first diagnose a limitation of conventional final-image selection: on GenEval, a CLIP-style image-prompt score is weakly aligned with within-prompt compositional correctness, leaving substantial headroom between verifier selection and oracle selection. We then propose PATTS, a novel parallel-aware TTS framework that searches over intermediate thought-image states using cross-modal verifier signals. PATTS uses a state-dependent reliability weight, derived from model-internal trajectory diagnostics, to modulate the influence of external semantic verification during generation. In the fixed N=32 evaluation on MMaDA-Parallel, the PATTS reaches a GenEval score of 0.844, compared with 0.628 without TTS, 0.787 for Best-of-N, and 0.810 for FKD. These results show that reliability-aware trajectory verification can improve test-time selection for parallel thought-image co-generation under the evaluated search budget. Our code release is at this https URL

AI.tldr: PATTS：面向并行多模态离散扩散模型的"思维-图像"中间状态测试时缩放框架，用模型内部轨迹诊断得到的可靠性权重调节跨模态验证信号，GenEval 0.844（无TTS 0.628）。
AI.motivation: 现有多模态生成TTS只对已完成图像或图像中心中间态做排序，而图像-文本CLIP式打分与提示内组合正确性对齐弱，验证器选择与oracle之间存在显著差距；并行多模态离散扩散模型在单条轨迹中联合解码推理token与图像token，需要状态级、跨模态的搜索信号。
AI.method: 先诊断终图选择与CLIP式图像-提示分数的弱对齐问题；提出PATTS——在中间thought-image状态上进行搜索的并行感知TTS框架，用跨模态验证器信号打分；并引入由模型内部轨迹诊断导出的状态依赖可靠性权重，动态调节外部语义验证的影响强度。固定N=32搜索预算。
AI.result: MMaDA-Parallel上N=32设定：GenEval 0.844 vs 无TTS 0.628、Best-of-N 0.787、FKD 0.810，明显缩小与oracle选择差距；消融体现可靠性加权作用。
AI.conclusion: 可靠性感知的轨迹级验证可有效提升并行thought-image联合生成的测试时选择效果，且在给定搜索预算下成立；为多模态离散扩散的推理期缩放提供了中间态搜索范式。

title: DPAGait: Dynamic Pose-Knowledge-Aware Network for Robust Gait Recognition in the Wild
summary: Gait biometrics aims at identity recognition by appearance or pose features captured during unconstrained human walking. Existing methods predominantly rely on binary silhouette images, inherently characterized by low information entropy, and fail to fully utilize the dynamic information in gait sequences, limiting their ability to handle cross-time variations effectively. Consequently, these methods encounter significant challenges in the wild. They are susceptible to variations in clothing, carried objects, and viewpoints, as well as dynamic environmental conditions, all of which lead to substantial degradation in recognition accuracy and robustness. To overcome these challenges, we propose a pose-knowledge-aware approach specifically designed for robust gait recognition in the wild. First, we propose a novel Dynamic Pose-Parsing enhanced Silhouette gait representation paradigm that substantially enhances the information entropy and effectively captures fine-grained behavioral cues by integrating pose-parsing cues with traditional silhouettes. Subsequently, we develop a dual-branch Dynamic Pose-Knowledge-Aware Gait network. The framework consists of two complementary branches: (1) a 2D dynamic pose-aware branch that extracts pose-enhanced features from our proposed DPPS representations, and (2) a 3D Skinned Multi-Person Linear branch that leverages the 3D SMPL model to capture rich and comprehensive 3D dynamic pose information. Finally, the features are integrated to facilitate accurate and robust gait recognition. Extensive experiments on four challenging in-the-wild gait datasets demonstrate the effectiveness and generalizability of the proposed DPPS representation. The complete framework is further evaluated on SUSTech1K, CCPG, and Gait3D, where SMPL information is available or can be consistently estimated, achieving competitive performance under diverse real-world conditions.

AI.tldr: 提出Dynamic Pose-Parsing enhanced Silhouette (DPPS)步态表征，将姿态/解析线索与剪影融合以提升信息熵，并构建2D动态姿态感知+3D SMPL双分支网络做野外步态识别。
AI.motivation: 现有步态识别依赖低信息熵的二值剪影，未能充分利用步态序列的动态信息，导致对服装、携带物、视角变化与复杂环境鲁棒性差，野外场景精度明显下降。
AI.method: 1) DPPS表征范式：将姿态-解析线索与剪影结合，增强信息熵并捕捉细粒度行为线索；2) 双分支Dynamic Pose-Knowledge-Aware Gait网络：2D分支从DPPS提取姿态增强特征，3D分支利用SMPL模型捕获三维动态姿态信息；3) 融合两分支特征进行识别。
AI.result: 在四个野外步态数据集上验证了DPPS表征的有效性与泛化性；在SUSTech1K、CCPG、Gait3D（SMPL可得或可稳定估计）上取得有竞争力的性能。
AI.conclusion: 用姿态知识与3D人体参数模型增强剪影表征可有效缓解野外步态识别的协变量干扰，是鲁棒步态识别的可行路线。

title: Safeguarding Multi-Agent Reinforcement Learning for Connected and Automated Vehicles with Recursively Feasible Control Barrier Functions
summary: Multi-Agent Reinforcement Learning (MARL) shows promise in coordinating connected and automated vehicles but offers no safety guarantee. Although Control Barrier Functions (CBFs) can add this guarantee, their optimization problem can become infeasible in practice due to control bounds. Moreover, they often overapproximate vehicle and road geometry, which makes them conservative. This paper proposes the Backup-Horizon CBF (BH-CBF), which evaluates safety along a horizon until all vehicles stop. BH-CBF is recursively feasible under control bounds, and it considers the exact vehicle and road geometry. Based on BH-CBF, we derive a fully decentralized safety filter that only needs a single broadcast of vehicle states and routes per step and stays real-time in dense traffic. We use BH-CBF to safeguard a MARL policy over its life cycle: as a reward during pre-training, as a run-time filter at deployment, and as a filter in the training loop that keeps fine-tuning on unseen maps collision-free. In simulations on real-world maps of a roundabout and an intersection, BH-CBF avoids all collisions of unsafe MARL policies and keeps its safety guarantee at every step. Existing filters either collide, lose the guarantee, or fall back to full braking far more often. In recorded roundabout traffic with 1264 human-driven vehicles over 115 km, our safeguarded policies shorten the median travel time by 14% compared with the human drivers, without any collision.

AI.tldr: 提出 Backup-Horizon CBF (BH-CBF)，沿“所有车辆停车”的时域评估安全性，具控制有界下的递归可行性并考虑精确车辆/道路几何；据此构造仅需每步一次广播的全分布式实时安全滤波器，并在 MARL 全生命周期（预训练奖励、部署时过滤、微调闭环过滤）中使用。
AI.motivation: MARL 可协调网联自动驾驶车辆但无安全保证；传统 CBF 因控制上下界导致优化不可行，且对车辆与道路几何做过近似而过于保守。
AI.method: BH-CBF：以停车时域（backup horizon）上的可达/制动可行性定义安全约束，保证控制有界下的递归可行性，并使用精确几何；基于该约束推导去中心化安全滤波器，每步只需一次车辆状态与路径广播；将 BH-CBF 作为预训练奖励、部署期运行时滤波器、以及微调循环中的过滤项三重使用。
AI.result: 在真实地图的环岛与路口仿真中，BH-CBF 使不安全的 MARL 策略零碰撞且每步保持安全保证；对比滤波器则出现碰撞、丧失保证或更频繁地退化为全力制动。在含 1264 辆人驾车、115 km 的真实环岛轨迹上，受保护策略相较人类驾驶员中位通行时间缩短 14%，且无碰撞。
AI.conclusion: BH-CBF 为 MARL 自动驾驶提供了兼具实时性、分布式性与递归可行性的安全保证框架，并在真实交通数据上同时提升效率与安全，可作为安全层嵌入学习型策略的全生命周期。

title: Lightweight graph transformers for clutter and target classification in automotive radar
comment: Accepted to the IEEE Sensors Journal Volume 26 Issue 6
summary: Radar is a core sensor modality for scene perception to achieve higher levels of autonomy in automotive driving. A common occurrence in automotive radars is clutter - detections of non-existent moving objects, that can adversely impact target detection and classification performance and subsequent driving actions. We propose lightweight tiny graph transformer network (TGTNet) models for classifying clutter from stationary and moving targets in the scene. Performance evaluation on the public RadarScenes show that our proposed TGTNet models achieve similar classification performance in precision and recall metrics in comparison to state of the art models, with one to two orders of magnitude lower model size and significantly faster inference.

AI.tldr: 提出轻量级Tiny Graph Transformer网络(TGTNet)，将雷达点云建模为图，用于区分非目标的杂波(clutter)与静止/运动目标，在RadarScenes上以1-2个数量级更小的模型规模和显著更快的推理达到SOTA相当的精度与召回。
AI.motivation: 车载雷达普遍存在对不存在运动物体的虚假检测（杂波），会损害目标检测/分类性能并误导下游驾驶决策；现有去杂波/分类模型体积大、推理慢，难以部署到资源受限的车载嵌入式平台。
AI.method: 构建tiny graph transformer：先以图结构表示雷达检测点（节点为点级特征，边为近邻空间关系），再用轻量化transformer层在图上做局部/全局关系聚合，从而在极小参数量下完成杂波与静止/运动目标的多类别判别。具体图构建细节与剪枝/降维策略需见正文。
AI.result: 在公开数据集RadarScenes上，TGTNet的precision与recall与SOTA模型相当，同时模型规模降低1–2个数量级，推理速度显著提升。
AI.conclusion: 轻量图transformer是雷达点云杂波分类的一种高效可行方案，兼顾精度与车载实时性约束；属于感知层面的鲁棒性增强工作，但场景限于单帧雷达点级分类，缺乏时序建模与实车闭环验证。

title: An Agentic Framework for Quality-Aware and Scenario-Adaptive Image Compression
summary: Despite decades of progress, image codecs remain difficult to adapt to diverse real-world compression scenarios for two main reasons. First, most image codecs are optimized for a specific objective and require substantial redevelopment when the compression goal changes. Second, they typically assume clean inputs, whereas sensor-captured images often contain degradations that alter rate-quality behavior. To address these challenges, we propose Practical Image Coding Agents (PICA), a multi-agent framework that adapts existing codecs to diverse user requirements and potentially degraded inputs. PICA consists of four collaborative agents: a Perception agent that interprets user intent and analyzes image content, an Improvement agent that jointly considers bitrate and reconstruction quality to guide pre-coding restoration, a Coding agent that refines quality-control settings from global to regional levels, and an After-coding improvement agent that addresses residual degradations and compression-induced artifacts through restoration guided solely by image quality. To enable codec-agnostic regional adaptation, we introduce Agentic ROI Coding (AROIC), which treats the codec as a black box and allows the agent to automatically schedule, execute, evaluate, and reflect ROI coding plans without architectural modifications or codec-specific retraining. We integrate these four agents with a Scenario-Guided Quality-Rate (SGQR) evaluation strategy to enable more effective scenario-adaptive compression across heterogeneous codecs. Comprehensive experiments on clean, noisy, and blurred images across standard, perceptual, and machine-vision compression scenarios demonstrate that PICA consistently enhances the compression performance of both the conventional H.266/VVC codec and the neural Cheng2020 codec, outperforming competing compression methods on the Kodak, CLIC2020, and HEVC datasets.

AI.tldr: PICA: a four-agent framework (Perception / Improvement / Coding / After-coding) that adapts existing black-box codecs to diverse user intents and degraded inputs, with Agentic ROI Coding (AROIC) for codec-agnostic regional quality control and SGQR scenario-guided rate-quality evaluation.
AI.motivation: Existing image codecs are (1) optimized for a single fixed objective and require redevelopment when the compression goal changes (human perception vs. machine vision vs. fidelity), and (2) assume clean inputs, while sensor-captured images often contain noise/blur that shifts rate-quality behavior. A general, codec-agnostic adaptation mechanism is needed.
AI.method: Multi-agent LLM-style framework wrapping an arbitrary codec as a black box: Perception agent parses user intent and image content; Improvement agent jointly weighs bitrate and reconstruction quality to guide pre-coding restoration; Coding agent refines quality-control parameters from global to regional granularity via AROIC (schedule-execute-evaluate-reflect on ROI coding plans, no architecture change or codec-specific retraining); After-coding agent performs quality-only-guided restoration of residual degradation and compression artifacts. Coupled with Scenario-Guided Quality-Rate (SGQR) evaluation for scenario-adaptive compression.
AI.result: Consistently improves compression performance for both conventional H.266/VVC and neural Cheng2020 across clean, noisy, and blurred inputs, on Kodak, CLIC2020 and HEVC datasets, under fidelity, perceptual and machine-vision objectives; outperforms competing methods.
AI.conclusion: Treating the codec as a black box and letting cooperative agents adapt restoration, rate allocation and ROI scheduling is an effective, codec-agnostic route to scenario-adaptive image compression.

title: Caging Vision-Language Navigation for Legged Robots via Barrier-Certified Safety Architecture
summary: By harnessing the inherent commonsense capabilities of pretrained Large Language Models (LLMs) and Vision-Language Models (VLMs), current Vision-Language Action(VLA) models for legged robots excel at interpreting language-based navigation commands but lack the physical grounding and explicit safety assurance required for real-world operation. Therefore, this paper aims to cage Legged-Vision-Language Navigation (VLN) through a safety architecture that provides physical grounding and ensures navigation safety. The key idea is not to abandon the powerful capabilities of end-to-end VLA planning, but rather to augment and cage them. In particular, we integrate a high-level VLA planner with a low-level physical-grounding layer that leverages efficient state estimation, in-situ 3D spatial perception, and an Signed Distance Field (SDF) representation to generate executable trajectories. We provide a navigation planner with provable collision-avoidance guarantees under the stated assumptions by combining a low-dimensional Bezier-parameterized MPPI planner with Discrete Exponential Barrier Function (dEBF) constraints. The proposed Legged-VLN system is modular, making it compatible with various VLM/VLA models and agnostic to the robot platform. The proposed system is validated with extensive real-world experiments on humanoid and quadrupedal robots, demonstrating versatile, efficient, and safe vision-language driven navigation capabilities.

AI.tldr: 提出"笼式"安全架构：高层VLA/VLM规划器 + 底层物理接地层（高效状态估计、原位3D空间感知、SDF表示），并用Bezier参数化MPPI与离散指数障碍函数(dEBF)约束实现可证碰撞规避，在四足与人形机器人上完成真实世界VLN实验。
AI.motivation: 现有面向足式机器人的VLA模型虽能理解语言导航指令，但缺乏物理接地与显式安全保障，难以支撑真实世界部署；作者不放弃端到端VLA规划能力，而是对其"增强+约束"。
AI.method: 模块化分层系统：高层VLA规划器输出语义目标/子目标；低层物理接地层结合高效状态估计、原位3D空间感知与SDF建图生成可执行轨迹；导航规划采用低维Bezier参数化的MPPI采样优化，并施加离散指数障碍函数(dEBF)约束，从而在既定假设下提供可证明的碰撞规避保证。系统与VLM/VLA模型及机器人平台解耦。
AI.result: 在人形与四足机器人上开展大量真实世界实验，展示多样化、高效且安全的视觉-语言驱动导航能力（摘要未给出定量指标）。
AI.conclusion: 为足式VLN提供了一条"保持VLA端到端能力+增加物理接地与形式化安全层"的可行路径，模块化设计利于跨模型、跨平台复用。

title: LLMs as MDP Designers: A Dependency-Aware Agentic Framework for Automated Robot Policy Generation
comment: Accepted to the 40th Annual Conference on Neural Information Processing Systems (NeurIPS 2026)
summary: We investigate the automated generation of executable robot reinforcement learning (RL) policies from natural-language task descriptions. Rather than using large language models (LLMs) as execution-time decision makers, we use them as designers that construct RL pipelines before deployment, including Markov decision process (MDP) formulation and simulator implementation. We identify a phase-wise structure in this problem: MDP formulation is dependency-structured and sequential, whereas simulator implementation becomes modular once the formulation is fixed. Based on this structure, we propose ARPG, a dependency-aware agentic framework that performs sequential MDP modeling, localized verification and correction, and simulator-structured implementation while externalizing intermediate artifacts. ARPG targets a key failure mode of automated policy generation: executable code may still yield non-learnable policies when state, action, reward, and termination artifacts are not semantically aligned. Experiments in Isaac Sim show that ARPG improves modeling correctness, environment executability, and policy-generation success compared with monolithic LLM baselines and off-the-shelf agentic systems. Additional demonstrations on custom robotics, standard RL, and engineering-domain MDPs further suggest that the same modeling pipeline can be reused beyond the main benchmark suite.

AI.tldr: 提出ARPG：用LLM在部署前设计RL流程（MDP建模+仿真器实现），依赖感知地顺序建模、局部验证纠错、模块化实现，解决"代码可执行但策略不可学习"的语义错配问题。
AI.motivation: 从自然语言任务描述自动生成可执行的机器人RL策略时，若不让LLM做在线决策器而让其做管线设计者，会遇到MDP建模与仿真器实现耦合的困难；且自动化生成的关键失败模式是状态/动作/奖励/终止四要素语义不对齐，导致代码能跑但策略学不出来。
AI.method: 识别任务的阶段性结构：MDP形式化为依赖结构化、顺序性过程，仿真器实现在形式化固定后呈模块化。据此设计ARPG依赖感知智能体框架：顺序MDP建模、局部化验证与修正、按仿真器结构进行模块化实现，并将中间产物外置（externalize）以便检查与复用。
AI.result: 在Isaac Sim实验中，相比单体LLM基线与现成智能体系统，ARPG在建模正确性、环境可执行性和策略生成成功率上均有提升；在自定义机器人、标准RL及工程领域MDP上的额外演示表明该建模范式可跨基准复用。
AI.conclusion: 将LLM定位为部署前的RL管线设计者而非运行时决策者，并以依赖感知的分解+局部验证来保证MDP语义一致性，是实现可靠自动策略生成的有效路径，具备一定跨域迁移性。

title: ProAlign: Progressive Positional and Prototype-Guided Alignment for Aerial-Ground Person Re-Identification
comment: Accepted by NeurIPS 2026
summary: Aerial-Ground Person Re-Identification (AG-ReID) aims to match pedestrian images captured by unmanned aerial vehicles (UAVs) and ground-based surveillance cameras. The task remains highly challenging due to severe viewpoint discrepancies, frequent occlusions, and substantial domain gaps between aerial and ground imagery. Beyond these observable factors, existing methods often overlook two fundamental structural issues: cumulative positional drift during hierarchical feature extraction and semantic inconsistency across cross-view feature distributions. To address these challenges, we propose ProAlign, a Progressive Positional and Prototype-Guided Alignment Network for AG-ReID. ProAlign comprises two key components: a Layer-wise Progressive Positional Embedding (LPPE) module and a View-Aware Prototype Contrastive Learning (PCL) module. LPPE performs adaptive positional calibration throughout transformer layers by employing conditional positional encoding in shallow layers to mitigate local spatial distortions, while introducing learnable static positional embeddings in deeper layers to reinforce global semantic priors. Meanwhile, PCL maintains view-specific aerial and ground prototypes for each identity and enforces cross-view semantic consistency via a dual-prototype contrastive objective. Extensive experiments on CARGO and two real-world AG-ReID benchmarks demonstrate the effectiveness of ProAlign, achieving state-of-the-art overall retrieval performance on CARGO with improvements of 1.60% in Rank-1 accuracy and 5.01% in mAP over the strongest competing methods.

AI.tldr: ProAlign：面向空地行人重识别的分层渐进位置编码（LPPE）+ 视角感知原型对比学习（PCL）对齐网络，在CARGO上Rank-1+1.60%、mAP+5.01%达SOTA。
AI.motivation: AG-ReID面临视角差异、遮挡与空地域鸿沟；作者指出两个被忽视的结构性问题：分层特征提取中的累积位置漂移，以及跨视角特征分布的语义不一致。
AI.method: LPPE在Transformer浅层使用条件位置编码缓解局部空间畸变，深层引入可学习静态位置嵌入强化全局语义先验；PCL为每个身份维护空中与地面两个视角专属原型，用双原型对比目标强制跨视角语义一致。
AI.result: 在CARGO及两个真实场景AG-ReID基准上验证有效性，CARGO整体检索性能SOTA，Rank-1提升1.60%、mAP提升5.01%。
AI.conclusion: 从位置编码与原型语义两个结构性角度对齐空地特征，是一种模块化、可插拔的重识别对齐方案；但属传统CV检索任务，与具身/3D重建/世界模型主线关联弱。

title: For You, Not for Everyone: Bystander-Aware Delivery of Critical Feedback in Robot Tutoring
comment: Submitted for Review
summary: Robots in shared settings may expose information intended for an individual user to nearby bystanders. Robot tutoring makes this concern particularly salient: critical feedback is directed at an individual learner, yet bystanders may overhear or see it. To address this, we compared context-invariant and context-adaptive robot behaviors in a between-subjects study with 40 participants. Following an initial phase without a bystander, a bystander entered the setting. Participants then received two scripted critical feedback messages concerning their pronunciation and handwriting, independent of their actual performance. With the context-invariant behavior, the robot tutor delivered both messages aloud. With the context-adaptive behavior, the robot tutor scanned for the bystander, turned its body and display away after detecting them, gave a spoken attention cue, and presented the same feedback messages silently on its display. Participants rated the robot tutor higher in perceived privacy awareness and perceived social competence in the context-adaptive condition than in the context-invariant condition, while evidence for reduced experienced embarrassment was inconclusive. These findings inform the design and evaluation of robots that respond to bystander presence by adapting how they communicate potentially sensitive information.

AI.tldr: 机器人导师在旁人在场时采用情境自适应行为（侧身、转开屏幕、静默文字反馈+口头提示），相比情境不变行为（直接朗读）提升了用户对隐私意识与社交能力的评价。
AI.motivation: 共享环境中的机器人可能将本应属于个体用户的敏感信息（如批判性学习反馈）暴露给旁观者，机器人辅导场景使这一问题尤为突出，需要研究机器人如何感知并响应旁观者存在。
AI.method: 被试间实验，40名参与者；先无助教/旁观者阶段，随后旁观者进入；机器人给出两条与其实际表现无关的脚本化批判反馈。对照组为情境不变行为（全部大声朗读），实验组为情境自适应行为（扫描旁观者→检测到后转体并侧转屏幕→给出语音注意提示→在屏幕上静默显示反馈）。测量感知隐私意识、感知社交能力与尴尬感。
AI.result: 情境自适应条件下，参与者对机器人导师的感知隐私意识与感知社交能力评分显著高于情境不变条件；关于尴尬感降低的证据不确定。
AI.conclusion: 基于旁观者存在调整敏感信息传达方式，是提升社交机器人隐私感知与社交得体性的有效设计策略，但主观尴尬等情绪层面的收益仍需进一步验证。

title: ScoreDial: Precise Control of Visual Attributes in Image Generation via Regressor Guidance from Limited Human Ratings
comment: Accepted to WACV 2027. 37 pages, 27 figures, 4 tables, including the supplementary material
summary: Requested-value control is stricter than continuous steering: given $c$ on a human-rating scale, the generated image should attain that value from only limited ratings. We present ScoreDial, which fits a differentiable regressor $R$ to 100-479 human-rated images; once $R$ is fixed, a requested value $c$ is defined on its output scale, and learned target conditioning is paired with error-adaptive guidance that repeatedly reduces $|R(\mathbf{x})-c|$ during sampling. Across tire slip resistance, interior visual complexity, food desire-to-eat, and soap translucency, using one set of sampler settings shared across all four, ScoreDial reaches requested values and achieves, on all four attributes, $R$-MAE at most 0.013 over a range of width 0.8 and Spearman $\rho=0.980$, the maximum attainable under our evaluation protocol. Because $R$ also drives sampling, we evaluate agreement with $R$ separately from matched sweeps, an independent auditor fitted to the same ratings on a backbone none of the deployed regressors uses, and blinded human judgments. MPGD-flow also reaches the requested values under $R$, but ScoreDial has larger auditor displacement on every attribute, the largest among all compared methods, and a stronger MPGD-flow setting gives up target agreement without closing this gap. On every attribute, removing target conditioning leaves low $R$-MAE but more than halves auditor displacement, separating precise score correction from attribute movement. Blinded rating studies with 15 raters per attribute show that mean human ratings track $c$ on tire and soap, with linear $R^2=0.665$ and $R^2=0.786$, and in forced-choice comparisons of matched sweeps, raters chose ScoreDial's as the clearer progression in at least 84% of judgments against every baseline.

AI.tldr: ScoreDial：用少量人类评分（100–479 张）拟合可微回归器 R，将其输出尺度上的目标值 c 作为"请求值控制"目标，结合学习式目标条件化与误差自适应引导，在采样中反复压低 |R(x)−c|。四个属性上用同一套采样器设置即达到 R-MAE≤0.013、Spearman ρ=0.980，但与独立审计器的属性位移最大，人类盲评中仅两个属性 R² 显著且强制选择胜率≥84%。
AI.motivation: 连续"转向"只需生成方向大致单调变化的图像，而实际设计需求是"更严格的请求值控制"：给定人类评分刻度上的具体取值 c，生成图像须恰好落在该值，且只能依赖有限的少量人工评分，不依赖大规模偏好数据集或在线人类反馈。
AI.method: 1) 对每个属性用 100–479 张人工评分图像拟合可微回归器 R（proxy 打分器）；2) 固定 R 后将请求值 c 定义在 R 的输出尺度上，采样时引入学习式目标条件化（learned target conditioning）；3) 叠加误差自适应引导（error-adaptive guidance），在去噪每一步按当前 |R(x)−c| 调整引导强度以逐步纠偏；4) 评估上把"与 R 的一致性"与"匹配扫描的属性真实位移"分离：用独立审计器（不同 backbone、同一批评分拟合）与 15 人/属性的盲评、强制选择清晰度比较交叉验证。
AI.result: 四个属性（轮胎抗滑性、内饰视觉复杂度、食物食欲吸引度、肥皂半透明度）共用一套采样设置：R-MAE≤0.013（取值范围宽 0.8），Spearman ρ=0.980（评估协议上限）。MPGD-flow 亦能在 R 上命中目标值，但 ScoreDial 在四个属性上审计器位移均更大（对比方法中最大），且加强 MPGD-flow 会牺牲目标一致而不缩小差距；去掉目标条件化则 R-MAE 仍低但审计器位移减半以上。人类盲评：轮胎 R²=0.665、肥皂 R²=0.786，平均评分随 c 单调；匹配扫描的强制选择中相对每个基线≥84% 判为更清晰的递进。
AI.conclusion: ScoreDial 证明了"低评分预算 + 单可微代理"即可实现刻度级精确的请求值控制，并在多属性间零调参泛化；但其高 R 精度部分源于对代理 R 的过拟合——审计器位移最大揭示了 score hacking 风险，说明"命中 R"与"真实属性移动"必须解耦评估。整体属于可控生成/人机对齐方向的方法工作，与具身智能、VLA、3D/世界模型主线关联较弱。

title: Learned Smartphone ISP on Mobile GPUs: Mobile AI 2026 Challenge Report
summary: With the increasing importance of mobile camera quality in modern smartphones, growing attention has been directed toward computational photography and advanced image signal processing (ISP) algorithms aimed at enhancing various perceptual attributes of captured images. This creates a need for efficient deep learning models for this problem that are not only performant but can also be deployed on constrained mobile hardware. In this Mobile AI challenge, we address this problem and propose the participants to design fast solutions that can reconstruct RGB photos from RAW Bayer camera data while running on popular smartphone GPUs from Qualcomm and Arm. For this, the participants were provided with a large-scale Fujifilm UltraISP dataset consisting of RAW-RGB image pairs captured with the Sony IMX586 Quad Bayer mobile sensor and a professional 102MP medium format FujiFilm GFX100 camera. The runtime of all models was evaluated on the Snapdragon 8 Elite Gen 5 and Dimensity 9500 chipsets with the Adreno and Mali GPUs, respectively. Top solutions proposed in this challenge are able to reconstruct high-quality 5MP RGB image from raw data on both platforms under 100 milliseconds. A comprehensive description of the models developed in the challenge is provided in this paper.

AI.tldr: Mobile AI 挑战赛：在骁龙 8 Elite Gen 5（Adreno）与天玑 9500（Mali）GPU 上，从 Fujifilm UltraISP 数据集的 RAW Bayer 数据在 100ms 内重建 5MP RGB 图像的快速 ISP 方案综述。
AI.motivation: 手机摄影画质日益重要，但 RAW→RGB 的深度学习 ISP 模型需同时满足高感知质量与移动端 GPU 实时部署约束，缺乏统一基准与效率导向的解法。
AI.method: 以 Sony IMX586 Quad Bayer 传感器 RAW 与 102MP 中画幅 Fujifilm GFX100 采集的 RAW-RGB 配对构成大规模 UltraISP 数据集，面向 Qualcomm/Arm GPU 设计轻量高效 ISP 网络；在 Snapdragon 8 Elite Gen 5 与 Dimensity 9500 上做端侧延迟评测。
AI.result: 优胜方案在两个平台均可在 100ms 以内从 RAW 重建高质量 5MP RGB 图像；论文汇总并描述了参赛模型的架构与工程优化。
AI.conclusion: 展示了端侧深度 ISP 在商用手机 GPU 上达到实时、高画质的可行性，为移动计算摄影的高效模型设计提供参考基线。

title: Can saliency maps flag chest radiograph classifier errors at a new hospital? An external validation study
comment: 21 pages, 5 figures, 1 table, 6 Extended Data figures and 4 Extended Data tables. Code: this https URL
summary: Saliency maps are offered as a safeguard for medical image classifiers, but whether they reveal individual errors at a new hospital remains largely untested. We trained a convolutional network and a vision transformer on NIH ChestX-ray14 and evaluated 303,768 decisions per model at the training hospital and at two external sites, in the USA and Vietnam, with radiologist-consensus labels. We scored each explanation by its anatomical enrichment, the area-normalized concentration of attribution in a segmented thoracic region, and tested whether it detects errors beyond the model's confidence. Grad-CAM localized findings less often than radiologists (hit rate at most 0.575 versus 0.888). Adding enrichment to a confidence-based error detector calibrated at the training hospital never raised its area under the curve by more than 0.011, and for the convolutional network the relation between enrichment and correctness reversed between hospitals, degrading the transferred detector. Model confidence, not saliency, should anchor deployment monitoring.

AI.tldr: 在NIH ChestX-ray14上训练的CNN与ViT，在训练医院及美国、越南两家外部医院共评估每模型303,768次判定，检验saliency图的解剖富集度能否检测个体错误：Grad-CAM定位命中率最高仅0.575（放射科医生0.888），富集度加入置信度错误检测器后AUC提升不超过0.011，CNN上富集度与正确性的关系在跨院后反转，导致迁移退化。
AI.motivation: saliency图常被视为医学影像分类器的"安全阀"，但其能否在部署到新医院后揭示个体层面的错误，尚缺乏大规模实证检验。
AI.method: 在NIH ChestX-ray14训练CNN与ViT，在训练院及美国、越南两处外部站点以放射科共识标签评估共303,768×2次判定；以"解剖富集度"（归因在分割胸部分区内的面积归一化集中度）为解释质量指标，并检验其在置信度之外对错误的增量检测能力。
AI.result: Grad-CAM定位命中率≤0.575，远低于放射科医生0.888；在训练院标定的置信度错误检测器上加入富集度，AUC提升不超过0.011；CNN上富集度与正确性的关联跨院反转，使迁移检测器性能下降。
AI.conclusion: saliency图不构成可靠的个体错误监测量；部署监测应以模型置信度而非显著性图为锚点。

title: HiLo-WAM: Decoupling Long-Horizon Task Evolution and Local Dynamics in World Action Models
summary: World Action Models (WAMs) improve robotic manipulation by jointly modeling visual dynamics and robot actions. However, most existing WAMs model dense short-horizon visual dynamics, capturing local interactions but providing limited long-range task context. Extending prediction horizons increases uncertainty and computation while entangling task-level evolution with fine-grained local dynamics, obscuring their dependencies and distinct roles in action generation. We propose HiLo-WAM, which decouples long-horizon task evolution from local visual dynamics while jointly modeling their interaction with robot actions. A sparse long-horizon visual stream captures historical task context and future evolution, while a dense local dynamics visual stream models short-horizon robot-object interactions. The two streams operate at different temporal scales within a unified dual-DiT architecture and guide actions through structured cross-stream attention. Progressive inference further reduces unnecessary computation through stream-wise partial denoising, joint denoising, and dynamic skipping. Experiments demonstrate strong long-horizon manipulation performance: HiLo-WAM achieves a 93.70% average success rate on RoboTwin 2.0 and a 17.43 progress score on RoboDojo long-horizon tasks, with robust in-domain and OOD performance on the Fourier GR-3 robot. Ablations confirm the complementary contributions of long-horizon task evolution and local interaction dynamics, while temporal-scale analyses highlight the importance of balancing temporal coverage and resolution. Progressive inference further achieves a 2.93x speedup while improving performance.

AI.tldr: HiLo-WAM 将长时程任务演化（稀疏视觉流）与局部短时视觉动力学（稠密视觉流）解耦，在统一双 DiT 架构中通过跨流注意力联合建模并与动作生成交互，配合流式渐进推理加速。
AI.motivation: 现有世界动作模型多建模稠密短时程视觉动力学，局部交互强但缺乏长程任务上下文；直接拉长预测时程会引入不确定性、计算开销，并把任务级演化与细粒度局部动力学纠缠在一起，难以区分二者在动作生成中的角色。
AI.method: 双流视觉表征：稀疏长时程流捕捉历史任务上下文与未来演化，稠密局部流建模短时程机器人-物体交互；两流以不同时间尺度在统一 dual-DiT 架构内运行，通过结构化跨流注意力引导动作生成；推理采用渐进式流程（流内部分去噪 → 联合去噪 → 动态跳过）减少冗余计算。
AI.result: RoboTwin 2.0 平均成功率 93.70%，RoboDojo 长时程任务进度分 17.43，Fourier GR-3 真机上具备稳健的域内与 OOD 表现；消融验证长时程演化与局部动力学的互补性，时间尺度分析显示覆盖度与分辨率的平衡很重要；渐进推理带来 2.93× 加速且性能提升。
AI.conclusion: 长时程任务演化与局部视觉动力学应显式解耦并跨尺度耦合，可实现强长时程操作性能与推理效率的双赢。

title: RGB Photo Enhancement with Deep Learning on Smartphone GPUs: Mobile AI 2026 Challenge Report
summary: On-device RGB photo enhancement is a popular task that is needed for quality improvement of photos captured with mobile devices as well as for retouching of images acquired through other sources. This creates a need for efficient deep learning models for this problem that are not only performant but can also be deployed on constrained mobile hardware. In this Mobile AI challenge, we address this problem and propose participants to design fast solutions that can perform comprehensive enhancement of RGB photos while running on popular smartphone GPUs from Qualcomm and Arm. For this, the participants were provided with a large-scale DPED dataset consisting of RGB image pairs captured with an old iPhone 3GS smartphone and a professional Canon 70D DSLR camera. The runtime of all models was evaluated on the Snapdragon 8 Elite Gen 5 and Dimensity 9500 chipsets with the Adreno and Mali GPUs, respectively. Top solutions proposed in this challenge are able to enhance Full HD resolution RGB images on both platforms under 300 milliseconds. A comprehensive description of the models developed in the challenge is provided in this paper.

AI.tldr: Mobile AI 挑战赛综述：面向骁龙与天玑 GPU 的端侧 RGB 照片增强（DPED 数据集：iPhone 3GS 与 Canon 70D 图像对），参赛模型可在 300ms 内完成全高清图像增强。
AI.motivation: 移动端拍摄与二次修图都需要高质量 RGB 图像增强，而现有深度模型难以同时兼顾画质与手机端算力约束，因此需要能在主流手机 GPU 上高效运行的增强方案。
AI.method: 以 DPED 大规模配对数据集为训练基础，在骁龙 8 Elite Gen 5（Adreno）与天玑 9500（Mali）上统一评测模型运行时，征集并汇总低延迟的端侧图像增强网络设计。
AI.result: 优胜方案可在两个平台上以低于 300 ms 的时延增强全高清 RGB 图像，论文对各参赛模型作了系统性描述。
AI.conclusion: 该工作本质是挑战赛总结报告，主要贡献是端侧增强模型的效率基准与工程实践汇总，可作为轻量化 CNN 部署的参考，但缺乏通用方法学创新。

title: Haptic Shared Control for Multi-Robot Systems
comment: PhD thesis, Université de Rennes (IRISA UMR 6074 / Inria Rennes), defended 30 April 2025. 134 pages, 38 figures
summary: Multi-agent systems offer significant advantages in terms of flexibility and redundancy, enabling the efficient distribution of complex tasks among multiple robots. However, their deployment requires advanced control strategies to ensure optimal cooperation between autonomous agents and human operators. We propose a modification of the global connectivity maintenance algorithm to incorporate measurements taken in agent's local frame, using sensors with limited fields of view. This algorithm, responsible for the autonomous behavior of the multi-robot system, is combined with different adaptive supervision strategies, allowing the user to exert control at varying scales over the entire group. (i) Single Agent Control (S): The operator directly controls a single robot, (ii) Pinning Control (P): The operator imposes constraints on multiple robots to influence the group, (iii) Centroid Control (C): The operator acts on the system's center of mass to steer the entire fleet. In conjunction with the connectivity maintenance algorithm, these methods ensure compliance with inter-agent constraints while providing haptic feedback to the user regarding the system's connectivity state. The effectiveness of these approaches was evaluated through a user study, comparing performance with and without haptic feedback across multiple scenarios tailored to the different control modes.

AI.tldr: 提出融合局部坐标系与有限视场传感器测量的全局连通性保持算法，并结合三种自适应监督策略（单机器人控制、钉扎控制、质心控制）实现用户对多机器人集群的多尺度控制与连通性状态力反馈，通过用户实验验证。
AI.motivation: 多机器人系统的灵活性与冗余性需要人类操作员与自主智能体协同，但现有全局连通性保持算法依赖全局坐标系测量，且用户缺少对集群规模可控的监督接口与连通性感知反馈。
AI.method: 将全局连通性保持算法改造为仅使用agent本体坐标系下的局部测量，并考虑有限视场传感器；与三种自适应监督策略组合：(i) 单机器人控制S、(ii) 钉扎控制P（对多个机器人施加约束）、(iii) 质心控制C（作用于系统质心引导整个车队）；同时向用户提供连通性状态的触觉反馈。
AI.result: 通过多场景用户研究，在不同控制模式下对比有无触觉反馈的性能，评估各监督策略与连通性保持算法结合的有效性。
AI.conclusion: 局部信息下的连通性保持算法可与多尺度人机监督策略有效结合，在满足智能体间约束的同时通过触觉反馈增强用户对系统连通状态的感知，多机器人协同任务的可行监督方案具有可操作性。

title: DRAP: Dynamics-Risk Adaptive Plasticity for Continual Learning in Physical AI
summary: Continual learning in physical AI differs from conventional continual learning because small per-step policy errors can accumulate over a trajectory. Each deviation may move the agent outside the training distribution, increase subsequent prediction errors, and ultimately cause closed-loop task failure. This work introduces Dynamics-Risk Adaptive Plasticity (DRAP), a replay-free method that estimates the historical importance of adaptable model tensors from sample-level action gradients weighted by local trajectory-amplification risk. A ridge-regularized local linear model is fitted to expert state-action transitions, and the largest singular value of its state-transition matrix provides a policy-independent, Lyapunov-inspired estimate of one-step perturbation amplification. After each task, risk-weighted squared gradients are accumulated in a tensor-level importance memory. During subsequent tasks, DRAP uses normalized cumulative importance to scale the effective AdamW learning rate of each tensor, immediately reducing the plasticity of components that supported previous behavior at dynamically sensitive trajectory points. We instantiate DRAP on a fixed KappaTune-selected subnetwork of OpenVLA and evaluate replay-free sequential adaptation across the LIBERO Spatial, Object, and Goal suites. Compared with standard AdamW fine-tuning and EWC, the results show substantially improved retention of previously learned behaviors while preserving strong new-suite acquisition.

AI.tldr: DRAP：一种无回放的持续学习方法，利用专家状态-动作转移拟合局部线性模型，以其状态转移矩阵最大奇异值作为Lyapunov式风险度量，对张量-level 风险加权梯度做重要性记忆，并归一化后缩放各张量 AdamW 有效学习率，实现在OpenVLA子网络上的序列适配。
AI.motivation: 物理AI中的持续学习不同于常规设定：闭环执行中单步策略误差会沿轨迹累积放大，使智能体漂出训练分布并进一步增大后续预测误差，最终导致任务失败。作者希望用"动力学放大风险"来界定哪些参数应被保护。
AI.method: 无回放（replay-free）方法。1）对专家状态-动作转移拟合岭正则化局部线性模型，取状态转移矩阵最大奇异值作为策略无关的一步扰动放大估计（Lyapunov启发）。2）以该局部轨迹放大风险加权的样本级动作梯度平方，在任务后累积为张量级重要性记忆。3）后续任务中用归一化累积重要性缩放每个张量的有效 AdamW 学习率，动态敏感轨迹点相关的组件塑性被即时刻制。实例化于 KappaTune 选定的固定 OpenVLA 子网络。
AI.result: 在 LIBERO Spatial / Object / Goal 三个套件上做无回放序列适配；与标准 AdamW 微调及 EWC 相比，先前行为的保持显著提升，同时新套件的获取能力保持在较强水平（摘要未给出具体数值）。
AI.conclusion: 把误差累积/误差放大风险显式纳入参数重要性度量，是持续学习VLA的一个合理且轻量的正则化方向；但证据仅限仿真基准，缺少实机验证与量化指标。

title: Federated Transfer Learning for Medical Image Classification under Mixed Skew
comment: 8 pages, 5 figures and 2 tables. Presented at 4th IEEE International Conference on Federated Learning Technologies and Applications (FLTA 2026)
summary: Deep learning in medical imaging is constrained by data scarcity and by privacy regulations that make centralizing patient data across institutions impractical. Federated Learning (FL) addresses these constraints by keeping data local, but its distributed nature exposes training to strong statistical heterogeneity. Multicentric medical data is particularly affected, exhibiting a mixed skew that combines feature, label, concept, and quantity shifts across centers. Personalized FL mitigates heterogeneity by tailoring a model to each client, yet most methods assume training from scratch, which is unrealistic given the high dimensionality of medical features relative to the limited data available. We propose the Personalized Aligner Federated Pretrained (PAFP) framework, a personalized FL approach built on a pre-trained backbone. PAFP inserts client-specific Feature Alignment modules before the fine-tuned blocks to realign hidden feature distributions toward a server-aggregated target. On the FedISIC benchmark, PAFP attains the highest unweighted balanced accuracy while reducing inter-client performance variance roughly six-fold relative to the strongest baseline, yielding accuracy and cross-client equity jointly. Our code is publicly available at this https URL .

AI.tldr: 提出PAFP框架：在预训练骨干上做个性化联邦学习，在微调块前插入客户端专属特征对齐模块，将隐特征分布对齐到服务器聚合的目标，从而同时提升医学影像多中心场景的精度与跨客户端公平性。
AI.motivation: 医学影像数据稀缺且隐私法规限制多中心数据集中化；联邦学习虽保留数据本地性，但面临多中心数据混合偏移（特征、标签、概念、数量偏移）。现有个性化联邦方法多假设从零训练，而医学特征维度高、样本少，从零训练不现实。
AI.method: 基于预训练骨干的个性化联邦学习框架：冻结/微调主干，在每个客户端的微调块之前插入客户端专属特征对齐（Feature Alignment）模块，把本地隐层特征分布重新对齐到服务器聚合的目标分布；训练后聚合共享部分、保留个性化对齐模块。
AI.result: 在FedISIC基准上达到最高未加权平衡准确率，同时将客户端间性能方差相对最强基线降低约6倍，实现精度与跨中心公平性的联合提升（代码公开）。
AI.conclusion: 预训练骨干+客户端级特征对齐是缓解多中心统计异质性、兼顾精度与公平性的有效个性化联邦方案；但验证仅限医学影像基准，尚未涉及通用视觉/机器人场景。

title: On the Learnability of Footwear Robustness: Footstep Recognition Under Unseen Conditions
comment: 13 pages (+2 pages supplementary), 7 figures
summary: Footstep patterns, captured using pressure or force-sensitive walkways during natural walking, offer a convenient and passive approach to biometric recognition. However, footwear variability poses a major challenge to practical deployment, as it impacts both the foot-sensor interface and the user's underlying gait mechanics. This study considers the particularly difficult scenario where users enroll under one fixed footwear condition but must later be recognized in arbitrary, unseen footwear. Using the StepUP-P150 dataset, we show that footwear-induced shift, while substantial and heterogeneous across individuals, contains shared structure that can be learned from a training population and transferred, zero-shot, to previously unseen users and footwear styles. We do this using BiStepNet, a novel architecture that decomposes spatial and temporal identity cues into independently trainable streams and outperforms compact 3D spatiotemporal baselines for cross-footwear recognition. We demonstrate that cross-footwear recognition performance scales systematically with the volume and diversity of footwear representation in the training set, with gains transferring to footwear styles not directly observed during training. Moreover, we show that auxiliary gait datasets with only partial modality overlap (incorporated through the architecture's decomposed design) can be leveraged to further improve robustness to unseen footwear conditions.

AI.tldr: 提出BiStepNet双流架构，将步态足迹识别中的身份线索分解为空间与时间独立可训练支路，实现"注册一种鞋、识别任意未见鞋"的零样本跨鞋识别，并证明跨鞋偏移具有可从训练人群学习的共享结构。
AI.motivation: 压力/力敏步道采集的足迹是可被动、便捷的生物识别手段，但换鞋会同时改变足-传感器界面与步态力学机理，导致实用部署困难。作者聚焦最苛刻的设定：注册时固定鞋型、测试时为任意未见鞋型。
AI.method: 基于StepUP-P150数据集；提出BiStepNet，将空间（足印形态）与时间（步态动力学）身份线索拆分为两条独立可训练流；利用训练群体的共享跨鞋偏移结构进行零样本迁移；并通过架构的解耦设计融合仅部分模态重叠的辅助步态数据。
AI.result: 跨鞋识别性能优于紧凑3D时空基线；性能随训练集鞋类表征的数量与多样性系统性地提升，且增益可外推到训练中未直接出现的鞋型；辅助步态数据可进一步提升对未见鞋条件的鲁棒性。
AI.conclusion: 跨鞋足迹识别中的偏移虽个体间强异质，但存在可学习、可迁移的共享结构；解耦式时空架构是实现零样本跨鞋泛化的有效途径。

title: Do Agentic Policies Need to Look at Every Step? Geometric Abstraction for Reasoning and Action
comment: Accepted to the CoRL 2026 Workshop on Agentic Robotics. 13 pages, 8 figures. Project page: this https URL
summary: Recent multimodal language models can reason directly about robot scenes, but it is unclear whether they need to repeatedly reinterpret raw visual observations at every step of an interaction. We propose shifting routine spatial reasoning from images to text and symbols through a 3D geometric abstraction that is refreshed locally from observations and read directly by the language models. Specifically, our interface represents scene geometry via typed, evidence-aware symbolic references to object parts, grounds them from calibrated RGB-D, and returns compact textual checkpoints with metric residuals after each action. Symbolic task structure can thus be reused across decisions while metric values are rebound to the current scene, with direct visual reasoning invoked only on demand. Across offline policy synthesis and continuous online execution, reasoning over grounded text and symbols improves multi-step manipulation completion while substantially reducing repeated multimodal queries, positioning explicit geometric state as an effective substrate for agentic robot policies.

AI.tldr: 提出以“局部刷新的3D几何符号抽象”替代逐步视觉重读的机器人推理接口：用类型化、证据感知的对象部件符号引用表示场景几何，从标定RGB-D落地，动作后返回带度量残差的紧凑文本检查点，从而复用符号任务结构、把度量值重绑到当前场景，仅在需要时才做直接视觉推理。
AI.motivation: 多模态语言模型虽能直接推理机器人场景，但每一步交互都重新解析原始视觉观测代价高且冗余；希望将常规空间推理从图像转移到文本与符号，降低重复多模态查询开销，同时保持与当前场景的度量一致性。
AI.method: 构建3D几何抽象接口：typed、evidence-aware的部件级符号引用 + 标定RGB-D grounding + 动作后输出含度量残差的紧凑文本检查点；符号化任务结构跨决策复用，度量值按当前场景重绑定，按需调用直接视觉推理。评测覆盖离线策略合成与连续在线执行。
AI.result: 在离线策略合成与在线连续执行中，基于grounded文本与符号的推理提升了多步操作任务完成率，并显著减少重复多模态查询次数。
AI.conclusion: 显式几何状态可作为agentic机器人策略的有效基底（substrate）：局部刷新+符号绑定兼顾结构复用与度量时效性，为减少VLM逐步视觉重载提供了可行路线。

title: FloMo: 3D Scene Flow as a World Action Model Intermediate for Learning from Human Video
summary: Pretrained video generation models distill internet-scale motion priors into robot policies, but full video is a redundant signal for action prediction. We argue that dense 3D motion is the medium through which video pretraining best transfers to robot actions, and that predicting motion rather than video affords better sample-efficiency for action prediction. FloMo is a 5B video-generation model fine-tuned to predict 3D scene-flow and action tokens. Rendering scene flow as RGB and encoding it into the same latent space as video enables a pretrained video generation backbone to efficiently adapt to predict 3D scene flow. Co-trained on action-free human video and action-labeled robot teleoperation data, our model benefits from human-video pretraining and generalizes to unseen objects, motion primitives, and tasks. Replacing motion prediction with a video prediction objective degrades out-of-distribution generalization, while adding a video prediction target alongside motion lowers policy success rather than improving it. When motion, video, and action are predicted jointly, action tokens attend far more to motion than to video, suggesting that predicting video wastes model capacity. Together, these results indicate that motion effectively mediates the transfer from video pretraining to action. More information can be found at this http URL .

AI.tldr: FloMo 是一个 5B 视频生成模型，微调后从视频中预测稠密 3D 场景流与动作 token，论证"3D 运动"而非"视频"是视频预训练向机器人策略迁移的最佳媒介。
AI.motivation: 视频生成模型蕴含互联网规模的运动先验，可作为机器人策略的预训练来源；但完整视频对动作预测是冗余信号，作者假设稠密 3D 运动才是迁移的有效中介，且预测运动比预测视频更样本高效。
AI.method: 将 3D scene flow 渲染为 RGB，编码到与视频相同的潜空间，使预训练视频生成主干可直接适配预测 3D scene flow；模型同时输出 scene flow 与 action token。在无动作人类视频与带动作的机器人遥操作数据上联合训练。
AI.result: 在未见物体、运动基元与任务上具备泛化能力。消融显示：用视频预测目标替换运动预测会显著降低分布外泛化；在运动目标之外额外加视频预测目标反而降低策略成功率；联合预测时 action token 对 motion 的注意力远高于对 video 的注意力。
AI.conclusion: 3D 运动是视频预训练到机器人动作迁移的有效中介，视频预测目标浪费模型容量；"预测运动"应作为视频预训练机器人策略的核心目标。

title: VIGOR: Visual Gain Ordering for Hallucination Mitigation in Multimodal Discrete Diffusion Language Models
comment: Accepted to NeurIPS 2026
summary: Multimodal discrete diffusion language models (dLLMs) generate responses through iterative mask prediction and offer a promising alternative to autoregressive large vision-language models. However, they still suffer from hallucination, producing outputs that are plausible under language priors but insufficiently grounded in the image. We argue that hallucination in multimodal dLLMs is not only a token prediction problem, but also a premature commitment problem: during iterative denoising, some masked positions are unmasked too early because their confidence is driven more by language priors than by visual evidence, and these early commitments can bias later generation. To address this issue, we propose Visual Gain Ordering (VIGOR), a training-free and plug-and-play inference strategy that reorders masked positions according to counterfactual visual evidence. At each denoising step, VIGOR compares the confidence of each candidate token under the original image-conditioned pass and an additional visual-ablation pass, and prioritizes positions whose predictions are more strongly supported by the image. Experiments on LLaDA-V and Lumina-DiMOO show that VIGOR consistently reduces hallucination and improves multimodal reasoning performance across benchmarks. Code is available at this https URL .

AI.tldr: 提出免训练、即插即用的推理策略 VIGOR，通过对比原始图像条件与视觉消融条件下的置信度来重排多模态离散扩散语言模型的掩码填充顺序，抑制过早承诺导致的幻觉。
AI.motivation: 多模态离散扩散语言模型（dLLM）仍存在幻觉，输出在语言先验下合理但缺乏视觉依据。作者认为这不仅是token预测问题，更是"过早承诺"问题：迭代去噪中部分掩码位置因置信度更多由语言先验而非视觉证据驱动而被过早解掩，进而污染后续生成。
AI.method: VIGOR 在每个去噪步对每个位置计算候选token在原始图像条件下的置信度与视觉消融（去除图像）条件下的置信度之差，即反事实视觉增益，优先解掩视觉支撑更强的位置；整个过程仅改变解掩顺序，无需训练、可即插即用。
AI.result: 在 LLaDA-V 与 Lumina-DiMOO 上，VIGOR 在多个基准上一致降低幻觉并提升多模态推理性能。
AI.conclusion: 幻觉可被视为去噪调度中的顺序问题，基于反事实视觉增益的解掩排序是一种轻量有效的缓解手段；但缺少真实机器人/具身场景验证，与本文核心关注区的直接相关性有限。

title: Trajectory Evaluation via Rollout-Free World Model for End-to-end Autonomous Driving
summary: Although existing candidate trajectory evaluators have substantially improved end-to-end planning accuracy, their underlying mechanism remains suboptimal. Model-based evaluators typically make scoring future-aware by explicitly predicting candidate-conditioned future states over the planning horizon, which we term rollout. However, rollout incurs high inference cost and accumulates prediction errors. We argue that planning does not require reconstructing a full future scene for each candidate, but only future-relevant information for reliable comparison. We therefore propose RFWorld, a Rollout-Free World model for end-to-end trajectory evaluation. RFWorld constructs a shared scene memory and shapes it into a future-readable representation via lightweight training-time temporal readout with semantic supervision, keeping training overhead low. At inference time, candidate trajectories directly query the shared memory via sparse spatial readout for scoring, reducing computation by roughly the planning horizon times the number of candidate trajectories, while avoiding recursive rollout errors. Experiments on NAVSIM and Bench2Drive show that RFWorld learns a more planning-aligned world representation and achieves state-of-the-art performance.

AI.tldr: RFWorld: 无需rollout的世界模型用于端到端轨迹评估，通过共享场景记忆+稀疏空间读出替代逐候选未来预测。
AI.motivation: 现有基于模型的轨迹评估器依赖逐候选的rollout（显式预测候选条件下的未来状态）来打分，推理成本高且递归误差累积；作者认为规划并不需要为每个候选重建完整未来场景，只需与未来相关的可比较信息。
AI.method: 构建共享场景记忆(shared scene memory)；训练时用轻量时序读出(temporal readout)加语义监督，将记忆塑造成"可读未来"的表征；推理时候选轨迹通过稀疏空间读出(sparse spatial readout)直接查询共享记忆完成打分，避免逐候选rollout与递归误差。
AI.result: 在NAVSIM与Bench2Drive上验证：学到更贴合规划的世界表征，性能达到SOTA；推理计算量约降低"规划时域长度×候选轨迹数"量级。
AI.conclusion: 以共享记忆+查询式读出取代rollout，可在保持/提升轨迹评估精度的同时大幅降低推理开销，为端到端规划提供更高效的世界模型范式。

title: Nested Field-of-View Barriers for Teleoperated Multi-Robot Relay Chains
comment: 8 pages, 4 figures, 1 table. Submitted to the American Control Conference (ACC)
summary: Teleoperation of mobile robots in communication-denied environments requires maintaining a communication link while allowing the operator to maneuver freely. We propose a shared-autonomy framework in which a teleoperated leader is followed by a chain of autonomous robots that relays a line of sight to a fixed base station, a geometric proxy for the link. Connectivity is enforced geometrically through visibility-based Control Barrier Functions (CBFs), with each agent computing its control input locally through a quadratic program. A strict visibility constraint guarantees connectivity, but a follower with no independent motion objective remains stationary, stalling the leader at the boundary of the safe set. Relaxing it preserves mobility at the cost of the guarantee. Our framework resolves this conflict through nested hard-soft visibility constraints: a full field-of-view (FoV) constraint enforced strictly to guarantee connectivity and a contracted FoV constraint imposed on each follower as a relaxed behavioral objective that drives it inward before the connectivity boundary is reached. We prove feasibility of the local quadratic programs and forward invariance of the connected, collision-free set under the resulting distributed controller. The contraction parameter shapes follower behavior without affecting the guarantee, which follows from the strict constraint alone. The framework is evaluated in confined and cluttered environments on two simulated systems: a kinematic integrator and software-in-the-loop Crazyflie quadrotors. Compared with a baseline tuned to reach the goal in comparable time, the framework keeps the links far closer to the connected set and moves the followers less.

AI.tldr: 针对通信受限环境下的移动机器人遥操作，提出链式共享自主框架：被遥操作领航者由一串自主跟随者接力维持到固定基站的视线连通，用严格FoV控制屏障函数保证连通、用收缩FoV软约束（行为目标）解决跟随者停滞导致领航者被卡在安全集边界的问题，并证明QP可行性与连通无碰撞集的前向不变性。
AI.motivation: 通信受限环境下遥操作需同时保持链路与机动自由。纯严格可见性CBF虽保证连通，但无独立运动目标的跟随者会静止，使领航者停滞在安全集边界；仅松弛则丧失保证。需要一个兼顾连通保证与机动性的分布式控制器。
AI.method: 几何代理：用视线连通性表示通信链路。每个智能体本地求解二次规划（QP），以可见性CBF施加约束。采用嵌套硬-软约束：完整FoV约束严格施加以保证连通；收缩FoV约束作为每个跟随者的松弛行为目标，使其在触及连通边界前向内收缩移动。证明局部QP可行性与所得分布式控制器下连通无碰撞集的前向不变性；收缩参数只调节行为不影响保证。在运动学积分器与软件在环Crazyflie四旋翼两类仿真系统、受限与杂乱环境中评估，与调参至相近到达时间的基线对比。
AI.result: 理论上给出QP可行性与连通无碰撞集前向不变性的证明；实验显示相比调至相近到达时间的基线，本框架使链路更贴近连通集（更少接近失联边界），且跟随者移动更少。
AI.conclusion: 嵌套硬-软可见性约束以简洁方式解耦了“连通保证”与“跟随者行为调节”，适用于通信拒止环境中多机器人链式接力遥操作，并提供可证明的安全保证。

title: CRONOS: Benchmarking Non-Episodic Reinforcement Learning for Robotic Manipulation
summary: Reinforcement learning (RL) is promising for adapting robot policies to unstructured real-world environments. However, standard RL pipelines rely on episodic training with frequent scene resets, which is impractical for real-world deployment due to the need for substantial human intervention. While prior work has studied non-episodic RL in relatively small policies trained from scratch, its behavior when fine-tuning modern large-scale pre-trained vision-language-action (VLA) models remains underexplored. In this work, we introduce CRONOS, a simulation benchmark for RL fine-tuning of VLAs under non-episodic scene resets. CRONOS leverages high-fidelity physics simulators and adopts shared-scene multi-task settings. Using CRONOS, we show that naively fine-tuning pre-trained policies fails in non-episodic settings due to shifts in object configurations and end-effector poses; however, these challenges can be mitigated through targeted reset allocation and by addressing biases in pre-trained models. Moreover, we find that non-episodic training enhances long-horizon manipulation and improves generalization to previously unseen object configurations and task sequences. Project page: this https URL

AI.tldr: CRONOS：面向非回合（无频繁场景重置）场景下大规模 VLA 模型强化学习微调的高保真仿真基准，揭示朴素微调失败的原因并给出缓解手段。
AI.motivation: 真实部署中回合式训练需要大量人工重置场景，不可行；已有非回合 RL 研究多针对小规模从零训练的策略，其在大型预训练 VLA 上微调时的行为尚不清楚，且缺少标准化评测平台。
AI.method: 构建基于高保真物理仿真器的非回合场景重置基准，采用共享场景多任务设定；在 CRONOS 上系统分析预训练策略在非回合条件下的失效机制（物体构型与末端执行器位姿分布漂移），并考察定向重置分配、纠正预训练模型偏差等干预策略。
AI.result: 朴素微调在非回合设置下失败，主要源于物体构型与末端位姿的分布偏移；定向重置分配与缓解预训练偏差可显著改善；非回合训练反而增强长程操作能力，并提升对未见物体构型与任务序列的泛化。
AI.conclusion: 非回合 RL 微调是通向实用化 VLA 在线适应的可行路径，但需配套的重置预算分配与偏差校正设计；CRONOS 为后续研究提供标准化评测基准。

title: Manifold Embedding of Deep Image Features for Image Matching via Neural Adjoint Maps
comment: 10 pages main paper, 12 pages appendix
summary: Estimating semantic correspondences between different object instances of similar categories in real-world images is a fundamental challenge in computer vision. While the recent progress in foundation models has significantly advanced solutions for such difficult image correspondence problems, respective methods are often insufficiently regularised. For example, common nearest-neighbour matching with foundation model features often results in noisy correspondences, which is particularly prominent when solving for dense correspondences. In this work, we tackle image matching via functional maps, which have been popularised for 3D shape matching due to their powerful spectral formalism utilising an efficient low-dimensional linear representation. However, functional maps require that domains (in our cases the rectangular image grids) are equipped with an informative and non-trivial geometry. To define a meaningful manifold structure for images, we use Galerkin's method from finite elements to derive a discrete Laplace-Beltrami operator (LBO) based on a manifold embedding of deep image features. Further, we leverage a neural adjoint map that allows to represent non-linear mappings. We demonstrate that our method sets the new state of the art among zero-shot image correspondence methods on multiple dense correspondence benchmarks of real-world images. Our code is publicly available: this https URL

AI.tldr: 用 Galerkin 有限元方法从深度特征流形嵌入导出离散 Laplace-Beltrami 算子，在功能映射(functional maps)框架下实现零样本稠密图像对应，配合神经伴随映射表示非线性映射，刷新多个真实图像稠密对应基准的 SOTA。
AI.motivation: 基础模型特征的最近邻匹配缺乏正则化，稠密对应噪声大；功能映射虽在 3D 形状匹配中因低维线性谱表示而高效，但需域具备信息量足且非平凡的几何结构，矩形图像网格天然不具备。
AI.method: 为图像网格构建有意义的流形结构：基于深度图像特征的流形嵌入，用有限元 Galerkin 法推导离散 Laplace-Beltrami 算子作为形状算子；在此谱基上求解功能映射，并引入神经伴随映射(neural adjoint map)以表达非线性映射，从而获得正则化良好的稠密对应。
AI.result: 在多个真实图像稠密对应基准上，零样本设定下取得新的 SOTA，优于现有零样本图像对应方法；代码已开源。
AI.conclusion: 将 3D 形状匹配的谱功能映射范式迁移到 2D 图像对应，关键在于用深度特征构造流形几何与 LBO；该路线为稠密匹配提供了强正则化替代方案。

title: Sparse Anchors for Visual Multi-Session Registration in Changing Environments
comment: 8 pages, 4 figures, 2 tables
summary: Repeated robotic monitoring requires localization across visits to the same environment, even if the environment changes. Such changes can substantially reduce persistent visual content, and repetitive structures can lead to incorrect cross-session correspondences. In this paper, we address visual multi-session registration of a new data recording (the query session) to a previously reconstructed reference map. Under substantial visual and structural changes, cross-session localization may be possible only for parts of the trajectory. In our approach, we therefore rely on a sparse set of reliable absolute pose constraints and combine them with within-session relative-pose information to register the complete trajectory to the reference map. We first estimate absolute alignment hypotheses through visual place recognition, local feature matching, and geometric verification. We then use sequence consensus to reject hypotheses that are inconsistent with a common query-to-reference alignment and retain the remaining poses as absolute anchors. These anchors are refined through featuremetric alignment against a Gaussian feature field and combined with within-session relative-pose constraints in a robust pose-graph optimization. We evaluate our approach on 15 cross-session experiments from the challenging HILTI26 construction-site dataset, covering substantial scene changes and difficult-to-match environments. Our method achieves 94.4% recall within 1m and 100.0% within 5m, outperforming independent image localization, which peaks at 65.3% and 70.7%, respectively, as well as direct registration of independently reconstructed Structure-from-Motion geometry. Our results show that sparse, reliable absolute anchors can provide accurate and complete trajectory registration even when reliable cross-session correspondences are available only for part of the query session.

AI.tldr: 提出跨会话（多通道）视觉定位方法：先从视觉地点识别+局部特征匹配+几何验证生成绝对位姿假设，用序列一致性剔除不一致假设得到稀疏可靠"绝对锚点"，再经高斯特征场featuremetric精化，并与会话内相对位姿约束联合做鲁棒位姿图优化，将完整查询轨迹配准到参考地图，在HILTI26施工场景15组实验上取得94.4%@1m召回。
AI.motivation: 重复性机器人巡检需要在场景发生显著外观/结构变化时仍能跨会话定位，但大变化会导致持续可见视觉内容减少，且重复结构易产生错误跨会话对应，使全局一致定位难以成立；因此需要仅依赖少量可靠绝对约束、同时保证整条轨迹完整配准的方案。
AI.method: 1) 通过VPR、局部特征匹配与几何验证生成绝对对齐假设；2) 用序列一致性（sequence consensus）筛除与全局一致对齐不符的假设，保留剩余位姿为绝对锚点；3) 对锚点在高斯特征场（Gaussian feature field）上做featuremetric对齐精化；4) 与会话内相对位姿约束一起纳入鲁棒位姿图优化，完成整轨迹到参考地图的配准。
AI.result: 在HILTI26施工工地数据集15组跨会话实验中，1m内召回94.4%、5m内100.0%；对比独立单图定位（峰值65.3%/70.7%）及独立重建SfM几何的直接配准均更优。
AI.conclusion: 在仅有部分查询会话可获得可靠跨会话对应的情况下，稀疏但可靠的绝对锚点结合会话内相对约束，足以实现准确且完整的轨迹级注册；验证了"锚点+图优化"范式对强场景变化的鲁棒性。

title: LoopQ: Fair, Closed-Loop Evaluation of Quantized Vision-Language-Action Models
summary: Post-training quantization (PTQ) for vision-language-action (VLA) models promises smaller and faster VLA deployments. However, when analyzing existing VLA quantization works, we realised that it is hard to reason about the performance of the suggested quantization method compared to existing, similar, or in many cases, simpler PTQ methods. We present LoopQ, a closed-loop benchmark that compares multiple quantization policies on the same checkpoint, layers and engine, varying only the method and the kernels. We evaluate RTN, AWQ, GPTQ, ActQuant and QuantVLA on four VLAs with more than 180,000 episodes of LIBERO and LIBERO-plus, compare against QVLA's reported results on the same layers, and benchmark whether the four public VLA-quantization releases can be reproduced. We benchmark the methods on an NVIDIA H100, an L4, and a Jetson AGX Thor. Our results show that while quantization reliably saves memory, 2-3x for real low-bit models, VLA-specific PTQ methods underperform compared to simpler generic baselines. At 4 bits, RTN, AWQ and GPTQ match or exceed ActQuant and QuantVLA, plain RTN matches the calibrated methods, and plain AWQ matches the success QVLA reports for itself. Standard LIBERO hides the losses that do exist: configurations with no significant LIBERO loss lose 1.5-4.3 points under paired LIBERO-plus perturbations. Speed is a weaker story. At batch 1 on the H100, no quantized pi0.5 or OpenVLA-OFT configuration is faster than its 16-bit model (1.06-1.58x slower on library kernels); only the L4 with int8 kernels gains (4-14%), the Thor is slower on every 4-bit configuration, and the engine alone changes latency by 2.1x. Profiling explains why: pi0.5's quantized backbone is compute-bound, while its memory-bound action expert, 63% of GPU time and 13% of the parameters, stays in 16 bits.

AI.tldr: LoopQ 是一个闭环基准，在同一 checkpoint、同一层、同一引擎下仅变化量化方法与 kernel，系统比较 VLA 的后训练量化（RTN/AWQ/GPTQ/ActQuant/QuantVLA），发现通用简单 PTQ 反超 VLA 专用方法，且量化加速收益有限。
AI.motivation: 现有 VLA 量化工作难以横向比较：方法差异混杂了 checkpoint、层选择、推理引擎等因素，导致无法判断 VLA 专用 PTQ 是否真的优于通用或更简单的 PTQ 方法；同时量化带来的实际延迟收益缺乏在多硬件上的可靠证据。
AI.method: 构建闭环评测基准：固定同一 checkpoint、相同量化层集合与推理引擎，仅改变量化策略与 kernel。在 4 个 VLA 模型上评测 RTN、AWQ、GPTQ、ActQuant、QuantVLA，覆盖 LIBERO 与 LIBERO-plus 共 18 万余 episode；复现 QVLA 报告的同层结果及 4 个公开 VLA 量化发布；在 H100、L4、Jetson AGX Thor 上测速，并结合 profiling 分析瓶颈。
AI.result: 量化可稳定省内存（真实低比特模型 2–3x），但 VLA 专用 PTQ 不如简单通用基线：4 bit 下 RTN/AWQ/GPTQ 至少持平 ActQuant 与 QuantVLA，纯 RTN 与校准方法持平，纯 AWQ 达到 QVLA 自报成功率。标准 LIBERO 掩盖损失：LIBERO 上无显著掉点的配置在配对 LIBERO-plus 扰动下掉 1.5–4.3 点。速度收益弱：H100 batch1 上无任何量化 pi0.5/OpenVLA-OFT 配置快于 16 bit（慢 1.06–1.58x），仅 L4 的 int8 kernel 有 4–14% 增益，Thor 全部 4 bit 配置更慢，引擎切换本身可致 2.1x 延迟差异。Profiling 显示 pi0.5 量化 backbone 受算力约束，而占 63% GPU 时间、仅 13% 参数的内存受限 action expert 仍保持 16 bit。
AI.conclusion: VLA 专用量化方法的实证优势不成立，通用 PTQ 已足够；量化主要价值在显存而非延迟，需对非 backbone 模块（如 action expert）量化并优化 kernel/引擎才可能获得真实加速；评测应使用 LIBERO-plus 类扰动基准以避免掩盖性能退化。

title: Characterizing the vertical continuity of fuel strata based on TLS point clouds Gaussian decomposition and overlap metrics
comment: 45 pages, 15 figures Author affiliations and ORCID: Jesús Torralba this https URL , Luis Á. Ruiz this https URL , Pablo Crespo-Peremarch this https URL , Marina Simó-Martí this https URL , Juan Pedro Carbonell-Rivera this https URL
summary: Vertical forest structure influences fire behavior by regulating understory-to-canopy fuel connectivity, yet operational fuel-type models represent this complexity through discrete classes that only indirectly capture vertical continuity. High-density point clouds offer an opportunity to characterize vertical fuel connectivity in a more explicit and continuous manner, but specific methodological approaches are still required. We applied Gaussian decomposition to vertical height profiles derived from terrestrial laser scanning (TLS) point clouds across 25 permanent forest plots to characterize geometric vertical fuel continuity. A multiscale analysis spanning from the plot scale to ~0.5 $m^2$ units was used to evaluate geometric, probabilistic, and overlap metrics for characterizing fuel strata. The method reproduced the vertical transition between shrub and tree strata, with median Pearson correlations ranging from 0.83 to 0.96 across analysis levels. Probability density overlap metrics and separability indicators, such as the Jeffries-Matusita distance, provided complementary descriptors of vertical continuity. Intermediate spatial scales (3-6 m cells) provided a useful compromise between spatial detail and the consistent representation of shrub-canopy interaction patterns. Finer scales increased variability due to point density reduction and profile irregularity, and low mean squared error values were found insufficient as sole performance indicators. Gaussian decomposition applied to TLS point clouds enables explicit quantification of vertical fuel continuity, a limitation of current discrete classification systems. Continuous vertical connectivity metrics derived from this approach offer a pathway for improving ladder fuel characterization and strengthening decision-making support in wildfire risk assessment.

AI.tldr: 对25个永久样地TLS点云的高度剖面做高斯分解，在样地到约0.5 m²单元的多尺度上构建几何、概率与重叠三类垂直可燃物连续性指标。
AI.motivation: 运行性可燃物类型模型用离散类别间接表达垂直连续性，难以刻画灌丛-冠层燃料的空间衔接；TLS高密度点云提供了显式、连续表征垂直燃料连通性的机会，但缺少具体方法。
AI.method: 对TLS点云垂直高度剖面进行高斯分解（多高斯拟合），表征垂直燃料分层的几何特征；设计几何、概率密度（含重叠度）与可分性（Jeffries-Matusita距离）三类指标；在样地尺度至约0.5 m²单元间做多尺度敏感性分析，以中位Pearson相关与MSE评估各尺度表现。
AI.result: 方法可重现灌木层与乔木层之间的垂直过渡，各分析层级中位Pearson相关为0.83–0.96；概率密度重叠与JM距离提供互补的连续性描述；3–6 m格网在空间细节与灌丛-冠层交互模式稳健性之间取得较好折中；更细尺度因点密度下降与剖面不规则性导致方差上升，且低MSE不足以单独作为性能判据。
AI.conclusion: TLS点云上的高斯分解可显式量化垂直燃料连续性，弥补离散分类体系不足，为梯状燃料（ladder fuel）刻画与野火风险评估决策支持提供途径；需注意尺度选择与多指标联合评价。

title: Label-Preserving Fourier Domain Adaptation with Generative-AI and Real Style Donors for 3D Mitral Valve Segmentation
comment: 7 pages, 1 figure, 3 tables, submitted to IEEE for possible publication
summary: Accurate segmentation of the mitral valve from three-dimensional transesophageal echocardiography (3D TEE) is severely restricted by the scarcity of publicly available expert- annotated volumetric datasets. To address this critical limitation, we investigated Fourier Domain Adaptation (FDA), utilizing general-purpose generative-AI images (from platforms like Chat- GPT, Google Gemini, and Microsoft MAI) as annotation-free style donors for 3D mitral valve segmentation. We employed a DeepMitral residual U-Net model on the public MVSeg2023 dataset, comparing six conditions over three runs: real-only training, traditional augmentation, FDA with each generative source, and a non-AI FDA control using real-image style donors, plus an optimization-matched real-only control and a \b{eta} sensitivity analysis. Case-level paired testing showed that FDA with these generative sources led to significant reductions in boundary- and surface-related errors across all three donor conditions relative to the primary real-only baseline. However, the impact on the core segmentation metric, Generalized Dice Score (GDS), proved generator-dependent. ChatGPT-FDA showed a significant GDS advantage over the optimization-matched control but not over the primary baseline, and Gemini-FDA showed no significant GDS difference. Notably, only MAI-FDA provided a statistically robust and significant increase in GDS compared to the primary baseline. The \b{eta} sensitivity was not robust across training runs. These findings confirm that FDA remains an important augmentation mechanism. While generative-AI images offer a practical means of acquiring style diversity without new annotations, the non-AI control performed comparably to ChatGPT-FDA, so we do not conclude that this approach is superior to training with real-image donors.

AI.tldr: 该论文研究用生成式AI（ChatGPT/Gemini/Microsoft MAI）图像作为无标注风格供体做傅里叶域自适应（FDA），以缓解3D经食管超声心动图中二尖瓣分割标注数据稀缺问题。
AI.motivation: 3D TEE二尖瓣分割缺乏公开的专家标注体数据，限制了监督模型的精度与泛化；希望在不新增标注的前提下引入风格多样性。
AI.method: 在MVSeg2023公开数据集上用DeepMitral残差U-Net，比较六种设置各训练3次：仅真实数据、传统增强、分别以三种生成式AI图像为供体的FDA、以真实图像为供体的非AI FDA对照，另加优化匹配的仅真实对照与β敏感性分析；采用病例级配对检验。
AI.result: 三种生成式供体的FDA相对主基线显著降低边界与表面相关误差；但核心指标GDS提升依赖生成器：ChatGPT-FDA仅优于优化匹配对照而非主基线，Gemini-FDA无显著差异，仅MAI-FDA相对主基线获得稳健显著提升；β敏感性在多次训练间不稳定。
AI.conclusion: FDA仍是重要的增强机制，生成式AI图像可在无新标注下提供风格多样性；但非AI真实供体对照表现与ChatGPT-FDA相当，因此作者不认为该方法优于使用真实图像供体的训练。

title: HLO-AMP: Hierarchical Loco-Manipulation from Object-Aware Motion Priors
comment: Accepted at the Conference on Robot Learning (CoRL 2026). Video: this https URL
summary: Hierarchical pipelines for humanoid loco-manipulation typically pair a task-agnostic whole-body controller (WBC) with a downstream task policy. Such WBCs are often trained through manual reward shaping, which yields visibly machine-like motions; more consequentially, they are trained without the manipulated object in the scene. Object dynamics are instead approximated through randomized end-effector force disturbances, a proxy that fails to reproduce the distributed multi-contact wrench a real payload applies across the arms and torso, with the gap becoming critical near the platform's payload limit. In this work, we train the low-level (LL) controller itself as an object-aware motion prior: a single policy trained via motion imitation on retargeted motion-capture (MoCap) references that span the core motion primitives of the downstream task, with the manipulated object physically present in the scene. This single stage inherits natural human-like coordination from the references and absorbs the realistic contact wrench at its source, while exposing the same compact task-space command interface used by command-tracking WBCs. A reference-free high-level (HL) policy is then trained on top, with its action channel anchored to the empirical envelope of the low-level training data so that it generalizes the priors to a long-horizon multi-stage task while structurally preventing queries that would push the low level off-distribution. We instantiate the framework on a Unitree G1 for bimanual box pick-and-place: the same deployed policy generalizes across object masses and dimensions, initial and goal poses, and reactively recovers from intentional drops mid-carry. Video: this https URL .

AI.tldr: 以物体感知的运动模仿先验训练人形机器人低层控制器（场景中真实存在被操作物体），再在其上训练无参考的高层策略并由低层数据包络锚定动作通道，实现 G1 双臂搬箱的长程抓放与泛化。
AI.motivation: 层级式人形 loco-manipulation 中，低层全身控制器通常用人工奖励塑形训练、且训练时场景里没有被操作物体，仅用末端随机力扰动近似负载，无法复现分布在双臂与躯干上的多接触 wrench，在接近负载上限时误差尤为严重；同时塑形奖励导致动作机器味明显。
AI.method: 把低层控制器本身训练成"物体感知运动先验"：单一策略通过模仿重定向 MoCap 参考（覆盖下游任务核心运动基元）学习，训练时被操作物体在场景中实际存在；保留与命令跟踪式 WBC 相同的紧凑任务空间命令接口。随后训练无参考的高层策略，其动作通道被锚定在低层训练数据的经验包络内，以约束查询避免低层 off-distribution。
AI.result: 在 Unitree G1 上实例化为双臂箱子 pick-and-place：同一部署策略可泛化到不同物体质量与尺寸、不同初始与目标位姿，并能在搬运行进中被人为掉落时做出反应性恢复。
AI.conclusion: 将低层控制器训练为含物体在环的运动先验，可同时获得类人自然协调性与真实接触 wrench 建模，并以数据包络约束高层动作空间，形成可长程部署的人形 loco-manipulation 分层框架。

title: DexHOT: Learning Hand-Object Configuration Transfer for Dexterous Manipulation
comment: 9 pages, 4 figures
summary: Dexterous manipulation involves not only moving objects, but also arranging the hand around them to maintain useful contacts and enable subsequent actions. Yet many learning-based systems specify goals primarily through object poses or trajectories, leaving hand-object configurations to emerge implicitly. We introduce DexHOT, which formulates dexterous manipulation as hand-object configuration transfer: moving between feasible configurations that jointly specify hand articulation and object pose relative to the wrist.
