DexHOT learns a reusable relation-conditioned transfer primitive from synthetic feasible configuration pairs, without human reference motions, and composes long-horizon behaviors through closed-loop tracking of configuration subgoals. On DexHOTBench with 120 objects, a single policy achieves 80.5% transfer success on seen objects and 69.4% on unseen objects; on a real dexterous hand, it achieves 61.5% success over 200 real-robot transfers and 90% task success across six demonstration-guided tasks. These results show that explicit hand-object goals provide an expressive and composable interface for dexterous manipulation. More details and videos are available at this https URL .

AI.tldr: DexHOT 将灵巧操作形式化为"手-物配置迁移"：在同时指定手部关节与物体相对腕部位姿的可行配置之间迁移，用合成配置对学习关系条件化的可复用迁移原语，并以闭环跟踪配置子目标组合长程任务。DexHOTBench 120 物体上单策略迁移成功率 80.5%（见过）/69.4%（未见），真机 200 次迁移 61.5%，6 个示范引导任务 90%。
AI.motivation: 现有学习式灵巧操作系统多以物体位姿或轨迹指定目标，手-物构型只能隐式涌现，导致接触与后续动作的可控性、可组合性差。作者认为显式的手-物联合目标才是更具表达力和可组合性的接口。
AI.method: 提出 DexHOT，把手-物配置定义为（手部关节 + 物体相对腕座位姿）的联合状态；从合成可行配置对中学习关系条件化的迁移原语（relation-conditioned transfer primitive），无需人类参考动作；长程行为通过闭环跟踪配置子目标（subgoal）序列组合而成。
AI.result: DexHOTBench（120 物体）单策略迁移成功率 80.5%（seen）/69.4%（unseen）；真实灵巧手上 200 次真机迁移达 61.5%，6 个示范引导任务平均 90% 成功率。
AI.conclusion: 显式的"手-物配置"目标为灵巧操作提供了可表达、可复用、可组合的接口，配合合成数据与闭环子目标跟踪可泛化到新物体并迁移到真机。

title: WayTrace: A Map-to-Language-to-Trace Hierarchy for Embodied Urban Navigation
comment: Under Review
summary: Web services provide walking directions for nearly every city, but following them reliably over long routes remains challenging for autonomous robots. Point-goal navigation policies rely heavily on accurate GNSS, while most vision-language navigation models struggle to execute even short instructions outdoors. We present WayTrace, a hierarchical system that connects web-map directions to robot motion through language. An off-the-shelf orchestrator vision-language model reads the turn-by-turn directions, a satellite map and recent camera images, and issues one atomic language command at a time, such as "cross the road to the left". An onboard trace predictor, trained on over one million automatically labelled samples from street-level images, draws the path for this command in the image, and a reinforcement learning policy tracks it. In long-range simulated missions, WayTrace remains robust to GNSS noise and rarely leaves crosswalks or sidewalks, while point-goal baselines degrade sharply with about ten times more violations. Deployed on a wheeled-legged robot, WayTrace completes real-world missions of up to 1.37 km at about 1.1 m/s through a busy city centre, rural trails and a university campus, handling crosswalks, staircases and construction sites. Project page: this https URL

AI.tldr: WayTrace：分层系统将网页地图的逐向导航指令经语言接口转化为机器人运动，实现城市长距离户外导航。
AI.motivation: 网页地图导航已覆盖几乎所有城市，但机器人在长路线中可靠跟随仍困难：点目标导航策略强依赖高精度GNSS，视觉语言导航模型在户外难以执行长指令。
AI.method: 三部分分层架构：1）现成编排视觉语言模型读取逐向指令、卫星地图与近期相机图像，逐条输出原子语言命令（如"向左过马路"）；2）机载轨迹预测器基于百万级街景图像自动标注样本训练，在图像中为该命令绘制路径；3）强化学习策略跟踪该路径。
AI.result: 长距离仿真任务中对GNSS噪声鲁棒，极少偏离人行横道或人行道；点目标基线性能急剧下降，违规约多十倍。轮腿机器人实机在城市中心、乡村小径与校园完成最长1.37 km、约1.1 m/s的任务，处理人行横道、楼梯与施工区。
AI.conclusion: 语言作为网页地图与机器人运动之间的中间接口，可在真实城市环境中实现千米级户外导航，但依赖现成VLM与大规模自动标注数据。

title: High-fidelity training-free photovoltaic module mapping from multi-view UAV imagery
comment: 39 pages, 16 figures
summary: High-fidelity photovoltaic (PV) module mapping requires complete instance recovery and accurate delineation. Vision foundation models offer zero-shot segmentation, but converting incomplete and inconsistent predictions across views into a complete, geometrically accurate map of individual modules remains challenging. We propose the Multi-View PV Module Mapper (MV-PVMapper), a training-free framework coupling vision foundation models with unmanned aerial vehicle (UAV) photogrammetry. First, Segment Anything Model 3 (SAM 3) generates candidates from original images using text prompts. Their contours are then transferred into object space through per-module slope correction to limit distortion from surface-model noise, and verified against representative module dimensions to guide cross-view instance selection. Finally, accepted instances return to all covering images as box prompts for SAM~3, supplementing text prompts with spatial cues for iterative segmentation, verification and fusion. On five-direction surveys of three operational rooftop PV plants at approximately 1 cm nadir ground sampling distance, two feedback iterations recover 7,710 of 7,711 reference modules with no false positives at an intersection-over-union (IoU) matching threshold of 0.5. Macro-averaged area precision and recall reach 99.00 % and 98.52 %, respectively. Averaged across sites, the aggregated Jaccard index reaches 97.55 %, compared with 60.73 % and 41.24 % for orthomosaic segmentation and multi-view pixel-voting baselines, respectively; average precision at the stricter IoU threshold of 0.95 reaches 95.67 %. Ablation studies show that module-size constraints are critical for instance separation, while slope correction and feedback to all covering views improve boundary accuracy. These results are achieved without task-specific image annotation or segmentation-model weight updates.

AI.tldr: MV-PVMapper：免训练框架，将SAM 3零样本分割与无人机摄影测量耦合，通过坡度校正投影、模块尺寸验证和跨视图反馈迭代，实现光伏组件级完整制图。
AI.motivation: 单视图基础模型分割结果不完整且跨视图不一致，难以直接生成逐组件、几何精确的光伏电站地图；同时希望避免任务专用标注与模型微调。
AI.method: 文本提示驱动SAM 3生成候选；轮廓经逐模块坡度校正投影到物方以抑制表面模型噪声，并用代表性模块尺寸约束做跨视图实例筛选；被接受实例以框提示回投所有覆盖影像，与文本提示联合迭代分割、验证与融合，共两轮反馈。
AI.result: 三座运营屋顶电站五方向航测（约1 cm GSD）：两轮迭代在IoU=0.5下恢复7,710/7,711个参考模块且无假阳性；宏平均面积精度99.00%、召回98.52%；聚合Jaccard 97.55%（正射影像分割60.73%、多视图像素投票41.24%）；IoU=0.95下AP达95.67%。消融显示尺寸约束对实例分离最关键，坡度校正与全视图反馈提升边界精度。
AI.conclusion: 多视图-物方几何一致性约束可把零样本基础模型分割转化为高保真逐实例制图，无需标注或权重更新；该“候选—几何验证—跨视图回馈”范式可迁移至其他结构化目标的航空重建。

title: When Cell Crops Share a Parent: Measuring and Isolating Acquisition Leakage in Cervical Cytology Benchmarks
comment: 5 pages, 3 figures
summary: Public cervical cytology benchmarks release many cell crops cut from far fewer microscope fields or slides and are often split at the crop level, so test cells share acquisition parents with training cells. In a preregistered study, crop-level splitting raised SIPaKMeD accuracy by 0.97 percentage points across twelve architectures and twenty seeds (95% CI 0.59-1.39), and CRIC accuracy by 12.08 points (11.16-12.99). On SIPaKMeD, a factorial that fixes training crop and parent counts attributes the gain to sibling exposure (1.73 points, 0.95-2.51), not to the extra parent diversity of crop-level splits (0.00). Parent identity is decodable at about 100 times chance, yet erasing 82% of its above-floor linear recoverability left the gap unchanged, and Grad-CAM did not distinguish leaking from clean models; matching test cells' color statistics to an unseen same-class field removed most of the advantage. Decodability and saliency cannot substitute for a parent-disjoint split.

AI.tldr: 公共宫颈细胞学基准以"细胞裁剪块"级别划分训练/测试集，导致测试细胞与训练细胞共享同一显微镜视野（父样本）而产生数据泄漏；预注册实验量化了该泄漏的准确率虚高幅度并定位其机制为"同胞暴露"。
AI.motivation: 细胞学数据集（SIPaKMeD、CRIC）从少量视野/切片中切出大量细胞裁剪块，若按裁剪块随机划分，测试细胞与训练细胞具有相同采集父样本，基准分数可能系统性虚高，但缺乏严格量化的因果证据。
AI.method: 预注册研究；12种架构×20个随机种子对比裁剪级划分与父样本不相交划分；在SIPaKMeD上做析因实验，分别固定训练裁剪数与父样本数，以分离"同胞暴露"与"父样本多样性"的贡献；线性可解码性分析父样本身份、抹除82%线性可恢复性、Grad-CAM可视化，以及将测试细胞颜色统计匹配到未见过的同类视野。
AI.result: 裁剪级划分使SIPaKMeD准确率提升0.97个百分点（95% CI 0.59–1.39），CRIC提升12.08个百分点（11.16–12.99）；SIPaKMeD上增益归因于同胞暴露（1.73，0.95–2.51）而非父样本多样性（0.00）；父样本身份可解码性约为随机水平100倍，但抹除82%的超出下限线性可恢复性后差距不变；Grad-CAM无法区分泄漏模型与干净模型；将测试细胞颜色统计匹配到未见同类视野可消除大部分优势。
AI.conclusion: 裁剪级划分会造成显著且可量化的基准虚高，且主要由同父样本同胞细胞的颜色/外观相似性带来；可解码性与显著性图不能替代父样本不相交划分作为诊断手段。

title: Asynchronous Robot Policies
comment: For code, checkpoints and more results, check out this https URL
summary: Scaling vision-language foundation models has significantly advanced generalist robot manipulation, but the increased model scale introduces computational latency that degrades real-time physical reactivity. Existing Vision-Language-Action (VLA) architectures execute high-level semantic reasoning and action ex- ecution sequentially within the primary control loop, creating a fundamental tension between semantic-reasoning capability and robot agility. To address this, we propose Asynchronous Robot Policy (ARP), an architectural framework that decouples semantic reasoning from low-level action generation using asynchronous processes operating at independent frequencies. In ARP, a high-capacity Vision-Language Model (VLM) asynchronously updates a semantic memory at low fre- quency, while a lightweight Vision-Action Expert, conditioned on this semantic memory, generates robot actions at a much higher control frequency. Such a formulation, enables having a fast perception-action loop without compromising on the semantic capability. To overcome asynchronous memory staleness, ARP trains the vision-action expert on the semantic staleness and execution delay, with temporally mismatched observation across processes. On Franka manipulation tasks, ARP achieves an 18% higher success rate and 20% less time need for execution in quasi-static setups, while 3-5 times baseline performance in dynamic simulation environments. Furthermore, ARP enables operating the VLM at 10 times lower than its nominal frequency with no significant performance loss making it much more efficient than the baseline. These results highlight the architectural advantages of modeling robot policies as asynchronous processes, enabling real-world reactive deployment without sacrificing the scale of foundation models.

AI.tldr: ARP decouples VLM semantic reasoning from action generation into asynchronous processes at independent frequencies: a large VLM updates semantic memory slowly, while a lightweight vision-action expert conditioned on that memory acts at high control rate; the expert is trained on stale/delayed observations to tolerate asynchrony. Gains: +18% success, -20% time on Franka quasi-static tasks, 3-5x baseline in dynamic sim, VLM can run 10x slower without loss.
AI.motivation: Scaling VLM-based VLA models improves generality but introduces inference latency; existing VLA pipelines run semantic reasoning and action execution sequentially in the primary control loop, creating a tension between semantic capability and real-time reactivity.
AI.method: Two-process asynchronous architecture: (1) high-capacity VLM updates a semantic memory at low frequency; (2) a lightweight Vision-Action Expert, conditioned on the semantic memory, generates actions at high frequency. To handle memory staleness and execution delay, the expert is trained with temporally mismatched observations across the two processes.
AI.result: On Franka tasks, 18% higher success rate and 20% shorter execution time in quasi-static settings; 3-5x baseline in dynamic simulation; VLM can operate at 1/10 of nominal frequency with no significant performance loss.
AI.conclusion: Modeling robot policies as asynchronous processes yields architectural advantages, enabling reactive real-world deployment of large foundation models; decoupling frequency of semantic reasoning and control resolves the latency–capability trade-off.

title: Perturb, Repair, Verify: Self-Play Vision-Language Verifiers for Compositional Understanding
summary: Vision-language verifiers judge whether an image faithfully matches a textual description, yet existing training pipelines typically rely on static supervision from stronger external judges or curated hard-negative data. Such supervision requires external generation or annotation, is teacher-bounded, and is difficult to adapt as model failures evolve. We introduce PROVE (Perturb-and-Repair Optimization for Vision-Language Evaluation), a self-play framework that trains verifiers through a closed perturb-verify-repair-verify loop. Starting from a known-correct image-caption pair, a Mutator introduces a typed perturbation over objects, attributes, counts, or relations. The verifier then judges the perturbed caption and provides textual feedback, which a Repairer uses to recover a faithful caption for re-verification. These two verification rounds produce structured rewards for informative mismatches and visually grounded repairs. Since perturbation, verification, and repair are role-conditioned behaviors of the same evolving multimodal backbone, updating the shared parameters also improves the verifier itself. Experiments show that PROVE improves fine-grained compositional verification across model scales and families and strengthens visual-detail robustness on the reference backbone, with limited, benchmark-dependent changes on broader multimodal tasks.

AI.tldr: PROVE：用自博弈"扰动-验证-修复-再验证"闭环训练视觉语言验证器，免外部教师监督。
AI.motivation: 现有视觉语言验证器训练依赖更强外部评判者的静态监督或人工构造的难负样本，需外部生成/标注、性能受教师上限约束，且难以随模型失败模式演化而自适应。
AI.method: 共享多模态骨干按角色条件化产生三种行为：Mutator 对正确图文对施加类型化扰动（物体、属性、数量、关系）；Verifier 判断扰动后描述并给出文本反馈；Repairer 依据反馈恢复忠实描述；两轮验证产生结构化奖励（信息性不匹配 + 视觉grounded修复），更新共享参数同时提升验证器。
AI.result: 在多个模型尺度与家族上提升细粒度组合式验证能力，并在参考骨干上增强对视觉细节的鲁棒性；更广泛多模态任务上变化有限且依基准而异。
AI.conclusion: 自博弈闭环为验证器提供可自我演化的课程式监督信号，成本低、可随失败模式迭代；但迁移收益局限于验证类任务。

title: RoboTryOn: Synthesizing Dexterous Robot Demonstrations from Human Videos via Virtual Try-On
comment: 29 pages, 15 figures, 13 tables. Project page: this https URL
summary: Robot foundation models have shown remarkable performance in robot control, yet adapting them to a new task still relies heavily on teleoperated demonstrations. Egocentric human videos offer a scalable substitute, but overlaying rendered robots on human videos or retargeting human poses into robot actions leaves significant visual or action gaps for high-DoF robot embodiments. To address this limitation, we propose RoboTryOn, which treats human-to-robot translation as virtual try-on: try-on keeps the person and swaps the garment, RoboTryOn keeps the demonstrated motion and swaps the human for the robot. Specifically, RoboTryOn converts a human video into a video of the target robot specified by a reference image, while preserving the original task, objects, and background. To maintain visual consistency, we translate selected keyframes autoregressively and use them to guide video synthesis with motion conditioned on the human hand skeleton. Additionally, we use an inverse dynamics model (IDM) that incorporates depth features to infer action labels from synthesized videos for policy learning. Our experiments across multiple humanoid embodiments show that policies trained with our synthetic data improve the average success rate on novel tasks, including challenging bimanual manipulation, from 2% to 60%, without any real robot demonstration of those tasks. Moreover, training with our synthetic data matches the performance of policies trained solely on teleoperated demonstrations at approximately a third of the collection cost, demonstrating the cost efficiency of our approach.

AI.tldr: RoboTryOn 将"人到机器人"迁移视为"虚拟试衣"：保留演示动作与场景，把视频中的人替换为目标机器人，再用带深度特征的逆动力学模型从合成视频打标，用于策略学习。
AI.motivation: 机器人基础模型适配新任务严重依赖遥操作示范；第一人称人类视频是可扩展替代，但"渲染机器人叠加"或"人体姿态重定向"在高自由度机器人本体上存在显著视觉域差与动作域差。
AI.method: 按参考图像指定的目标机器人，把人类视频转为该机器人的视频；自回归地翻译关键帧以保持视觉一致性，并以人类手部骨架为条件做运动引导的视频合成；训练融入深度特征的 IDM，从合成视频推断动作标签以进行策略学习。
AI.result: 在多种人形本体上，仅用合成数据训练的策略将新任务（含双臂操作）平均成功率从 2% 提升到 60%，且无需真实机器人示范；效果与纯遥操作数据训练的策略相当，数据采集成本约为其三分之一。
AI.conclusion: 以"换本体不换动作"的虚拟试衣范式可生成视觉一致、动作可用的机器人示范数据，是低成本替代遥操作的数据规模化路径。

title: PadLoc: Training-Free Floor-Plan Localization by Sparse Geometric Matching
comment: Accepted to WACV 2027 (Algorithms track). 22 pages: main paper (10 pages incl. references) and supplementary material (12 pages). Code: this https URL
summary: We propose PadLoc, a training-free localization back-end that places a moving sensor within a known floor plan. Floor plans are cheap, persistent, and robust to appearance change, but recent learned-depth methods localize against them by filtering per-frame depth through dense $(x,y,\theta)$ pose grids. PadLoc keeps the swappable depth front-end and replaces the dense grid back-end with sparse geometric matching: dominant wall orientations define a small pose-candidate set, masked normalized cross-correlation scores observed free space against the plan, and a moving-pose Gaussian-mixture Bayes filter plus consensus readout decodes the trajectory. Holding each competitor's depth fixed, PadLoc matches or beats UnLoc's forward filter and the F3Loc filter at every Gibson trajectory length, and UnLoc's offline refinement from $T=35$ on; it exceeds Z-FLoc's published results with a shared MapAnything front-end. On Bonn LiLocBench, PadLoc improves pooled SR@1m over UnLoc by 23-32 pp under wheel odometry and 35-43 pp with ground-truth motion; with full-FOV LiDAR plus wheel odometry the same readout reaches 100% SR@1m at 9-10 cm median error on the static sequence. On the Hilti-Trimble Localization Challenge PadLoc localizes a camera-only fisheye rig on construction floors hundreds of metres across at 0.90-0.98 online SR@2m on three of five sessions; adding learned wall isolation, applied to every session, covers all five at 0.67-0.92 with the localizer unchanged throughout. PadLoc thus matches or outperforms dense grid back-ends while preserving sensor modularity and a compact state that does not grow with trajectory length.

AI.tldr: PadLoc: 一种无需训练的稀疏几何匹配后端，在已知平面图中定位移动传感器；用主导墙方向生成少量候选位姿、掩膜NCC打分自由空间、高斯混合贝叶斯滤波+一致性读出解算轨迹，替代密集(x,y,θ)网格滤波后端。
AI.motivation: 平面图廉价、持久且对外观变化鲁棒，但现有学习深度+平面图定位方法依赖稠密位姿网格滤波，计算重、状态随轨迹增长，且可与深度前端耦合。
AI.method: 保持可替换的深度前端不变，将后端改为稀疏几何匹配：主方向候选位姿枚举 + 掩膜归一化互相关（观测自由空间 vs 平面图自由空间）+ 移动位姿高斯混合贝叶斯滤波 + 共识读出；可选学习式墙面隔离模块提升泛化。
AI.result: Gibson各轨迹长度上匹配或超过UnLoc前向滤波与F3Loc，T=35起超过UnLoc离线精化；共享MapAnything前端时超过Z-FLoc报道结果；Bonn LiLocBench上SR@1m较UnLoc提升23–32pp（轮式里程计）/35–43pp（真值运动），全视场LiDAR+轮速在静态序列达100% SR@1m、中位误差9–10cm；Hilti-Trimble挑战中纯鱼眼相机在数百米厂房地面五会话中三场在线SR@2m 0.90–0.98，加学习墙面隔离后五场全覆0.67–0.92。
AI.conclusion: 稀疏几何匹配+贝叶斯滤波可替代稠密网格后端，在多种传感器与真实场景下持平或更优，同时保持传感器模块化与不随轨迹增长的紧凑状态。

title: What Does the Model See? Representation Validity in Multimodal LLM-Based Video Analysis
summary: Multimodal large language models (MLLMs) allow social scientists to analyze video at scale, but researchers must decide which parts of a video to provide as input. We use the term representation validity to examine how text, audio, video, and combined inputs affect measurement and subsequent analysis. We compare input representations across six open-weight MLLMs and three human-annotated video datasets. No representation consistently performs best. On seven news-related constructs, native-video performance varies little across models (macro-F1 = .70-.77), while extracted-text performance ranges from .52 to .80. Three models perform better with text and three with video. Combining inputs rarely improves performance. Higher classification accuracy also does not reliably produce estimates closer to those based on human codes. The highest-F1 representation best reproduces human-coded regression coefficients in 17 of 42 comparisons. Even when each model uses its highest-F1 deployable representation, 45% of sample-prevalence estimates differ from the human-coded benchmark by more than ten percentage points. Input representation therefore requires validation for both the construct being measured and the quantity estimated from the resulting labels.

AI.tldr: 该文提出"表征有效性"概念，系统比较文本、音频、视频及其组合输入在6个开源多模态大模型和3个人工标注视频数据集上对测量与后续分析的影响，发现没有一种输入表征始终最优，且高分类准确率不等于下游估计更接近人工编码结果。
AI.motivation: 社会科学研究者使用MLLM大规模分析视频时必须决定将视频的哪些部分作为输入，但输入表征（文本/音频/视频/组合）如何影响测量质量和下游统计推断缺乏系统证据。
AI.method: 定义"表征有效性"框架；在6个开放权重MLLM与3个人工标注视频数据集上对比多种输入表征；在7个新闻相关构念上评估分类性能（macro-F1），并考察分类表现与回归系数、样本流行度估计相对于人工编码基准的一致性（42组比较）。
AI.result: 原生视频输入的macro-F1为.70–.77且跨模型变化小，抽取文本输入为.52–.80；3个模型文本更优、3个模型视频更优；多模态组合很少带来提升；最高F1表征仅在42次比较中的17次最好地复现人工编码回归系数；即便采用各模型最高F1的可部署表征，45%的样本流行度估计与人工基准偏差超过10个百分点。
AI.conclusion: 输入表征需针对所测量的构念和由标签估计的统计量分别进行验证，不能默认某一模态或默认分类精度即可保证下游分析有效性。

title: From Natural Images to Medical Scans: Transferability of Diffusion Models for Medical Image Generation
comment: WACV 2027
summary: Transfer learning from natural images is standard in supervised and increasingly adopted in self-supervised medical image analysis, but its role in generative modelling, and in particular diffusion denoisers, remains underexplored. Medical diffusion models typically train the denoiser from scratch, with no systematic evaluation of natural-image transfer. We analyse this across latent and pixel paradigms, model sizes (131M-952M) and two radiology datasets (RadImageNet, BraTS), and ask which aspects of transfer support generation. We find that: i) Natural-image initialisation consistently improves generation, by 21-34% relative gFID in pixel space against 14% in latent space, where the tokeniser supplies much of the prior. gFID gains mirror downstream pathology classification and radiomic-feature FD, both proxies for clinical fidelity. ii) Benefits reflect spatial structure, not semantics: semantic probing does not predict generation quality, whereas a spatial-structure metric adapted to internal denoiser representations tracks gFID at $|r|=0.85$, positioning spatial organisation as a channel through which pretraining manifests. iii) Mixed-domain denoiser training shows that natural and medical images share similar layer-wise representations up to the late blocks, and mixing natural images into medical training improves fidelity. iv) Transfer benefit is tied to natural image initialisation, outperforming in-domain medical pretraining and several reinitialisation schemes. Overall, natural image denoisers transfer positively to medical ones in our setup. Code is available at this https URL

AI.tldr: 该文系统研究了自然图像预训练对医学扩散模型去噪器的迁移效果，发现自然图像初始化在像素空间带来21-34%相对gFID提升（潜空间约14%），且增益源自空间结构先验而非语义信息。
AI.motivation: 医学扩散模型通常从零训练去噪器，自然图像迁移学习在生成建模（尤其扩散去噪器）中的作用缺乏系统评估。作者希望厘清"迁移的哪个方面"支撑生成质量。
AI.method: 在潜空间与像素空间两种范式、131M-952M多种模型规模、RadImageNet与BraTS两个放射学数据集上进行对照实验；采用语义探针与适配去噪器内部表示的空间结构度量分析迁移来源；并做自然/医学混合域训练、与域内医学预训练及多种重初始化方案的比较。
AI.result: i) 自然图像初始化稳定提升生成质量（像素空间相对gFID ↓21-34%，潜空间约14%），gFID增益与下游病理分类、影像组学特征FD一致；ii) 增益源于空间结构而非语义，空间结构度量与gFID相关性达|r|=0.85；iii) 自然与医学图像在后期层之前的逐层表示高度相似，混合训练提升保真度；iv) 迁移收益依赖于自然图像初始化本身，优于域内医学预训练及多种重初始化。
AI.conclusion: 在该设定下，自然图像去噪器可正向迁移至医学图像去噪器，空间组织是预训练发挥作用的主要通道。

title: Factorized MLLM Embeddings for Composed Image Retrieval
comment: Project page: this https URL , Code: this https URL
summary: Composed Image Retrieval (CIR) aims to retrieve a target image given a reference image and a modification text. Although recent approaches leveraging Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) have shown significant progress, we argue that the MLLM's compositional understanding remains underutilized. This stems from directly mapping composed queries into a retrieval embedding via contrastive supervision alone, without explicitly resolving the intended visual modifications. In this work, we introduce Factorized MLLM Embeddings (FactEmbed), which decouples compositional query comprehension from building discriminative embeddings. Rather than directly projecting the composed query into a single embedding without internal reasoning, FactEmbed employs a set of factorized latents that simulate the intended visual modifications via an intermediate target imagination objective. This process encourages the latents to ground into target semantics before forming discriminative representations for retrieval. Subsequently, to propagate these factorized representations throughout the model for retrieval, we optimize a factor-level contrastive loss while distilling the decomposed representations into a deeper attention layer of the MLLM. Finally, for efficient inference, we retain the [EOS] token to establish a global-level embedding on top of these factorized latents, while we exploit the mean-pooled factorized latents to rerank a short candidate list at negligible cost, as both are produced by the same forward pass. Extensive evaluations demonstrate that FactEmbed outperforms prior works across CIR benchmarks.

AI.tldr: FactEmbed将组合图像检索(CIR)中的组合理解与判别嵌入构建解耦：用一组因子化隐变量通过"目标想象"中间目标模拟预期视觉修改，再以因子级对比损失并结合蒸馏到MLLM深层注意力层进行检索，推理时用[EOS]全局嵌入检索并用因子均值池化重排短候选表。
AI.motivation: 现有基于多模态大模型的CIR方法直接把"参考图+修改文本"的复合查询经对比监督投影为单一检索嵌入，未显式解析预期的视觉修改，导致MLLM的组合理解能力未被充分利用。作者主张将复合查询理解与判别嵌入构建解耦。
AI.method: 1) 引入因子化隐变量(Factorized Latents)，通过中间"目标想象"目标让隐变量在形成检索表示前先落地到目标语义；2) 设计因子级对比损失，并将分解后的表示蒸馏到MLLM更深的注意力层以在整个模型中传播；3) 推理阶段保留[EOS] token在因子化隐变量之上构建全局嵌入做粗检索，并用均值池化的因子化隐变量对短候选列表重排，二者共享同一次前向、开销可忽略。
AI.result: 在多个CIR基准上，FactEmbed 优于先前方法，验证了因子化解耦+目标想象+因子级对比与蒸馏的有效性，且重排带来近乎零成本的检索提升。
AI.conclusion: 显式解析视觉修改、将组合理解与嵌入判别解耦，是提升MLLM驱动组合图像检索的关键方向；同前向产生的多粒度嵌入可低成本用于重排。

title: Robust Reconstruction of Power Lines from Incomplete Mobile and Aerial LiDAR Data
comment: 15 pages, 9 figures
summary: Accurate vegetation-encroachment assessment and risk mitigation require electric utilities to accurately locate and characterize distribution-network assets, including poles and power lines, and distinguish among medium-voltage, low-voltage, neutral, and telecommunication lines. Mobile and aerial Light Detection and Ranging (LiDAR) point clouds provide detailed 3D representations of these assets and their surroundings. However, power-line detection and reconstruction remain challenging because conductor returns are often sparse, incomplete, noisy, or occluded by vegetation. These challenges are especially significant in distribution networks, where lower pole heights and complex line configurations place conductors close to trees. In addition, mobile and aerial LiDAR datasets differ substantially in point density, viewing geometry, spatial coverage, and occlusion patterns. We propose a robust and automated reconstruction method combining scaled density-based clustering, robust polynomial fitting, and iterative fragment merging to recover individual conductors under severe data incompleteness and occlusion. Following semantic classification, the same reconstruction pipeline processes both mobile and aerial LiDAR data without modality-specific code or parameter tuning. The method is evaluated through degradation experiments, benchmarking, parameter sensitivity analysis, and large-scale validation. On the aerial dataset, it achieves 96.87% precision, 96.66% recall, a 96.76% F$_1$-score, and a geometric RMSE of 0.127 m. On the mobile dataset, where conductor-level reference annotations were unavailable, it achieves a point-to-model RMSE of 0.045 m and a reconstruction coverage of 95.27%. Source code, documentation, and evaluation data are publicly available at this https URL .

AI.tldr: 提出一种自动化电力线重建方法，结合尺度化DBSCAN聚类、鲁棒多项式拟合与迭代片段合并，可在严重缺失与遮挡下恢复单根导线，且同一流程无需改动即可处理机载与车载LiDAR数据。
AI.motivation: 电力公司评估植被侵入与降低风险需精确定位配电网络资产并区分中压、低压、中性线与通信线；但导线点云稀疏、不完整、含噪或被植被遮挡，且车载与机载LiDAR在点密度、视角、覆盖与遮挡模式上差异大，现有检测与重建方法难以胜任。
AI.method: 语义分类之后，采用尺度化密度聚类（scaled density-based clustering）、鲁棒多项式拟合（robust polynomial fitting）与迭代片段合并（iterative fragment merging）的流水线，从点云中逐根恢复导线；同一管线与参数同时适用于车载与机载数据，并通过退化实验、基准对比、参数敏感性分析与大规模验证进行评估。
AI.result: 机载数据集上达到96.87%精确率、96.66%召回率、96.76% F1与0.127 m几何RMSE；车载数据集（无导线级参考标注）点-模型RMSE为0.045 m，重建覆盖率95.27%；代码、文档与评测数据公开。
AI.conclusion: 该方法在数据严重不完整和遮挡条件下仍能稳定、自动地重建配电导线，具备跨模态（机载/车载）零调参的通用性与工程可部署性，适用于植被侵入风险评估。

title: TAQ-MOTR: Tracking-Aware Detection Query Formation for End-to-End Multiple Object Tracking
summary: Tracking-by-propagation (TBP) methods perform end-to-end multi-object tracking by propagating track queries across frames, jointly handling detection and identity association without heuristic post-processing while naturally modeling temporal information. However, as detection and association are tightly coupled, detection queries in TBP are expected to discover currently untracked objects and provide complementary current-frame evidence for challenging tracks whose queries and identities are retained. Existing methods largely inherit detection-query formation from single-frame detection and construct such queries before the decoder with little awareness of trajectory states. Consequently, currently untracked objects may be missed, while challenging tracked objects with reduced visibility under occlusion may lack complementary evidence, causing association failures or duplicate responses. To address these issues, we propose TAQ-MOTR, a tracking-aware detection query formation framework that employs a pre-decoder Hybrid Query Generator (HQG) to fuse current-frame image features, track memory, and learnable memory. By conditioning detection queries on trajectory states, TAQ-MOTR adapts them to \rev{the discovery of currently untracked objects and tracked-object complementation We further introduce a training-only auxiliary detection branch whose one-to-one label assignment is decoupled from that of the main tracking branch, providing additional detection supervision to strengthen the shared HQG and decoder for the discovery of currently untracked objects. TAQ-MOTR improves performance on DanceTrack, SportsMOT, and BFT, achieving 72.0 HOTA, 63.1 AssA, and 76.6 IDF1 on the DanceTrack test set. Code is available at this https URL

AI.tldr: TAQ-MOTR提出tracking-aware的检测查询构建框架：用解码器前的Hybrid Query Generator融合当前帧特征、轨迹记忆与可学习记忆，使检测查询条件化于轨迹状态，并加一条训练期辅助检测分支（标签分配与主跟踪分支解耦）以增强未跟踪目标的发现能力。
AI.motivation: TBP类方法中检测与关联紧耦合：检测查询既需发现当前未被跟踪的目标，又需为遮挡下退化的已跟踪目标提供互补证据。现有方法沿用单帧检测的查询构建方式，在解码器前构建且不感知轨迹状态，导致漏检新目标、遮挡目标缺乏补证，引发关联失败或重复响应。
AI.method: 解码器前Hybrid Query Generator（HQG）融合当前帧图像特征、轨迹记忆与可学习记忆，生成轨迹状态条件化的检测查询；并引入仅训练期使用的辅助检测分支，其一对一标签分配与主跟踪分支解耦，为共享的HQG与解码器提供额外检测监督。
AI.result: DanceTrack测试集达到72.0 HOTA、63.1 AssA、76.6 IDF1；在DanceTrack、SportsMOT、BFT上均有性能提升，代码已开源。
AI.conclusion: 将检测查询构建与轨迹状态显式耦合、并用解耦标签分配的辅助检测监督，可提升TBP在拥挤与遮挡场景下的目标发现与身份保持能力，是一种即插即用的查询构建改进方案。

title: Diffusion Plug-in Priors for Self-Supervised Ultrasound Video Restoration
summary: \textit{Objective:} Ultrasound videos are limited by hardware-constrained spatial resolution and signal-dependent speckle, while paired low- and high-resolution acquisitions for supervised restoration are rarely available. We aim to jointly super-resolve and despeckle ultrasound videos without paired training data or network retraining. \textit{Methods:} We propose UltraDiff, which uses a frozen pre-trained diffusion model (DM) as a plug-in prior and restores each frame by optimizing the latent seed of the DM sampler under a range-constrained maximum a posteriori formulation. We derive a speckle-aware data-fidelity term from a Rayleigh scale-family model and characterize its relative-residual and variance-adaptive weighting properties. We further introduce a stabilized fidelity that is bounded below and strictly convex in log intensity for positive observations in its unclamped form. A total-variation regularizer complements the DM prior, and a temporal seed update warm-starts each frame from the optimized seed of its predecessor. \textit{Results:} On EchoNet-LVH videos with simulated speckle and additive noise, UltraDiff with a natural-image prior improves PSNR by 1.24\,dB over the strongest baseline, and ultrasound-related priors improve it further. On real clinical echocardiography videos, UltraDiff reduces the mean absolute error of zero-shot ejection fraction (EF) prediction from 7.31 to 6.37 EF points relative to DUP, the strongest baseline. \textit{Conclusion:} Combining a speckle-aware fidelity with frozen diffusion priors enables ground-truth-free ultrasound video restoration that benefits downstream measurement. \textit{Significance:} UltraDiff needs neither paired data nor retraining and is not tied to a specific diffusion checkpoint. Code associated with this work will be made publicly available upon acceptance.

AI.tldr: UltraDiff 用冻结的预训练扩散模型作为先验，通过在 range-constrained MAP 框架下优化采样器潜变量种子，实现无需成对数据、无需重训的超声视频联合超分与去斑点。
AI.motivation: 超声视频受硬件空间分辨率限制且有信号依赖的散斑，成对低/高分辨率数据几乎不可得，因此需要无监督、免训练的视频恢复方法。
AI.method: 冻结 DM 作 plug-in prior；从 Rayleigh scale-family 模型推导散斑感知的数据保真项（分析其相对残差与方差自适应加权特性），并给出在正观测下对 log 强度有界且严格凸的稳定化形式；加 TV 正则；用前帧优化种子对当前帧时间种子 warm-start。
AI.result: EchoNet-LVH 仿真数据上 PSNR 比最强基线高 1.24 dB，超声相关先验进一步提升；真实临床超声视频上零样本 EF 预测 MAE 从 7.31 降至 6.37 EF 点。
AI.conclusion: 散斑感知保真项结合冻结扩散先验可实现无真值的超声视频恢复，并改善下游测量；不需成对数据与重训，也不绑定特定扩散权重。

title: PLANTEUR: A Crop-Type Segmentation Benchmark for Tropical Regions
summary: We introduce PLANTEUR, a benchmark for crop-type mapping from satellite images in the French overseas territories. Building on the PASTIS design, PLANTEUR provides georeferenced and aligned Sentinel-2, Sentinel-1, and Landsat-8 sequences with parcel-derived labels spanning six tropical regions and an 8-class label space. We define both a standard test split and a leave-one-island-out protocol to measure cross-territory generalization, and evaluate fully supervised models, linear probes, and fine-tuned foundation models. The benchmark code and data are open source and available on GitHub and Hugging Face.

AI.tldr: PLANTEUR是一个面向法属海外领地热带地区作物类型制图的遥感基准，提供对齐的Sentinel-2/1与Landsat-8序列及地块级标签（6区域、8类），并设标准测试集与留一岛协议评估跨域泛化。
AI.motivation: 现有作物制图基准（如PASTIS）集中于温带/欧洲农业区，缺乏热带多岛、多传感器、跨区域泛化的评测平台，难以检验模型在域偏移下的迁移能力。
AI.method: 沿用PASTIS设计范式，构建地理参考并对齐的多源卫星时序数据（Sentinel-2、Sentinel-1、Landsat-8）与地块级标签；定义标准划分与leave-one-island-out交叉验证协议；评测全监督模型、线性探针与微调的基础模型。
AI.result: 摘要未给出量化结果；主要交付为开源基准（GitHub与Hugging Face），覆盖六个热带区域、8类标签空间，并提供跨域泛化评测协议。
AI.conclusion: PLANTEUR将热带多岛作物制图与跨域泛化纳入统一基准，可作为遥感基础模型在农业时序分割任务上的一致评测工具，但方法学贡献有限。

title: Diagnosis by Composition: Detecting and Localizing Unseen Diseases by Composing Learned Radiological Findings
summary: Deep models for radiological diagnosis are typically trained to predict disease labels directly from images, which limits them to diseases seen during training and makes their decisions hard to interpret in radiologists' terms. Radiology, however, proceeds from visual findings to disease through published guidelines that make this decision rule explicit, interpretable, and reproducible. We introduce diagnosis by composition (DbC), a representation learning framework that encodes this findings-first logic. DbC learns a vocabulary of radiological findings by aligning image features with the text embeddings of the findings, each finding represented as a dense map over the scan. A disease is defined by a set of required findings derived from its guidelines, and its diagnosis map is a fixed, parameter-free composition of the corresponding finding maps. Because the finding-to-disease mapping is derived from guidelines rather than learned, DbC is interpretable and auditable by design, can extend to new diseases by specifying their findings without retraining, and can diagnose unseen diseases by composing their findings. On multi-phase liver CT, DbC detects and localizes unseen diseases, rare diseases from a different institution, and an external cohort significantly better than all comparators, including models that align images with disease names. DbC also improves detection and localization in the fully supervised setting and remains superior across training-set sizes. Although demonstrated on liver CT, DbC applies wherever radiological guidelines define diseases through findings.

AI.tldr: 提出“诊断即组合”(DbC)：将影像特征与放射学征象文本嵌入对齐，学习征象词表（每个征象为稠密热图），疾病由指南规定的征象集合以无参数固定方式组合而成，实现可解释、可审计、可零样本扩展的诊断。
AI.motivation: 直接从图像预测疾病标签的深度模型受限于训练时见过的疾病，且决策难以用放射科术语解释；而临床诊断本身遵循“先征象、后疾病”的公开指南逻辑，该规则显式、可复现，却未被模型编码。
AI.method: 表示学习框架：以文本嵌入作为征象原型，将图像特征对齐到征象文本空间，得到覆盖全扫描的征象稠密图；疾病定义为指南导出的必需征象集合，其诊断图是相应征象图的固定、无参数组合；征象—疾病映射来自指南而非学习，故新疾病只需指定征象即可免训练扩展。
AI.result: 在多期肝脏CT上，DbC在检测与定位未见疾病、他院罕见病及外部队列上显著优于全部对比方法（含图像—疾病名对齐模型）；在全监督设置下同样提升检测与定位，并在不同训练集规模下保持优势。
AI.conclusion: 以指南为纽带的“征象组合”式表示学习使医学影像诊断兼具可解释性、可审计性与零样本泛化能力；方法虽在肝脏CT上验证，但可推广到任何以征象定义疾病的放射学场景。

title: Reality and Perceptual Gaps in Expressive Swarm Robotics
summary: Moving robot swarms from simulation into the physical world can be difficult because small discrepancies in hardware, timing and communication can cascade across interacting robots and alter group behaviour. This challenge is known as the reality gap. When swarms operate in human environments, a second challenge emerges: a perceptual gap between what the swarm physically does and what human onlookers actually perceive. This study examines the same decentralised coordination code deployed across three robotic swarms-tabletop, aerial and human-scale mobile manipulators-during live artistic performances. We find that while the underlying algorithms executed reliably on all three platforms, physical embodiment drastically altered visible motion-distorting execution timescales by more than a factor of three and reshaping trajectory geometry. More importantly, audience surveys revealed that human interpretation does not mirror technical success: how observers attribute meaning (perceived purpose) and how they react emotionally (comfort versus threat) depend heavily on physical form. Meaning attribution and emotional responses did not vary together. Our results demonstrate that successfully transferring swarm software to physical hardware is insufficient for real-world deployment. Addressing the reality gap does not guarantee that the resulting collective motion will be readily interpreted by human observers. Swarms destined for human environments must be engineered not only for decentralised stability but also for the expressive physical dynamics through which humans interpret collective motion.

AI.tldr: 多平台（桌面、空中、人形尺度移动操作）群体机器人现场艺术演出部署，揭示"现实差距"与"感知差距"：算法可靠但具身显著改变可见运动（时序差3倍以上、轨迹几何改变），观众意义归因与情绪反应并不随技术成功同步。
AI.motivation: 群体机器人从仿真迁移到物理世界存在现实差距（硬件、时序、通信微小差异在交互中放大）；同时在人机共存环境中还存在"感知差距"——群体实际行为与人类观察者感知/解读之间的错位，二者此前缺少统一实证。
AI.method: 将同一套去中心化协调代码部署于三类机器人群体（桌面级、空中、人形尺度移动操作平台），在真实艺术演出中运行；测量执行时序与轨迹几何差异，并通过观众问卷调查其感知目的归因与情绪反应（舒适vs威胁），比较跨具身的差异。
AI.result: 底层算法在三平台均可靠执行；但物理具身使执行时序相差超过3倍并重塑轨迹几何。观众调查显示意义归因与情绪反应均强烈依赖物理形态，且二者并不协同变化（技术成功≠人类解读成功）。
AI.conclusion: 把群体软件成功迁移到硬件不足以支撑真实部署；解决现实差距不保证集体运动可被人类读懂。面向人类环境的群体系统需同时为去中心化稳定性与"可表达的物理动力学"（expressive dynamics）进行设计。

title: Should the Action Expert Train the VLM? Action-Token Supervision and Gradient Routing in Mixture-of-Transformer VLAs
summary: Vision-language-action (VLA) models increasingly pair a pre-trained vision-language model (VLM) with a flow-matching expert that conditions its action predictions on the VLM's key-value representations. Those representations must carry information useful for control, yet the VLM was never trained for the action expert's flow-matching objective. Two signals can address this: gradients backpropagated from the expert's loss (coupling), or VLM supervision to predict discrete tokens encoding the same target actions. Prominent training recipes forgo the first, blocking expert-to-VLM gradients (insulation) to protect the VLM's existing capabilities, while also supervising it on vision-language data and action tokens. Because vision-language co-training also aims to preserve those capabilities, the additional protection provided by insulation is unclear. At the same time, insulation removes a direct signal about which features continuous action prediction requires. On the other hand, action-token supervision offers an alternative way to learn action-relevant representations, which may explain why insulation succeeds in practice. We disentangle these factors in autonomous driving and manipulation by independently varying action-token supervision and whether the expert's loss updates the VLM. In open-loop driving, insulation is competitive with coupling when action tokens are supervised; without them, coupling reduces trajectory-prediction error by roughly 25%. When both components are trained jointly from the outset, coupling increases closed-loop driving route progress by approximately 17% with action-token supervision and 40% without it, and similarly improves robot manipulation performance under both settings. These findings show that the value of gradient insulation depends on the VLM's action supervision and the evaluation setting, challenging insulation as a default VLA training recipe.

AI.tldr: 该文系统解耦VLA训练中"梯度绝缘"(阻断专家loss回传到VLM)与"动作token监督"两大因素，发现二者可替代：有动作token监督时绝缘与耦合性能相当，无之则耦合显著更优（开环轨迹误差降约25%，闭环路线进度升17%/40%）。
AI.motivation: 主流VLA配方默认用梯度绝缘保护VLM能力，但VL共训练本身已起保护作用，绝缘的额外收益不明；同时绝缘切断了"连续动作预测需要哪些特征"的直接信号。作者试图厘清绝缘成功究竟源于保护还是因为动作token监督提供了替代信号。
AI.method: 在自动驾驶与机器人操作两个域做控制变量实验：独立调节(1)是否对VLM施加离散动作token监督、(2)专家流匹配loss是否回传更新VLM，对比开环驾驶轨迹预测、闭环路线进度及操作任务性能。
AI.result: 有动作token监督时绝缘与耦合相当；无监督时耦合使开环轨迹误差降约25%。从零联合训练下，耦合在闭环驾驶使路线进度提升约17%（有动作token）与40%（无动作token），操作任务亦在同两种设置下均改善。
AI.conclusion: 梯度绝缘的价值取决于VLM是否受动作监督及评测设置（开环/闭环），不应作为VLA训练的默认配方；直接耦合在无动作token时可提供更有效的动作相关表征。

title: Route Anything: A Study of Model and Policy Routing for General-Purpose AI Systems
summary: Artificial general intelligence (AGI) requires a method that can understand, generate, reason, and act across diverse domains and modalities. Rather than relying on a single model to master every capability, a promising path toward AGI now is to orchestrate a heterogeneous ecosystem of specialized models, tools, and policies (candidates) into a unified AI system. At the heart of this vision lies a fundamental question: how can an AI system dynamically select and coordinate the most capable candidate for each task while balancing performance and computational cost? In this work, we present Route Anything, a unified framework for studying model and policy routing across general-purpose AI systems. We develop a unified theoretical foundation that characterizes optimal routing under quality--cost trade-offs and establishes how the information available to a router determines its attainable performance. To systematically investigate routing across diverse capabilities, we first construct an omni-modal trajectory matrix spanning 25 benchmarks across language understanding, image, video, and speech generation, coding and workplace agents, and robotic manipulation, comprising 374,401 scored runs from 452 candidate configurations. Building on this framework, we train and test different routers to investigate the potential of omni-modal model routing, the capabilities of learned routers, and the conditions under which routing improves efficiency. Our results reveal substantial opportunities for capability orchestration: per-input oracle routing outperforms the best fixed candidate by 5.4 points, and learned routers outperform it by 0.3 points across 16 benchmarks, by 2.1 points on video generation, and by 1.1 points on robot manipulation while using 24% less policy time. More importantly, routing raises efficiency by 8.82x on average compared with the reference model.

AI.tldr: 面向异构模型/工具/策略生态的统一"模型与策略路由"框架 Route Anything，给出质量–成本权衡下的最优路由理论，并构建跨25个基准、452个候选配置、374,401条打分的全模态轨迹矩阵，验证逐输入 oracle 路由与学习型路由器的收益与效率提升。
AI.motivation: AGI 更现实的路径不是单一模型掌握全部能力，而是编排异构的专用模型、工具与策略生态；由此产生核心问题：系统如何按任务动态选择并协调最优候选，同时平衡性能与算力成本。
AI.method: 提出统一理论框架刻画质量–成本权衡下的最优路由，并分析路由器可用信息如何决定其可达性能上界；构建覆盖语言理解、图像/视频/语音生成、编码与办公智能体、机器人操作共25个基准的"全模态轨迹矩阵"（374,401次打分运行，452个候选配置）；基于该矩阵训练并评测多种路由器，考察全模态路由潜力、学习型路由器能力及路由提升效率的条件。
AI.result: 逐输入 oracle 路由比最佳固定候选高 5.4 分；学习型路由器在16个基准上高 0.3 分，视频生成高 2.1 分，机器人操作高 1.1 分且策略耗时减少 24%；相比参考模型平均效率提升 8.82 倍。
AI.conclusion: 路由式能力编排在性能与效率上均有可观空间；但学习型路由器与 oracle 上界差距明显（0.3 vs 5.4），说明路由信息与学习方法是后续关键瓶颈。对具身/机器人方向，路由属系统层编排，缺乏具体物理任务方法或真实机器人验证。

title: Möbius: A Unified Motion-Language Model Bridging Understanding and Generation
comment: Project page: this https URL
summary: We aim to build a truly unified motion model that can understand, generate, and edit human motion within a single framework. Existing motion UMMs remain only partially unified: motion understanding is handled by a language model, while generation is often delegated to a separate diffusion module operating over learned motion latents. We introduce Möbius, which brings the entire diffusion process into the same multimodal representation space used for motion understanding. Clean motion, noisy motion, and text jointly participate in shared attention, while role-specific parameters process understanding and generation streams. Importantly, Möbius operates directly on continuous frame-level raw motion, requiring neither discrete tokenization nor a pretrained motion VAE. This simple formulation naturally supports motion captioning, text-to-motion generation, temporal completion, and instruction-guided editing within a single model. On HumanML3D, Möbius achieves state-of-the-art performance among unified motion models. Scaling to 1.7B parameters and 1,700 hours of motion data further demonstrates that our framework is both effective and scalable.

AI.tldr: Möbius 将扩散过程整体搬进理解与生成共享的多模态表示空间，直接在连续帧级原始运动上做统一理解、生成与编辑，无需离散分词或预训练运动 VAE。
AI.motivation: 现有统一运动模型（UMM）仅是"半统一"：理解由语言模型负责，生成交给单独的扩散模块并依赖学到的运动潜变量，流程割裂、依赖额外表征学习。
AI.method: 将干净运动、带噪运动与文本共同投入共享注意力，理解流与生成流使用角色专属参数；扩散直接在连续帧级 raw motion 上运行，不做离散 tokenization，也不用预训练 motion VAE。
AI.result: 在 HumanML3D 上，统一运动模型中达到 SOTA；扩展到 1.7B 参数、1700 小时运动数据后仍显示有效且可扩展。
AI.conclusion: 单一框架内可同时支持运动描述、文本到运动生成、时序补全与指令引导编辑，验证了"全扩散共享表征空间"路线的有效性与可扩展性。

title: YANAMI: A Large-Scale Multimodal Dataset and Benchmark for Multiturn Stateful Interaction
comment: Project page: this https URL
summary: Unified Multimodal Models (UMMs) integrate visual understanding, generation, and editing within a single unified framework. However, existing unified multimodal datasets and benchmarks remain dominated by single-turn tasks. Even in recent multi-turn datasets, many turns can be solved independently without tracking information across turns. Consequently, they provide limited supervision and evaluation for multimodal stateful interaction, which requires models to understand, maintain, update, and faithfully realize evolving dialogue states across turns. To address this gap, we introduce YANAMI, the first large-scale multimodal dialogue dataset and benchmark for stateful interaction, comprising YANAMI-400K and YANAMI-Bench. YANAMI-400K contains 400K multi-turn multimodal dialogues, with more than 2M images and 2.6M dialogue turns. The dialogues span four representative scenarios: Multi-Image Fusion, Image Editing, World Modeling, and Visual Reasoning, and require models to continuously track, preserve, and revise evolving multimodal dialogue states across turns. YANAMI-Bench comprises 400 multi-turn dialogues for systematically evaluating multimodal stateful interaction. It jointly evaluates Dialogue State Understanding and Visual Realization, characterizing the gap between models' ability to understand evolving dialogue states and their ability to faithfully realize them in visual outputs. Experiments show that fine-tuning BAGEL on YANAMI-400K improves image editing, generation, and multimodal stateful interaction by 10.3%, 2.0%, and 13.23%, respectively, while preserving its general visual understanding capabilities. Evaluations on YANAMI-Bench further reveal that existing UMMs still struggle to maintain, update, and visually realize evolving multimodal dialogue states.

AI.tldr: 提出YANAMI：首个面向“多模态有状态交互”（跨轮理解、维护、更新并忠实生成视觉状态）的大规模多轮多模态对话数据集与基准，含YANAMI-400K（40万多轮对话、200多万图像、260万对话轮）与YANAMI-Bench（400个多轮对话，联合评估对话状态理解与视觉实现）。
AI.motivation: 现有统一多模态模型（UMM）的语料与基准以单轮任务为主；即使是多轮数据，许多轮次也可独立求解、无需跨轮追踪信息，因而对“有状态交互”的监督与评测严重不足，模型难以维持、更新并在视觉上落实不断演化的对话状态。
AI.method: 构建四类代表性场景（多图融合、图像编辑、世界建模、视觉推理）的多轮对话数据，要求跨轮持续跟踪、保持与修订多模态状态；设计YANAMI-Bench同时评测“对话状态理解”与“视觉实现”两维度；以BAGEL为基座在YANAMI-400K上微调验证数据价值。
AI.result: 微调BAGEL后，图像编辑、生成、多模态有状态交互分别提升10.3%、2.0%、13.23%，同时保持通用视觉理解能力；YANAMI-Bench显示现有UMM在维持、更新与视觉实现演化状态方面仍普遍吃力。
AI.conclusion: 多轮“有状态”是当前统一多模态模型的关键缺口；YANAMI提供了规模化监督与可分离评测框架，揭示“理解状态”与“视觉实现状态”之间的能力落差，可作为该方向的数据基础设施与评测标准。

title: Anchored Rank-Adversarial Fine-Tuning Pretrained Visual Place Recognition Models
comment: 15 pages, 3 figures, 8 tables
summary: Visual place recognition (VPR) localises a camera by retrieving similar geo-tagged images, and current foundation-model VPR models are accurate across cities, seasons and illumination, but not robust to adversarial perturbations: under a white-box attack on the ranking at an imperceptible budget of 1/255, SuperVLAD and BoQ keep at most 0.2% top-1 recall (R@1) on four benchmarks. We propose anchored rank-adversarial fine-tuning (ARAFT), which fine-tunes a released model with a listwise rank loss on each adversarial query's hardest positive and an anchor to the clean descriptor of the frozen pretrained model. Checkpoints are selected under a clean-accuracy budget fixed in advance, and the full trade-off is reported. Within five validation R@1 points of clean cost, plain adversarial training has no admissible checkpoint, whereas ARAFT raises robust R@1 from zero to 47.3 on SuperVLAD and 55.3 on BoQ; plain adversarial training exceeds this only at about three times the clean cost. Against unbudgeted plain adversarial training on the test sets, ARAFT matches its robust R@1 at 2/255 with about ten more clean R@1 points. At 4/255, plain adversarial training is 6-9 robust R@1 points ahead, while ARAFT still keeps its ten-point clean advantage. Developed on SuperVLAD, ARAFT transfers to BoQ without re-tuning, and its robustness holds against stronger optimisers, with no sign of gradient masking.

AI.tldr: ARAFT：用listwise排序对抗损失+冻结预训练描述子锚定正则微调VPR基础模型，在预设干净精度预算内将白盒对抗下的R@1从~0提升到47.3 (SuperVLAD) / 55.3 (BoQ)，并可零调参迁移到BoQ。
AI.motivation: 现有基础模型VPR（SuperVLAD、BoQ）跨城市/季节/光照准确，但在1/255不可察觉预算的白盒排序攻击下R@1几乎归零（≤0.2%），缺乏鲁棒性；而朴素对抗训练在同等干净精度约束下根本找不到可行检查点。
AI.method: 锚定排序对抗微调（ARAFT）：对每个对抗查询，用listwise rank损失作用于最难正样本，并加入对冻结预训练模型干净描述子的锚定约束以抑制干净精度漂移；检查点按事先固定的干净精度预算筛选，报告完整鲁棒-干净权衡曲线；在SuperVLAD上开发后无重调参迁移至BoQ，并检验更强优化器与梯度掩蔽。
AI.result: 干净R@1损失5个点以内时，朴素对抗训练无可接受检查点；ARAFT将鲁棒R@1从0提升至47.3（SuperVLAD）与55.3（BoQ），朴素对抗训练需约3倍干净代价才能超越。测试集上2/255时ARAFT鲁棒性持平朴素对抗训练且干净R@1高约10点；4/255时朴素法鲁棒领先6–9点但仍损失约10点干净精度。跨模型迁移成立，对更强优化器稳健，无梯度掩蔽迹象。
AI.conclusion: 锚定+listwise排序对抗微调是在干净精度预算下恢复VPR基础模型对抗鲁棒性的有效且可迁移方案；但绝对鲁棒性有限（远未达到干净性能），且工作聚焦VPR检索鲁棒性，未涉及具身导航或3D重建闭环验证。

title: Low-Density 3D Point Cloud Classification
summary: 3D point cloud classification, a task in computer vision, has recently gained substantial interest due to its extensive applications across various domains such as augmented and virtual reality, robotics, and autonomous driving. However, classifying 3D point clouds becomes challenging in real-world scenarios where the density levels vary. These variations are due to limitations inherent to current sensing technologies and variable environmental conditions, which often prevent the capture of detailed and comprehensive geometric representations. Existing classification methods, which have demonstrated impressive results on dense point clouds, may be affected and could experience reduced performance when dealing with low-density point clouds. Addressing this challenge, this paper introduces LD-PointNet++, an architecture optimized for the classification of low-density point clouds. To pave the way for LD-PointNet++, we conduct the first benchmarking study that systematically evaluates state-of-the-art point cloud classification methods across varying densities, revealing significant performance declines in low-density environments. Experimental results on the ModelNet benchmark dataset demonstrate that LD-PointNet++ not only outperforms these methods in low-density scenarios but also demonstrates consistent accuracy above 90% across different density levels.

AI.tldr: LD-PointNet++：面向低密度3D点云的分类架构，并首次系统基准测试不同点云密度下SOTA方法的性能衰减。
AI.motivation: 真实场景中传感器限制与环境变化导致点云密度不一，现有方法多在稠密点云上训练评估，低密度下性能下降。
AI.method: 构建跨密度基准评测揭示性能下降；提出LD-PointNet++架构，专门优化低密度点云分类。
AI.result: 在ModelNet基准上，低密度场景下优于现有方法，并在各密度级别保持>90%的一致精度。
AI.conclusion: 密度鲁棒性对点云分类关键，专门设计的架构可实现跨密度一致性能。

title: Wonder 4: A Mixture-of-Experts Recipe for Image Quality Enhancement
comment: Full version will be released soon
summary: A real photograph is often blurry, grainy, compressed, scratched, and low-resolution at the same time. Each defect has its own severity and its own place in the image. The corrections for these defects conflict with each other. Exist- ing models describe the whole image with one description, so they cannot say where each correction belongs. To solve this problem, we present Wonder 4, a mixture-of-experts (MoE) model for image quality enhancement. It corrects several defects of a real photograph at the same time, each in the region where it occurs. Every block of the model holds a mixture of N = 13 experts. A router, trained with the model, sends every image patch to k = 5 of them. No degradation classifier, mask, prompt, detector, or task label is used. Another issue is that standard MoE training, taken from language models, pushes every expert toward equal use. Equal use applies every correction everywhere, even where it is not needed. We replace this rule with a bias that only sets a minimum share of use. Across all patches, an expert used less than this minimum gets higher router scores until it is selected again. An expert above the minimum is not changed, so no expert is forced to be used as often as the others. The bias needs no extra loss. The method adds no extra module and no extra processing step. We evaluate Wonder 4 on DIV2K and Flickr2K, against five published methods and three open-weight pipelines. It reaches the best LPIPS, DISTS, and NIQE on all three test settings (DIV2K x4, DIV2K x8, and Flickr2K x4).

AI.tldr: Wonder 4 用 13 专家、每 patch 选 5 的 MoE 做区域化多缺陷修复，并以“最小使用比例”替代均等负载偏置，在三项基准上全部取得最佳 LPIPS/DISTS/NIQE。
AI.motivation: 针对真实照片中模糊、噪点、压缩痕迹、划痕、低分辨率等多种缺陷并存、修复方式互相冲突且空间分布不均的问题，现有模型用单一描述刻画整幅图像，无法表达“哪一处该做哪种校正”。
AI.method: 提出 Wonder 4，每块含 N=13 个专家的 MoE 图像质量增强模型，路由器按 patch 将每个图像块分派给 k=5 个专家；不使用退化分类器、掩码、提示词、检测器或任务标签。训练上放弃语言模型式“专家均等使用”约束，改为只设定最小使用比例的下界偏置：低于下限的专家在路由打分中被提升直至再次被选中，高于下限的专家不受干预，无需额外损失函数、额外模块或额外处理步骤。
AI.result: 在 DIV2K×4、DIV2K×8 与 Flickr2K×4 三个测试设置上，与五种已发表方法和三种开源权重流程对比，均取得最佳 LPIPS、DISTS 和 NIQE。
AI.conclusion: 以空间自适应 MoE 加最小使用下界偏置，可在无需退化先验与任务标签的情况下同步执行多缺陷、区域化修复，验证了“反均等化路由”在底层图像复原中的有效性。

title: GSBR: Geometric Support Behavior Regularization for Online RL
summary: Regularizing online reinforcement learning (RL) toward a pretrained base policy can improve sample efficiency and learning stability, but regularization that is too restrictive limits how much the policy can improve. Base policies -- typically diffusion or flow-matching models trained by imitation learning on large, diverse datasets -- capture many behaviors that are reasonable but suboptimal. Existing regularizers using such base policies are too restrictive in one of two ways: behavioral cloning regularizers pull the actor toward the full base-policy distribution, penalizing it for discarding suboptimal modes, while hard support constraints forbid improvements that lie just outside the base policy's support. We propose Geometric Support Behavior Regularization (GSBR), which penalizes actions by their distance from the base policy's support. Actions within the support incur no penalty, so the actor can concentrate on high-value modes; outside the support, where value estimates are less reliable, the penalty grows smoothly with distance while still permitting improvement when the value gained outweighs the penalty. GSBR estimates this distance from a finite set of base-policy samples, so it requires only sample access to the base policy. Across 19 tasks on four robotic benchmarks, GSBR raises the average success rate from 33% for the base policy to 95%, achieving the highest average success rate and throughput among all compared methods, with about 23% higher normalized throughput than the next-best RL method. Project website and open-source code at this https URL .

AI.tldr: 用“到基策略支撑集的距离”做正则，支撑内免罚、支撑外平滑加罚，仅需基策略采样，19个机器人任务成功率33%→95%。
AI.motivation: 现有以预训练基策略（扩散/流匹配模仿学习模型）做在线RL正则化的方法过于严格：行为克隆式正则会拉向整个基策略分布（惩罚丢弃次优模式），硬支撑约束则禁止基策略支撑集之外的改进。
AI.method: 提出几何支撑行为正则化（GSBR）：以动作到基策略支撑集的“距离”作为惩罚项。支撑集内动作零惩罚，actor可聚焦高价值模式；支撑集外（价值估计不可靠区）惩罚随距离平滑增长，当价值增益超过惩罚时仍允许改进。距离由基策略的有限采样集估计，仅需样本级访问。
AI.result: 在四个机器人基准的19个任务上，将平均成功率从基策略33%提升至95%，在所有对比方法中取得最高平均成功率与吞吐量，归一化吞吐量比次优RL方法高约23%。
AI.conclusion: GSBR以几何支撑距离正则化在“保留基策略先验”与“允许超越次优行为”之间取得更好折中，显著提升在线RL的样本效率与性能上限。

title: PACT: Pose-Robust Actuation Co-Design for Tendon-Driven Robotic Hands
summary: Humanoid robotic hands must provide sufficient force, speed, and backdrivability within a human-scale envelope. Tendon-driven transmissions address this challenge by relocating actuators to the palm and forearm, but routing paths, moment arms, and capstan dimensions jointly determine both force capability and joint speed, so selecting them sequentially satisfies one requirement at the expense of the other. This paper presents a pose-robust actuation co-design for tendon-driven robot hands (PACT) framework that optimizes tendon routing, moment arms, and capstan dimensions under pose-dependent force requirements and drivetrain-bandwidth constraints. A feasible-force formulation enforces actuator bounds and equilibrium at all joints, while a max-min objective maximizes task-force coverage at the weakest pose. Applied to a four-degree-of-freedom finger, the framework produces an asymmetric N + 1 tendon topology using quasi-direct-drive actuators. Across eight poses, the design achieves task-force coverage of 0.88-1.00 and a predicted 5 Hz minimum isolated-joint flexion/extension bandwidth within a 70th-percentile human-size envelope. Prototype measurements deviate from predictions by up to 24.5%, primarily due to unmodeled transmission losses. These results indicate that co-designing routing with the drivetrain can meet pose-dependent force requirements without relaxing the bandwidth constraint, paving the way for human-sized robotic hands with human-level performance.

AI.tldr: PACT框架将肌腱走线、力臂与绞盘尺寸与驱动带宽约束联合优化，在姿态相关力需求下最大化最差姿态的任务力覆盖率，实现四自由度手指的N+1非对称肌腱拓扑设计，原型实测误差至多24.5%。
AI.motivation: 人形机械手需在人体尺度包络内同时满足力、速度与反向驱动性；肌腱传动把执行器移至掌/前臂，但走线、力臂、绞盘尺寸共同决定力与速度，顺序设计必然牺牲其一，需联合协同设计。
AI.method: 提出PACT协同设计框架：以可行力（feasible-force）公式在各关节处强制执行器上下界与静力平衡，以max-min目标最大化最弱姿态下的任务力覆盖，同时施加驱动带宽（频响）约束，联合优化肌腱走线、力臂与绞盘尺寸；应用于4自由度手指，产出采用准直驱执行器的非对称N+1拓扑。
AI.result: 在8个姿态下任务力覆盖率达0.88–1.00，预测孤立关节屈/伸最低带宽5 Hz，整手位于第70百分位人体尺寸包络内；原型实测与预测偏差最高24.5%，主要源于未建模的传动损耗。
AI.conclusion: 走线与驱传动协同设计可在不放宽带宽约束的前提下满足姿态相关力需求，为人尺寸、人体性能级别的机器人手提供了可行路径。

title: PyRUA-DataFarm: LLM Agent as a Cost-Efficient Teleoperator for Real-Ready Robot Data
comment: 22 pages, 9 figures, 9 tables. Project page: this https URL Code: this https URL
summary: Teleoperation remains the default way to collect robot demonstrations, but every episode costs robot and operator time, and every new task starts from scratch. We ask whether a coding agent can take over the teleoperator's job. In our DataFarm, the agent receives a data request and one calibration episode of the robot in the target scene and rebuilds the task in simulation: it writes the scene, an expert controller, and a success judge. The simulator supplies exact actions, and a video model conditioned on real images renders each rollout as photographic video, generating all camera views together consistently. The output is real-ready data: synchronized camera views labelled with the robot's actions, on which a policy can be trained directly and deployed on the real robot. Independent judges certify the expert and every rendered episode before admission. On five real-robot tasks, policies trained only on farm data match policies trained on as many teleoperated episodes (93 vs. 84 successes in 100 trials), and under an unseen tablecloth and coloured light they keep 87 successes where the teleoperation-trained policies fall to 46. Adapting a task is fully automatic and costs \$21 of API usage on average, paid once per task, plus \$5 for a render contract; every further episode costs \$0.80 on average for simulation, rendering, and review, with no robot or operator. One hour of three-view data for a task costs \$107 on average, these costs included, slightly below a quote of \$117 for teleoperation in China and below \$290 in labour alone in North America.

AI.tldr: Coding agent用仿真重建任务并生成"可上真实机器人"的训练数据（DataFarm），替代遥操作采集演示
AI.motivation: 遥操作演示采集成本高（机器人+操作员时间），且每个新任务需从零开始；希望用编程智能体接管遥操作员的工作
AI.method: 智能体接收数据请求与目标场景的一段校准episode，在仿真中重建任务：编写场景、专家控制器与成功判定器；仿真给出精确动作，条件于真实图像的视频模型一致渲染多视角视频；独立评审认证专家与每条渲染episode后入库，得到带动作标签的同步多视角数据用于直接训练策略
AI.result: 5个真机任务上，仅用farm数据训练的策略与等量遥操作数据策略持平（100次试验中93胜 vs 84胜）；未见桌布与彩色光照下保持87胜，遥操作策略降至46；任务适配全自动，平均$21 API费（每任务一次）+$5渲染合约，后续每episode $0.80；每任务每小时三视角数据约$107，低于中国遥操作报价$117及北美纯人力$290
AI.conclusion: agent驱动的仿真数据生产可在成本与鲁棒性上替代遥操作演示采集，实现全自动、低成本、可扩展的机器人数据流水线

title: OpenBrain: An Auditable Generated-Label Release for Whole-Brain MRI Parcellation
comment: Accepted at NeurIPS 2026, Evaluations and Datasets Track. Dataset: this https URL code: this https URL
summary: Automatic tools can now generate whole-brain MRI parcellations at cohort scale, but generated-label releases often provide little evidence about which cases are reliable enough to reuse. We introduce OpenBrain, a confidence-aware release of 35,838 provenance-verified OpenNeuro T1w cases from 607 source datasets. OpenBrain is organized as an auditable case-record release rather than a directory of standalone segmentation files: each record links a primary parcellation, two committee parcellations, source/license provenance, raw QC-7 measurements, percentile risks, a combined risk score R, and a confidence tier. QC-7 is a reference-free reliability panel over label geometry, image-label consistency, and committee disagreement, so users can filter, weight, audit, or re-threshold generated labels without rerunning inference. We evaluate this released evidence under a frozen protocol. Across external cohorts, lower QC-7 risk corresponds to higher generated-label quality; in fixed-budget training, lower-risk selections improve paired macro Dice over random selection by +3.2 to +3.7 percentage points. OpenBrain also exposes raw axes, committee outputs, provenance, and datasheet documentation, so confidence claims remain inspectable after download. It does not turn generated labels into manual annotations or clinical-grade segmentations. Its contribution is a large open generated-parcellation substrate, a reusable case-level risk-evidence layer, and an external validation protocol for release-time QC. Dataset: this https URL . Code: this https URL .

AI.tldr: OpenBrain 发布 35,838 例 OpenNeuro T1w MRI 置信度感知分割记录集，用 QC-7（无参考可靠性面板：标签几何、图像-标签一致性、委员会分歧）给出风险分数 R 与置信分层。
AI.motivation: 自动全脑 MRI 划分已达到队列规模，但生成标签发布时几乎不提供"哪些案例可复用"的可靠性证据，用户无法在下载后审计置信度。
AI.method: 构建可审计的案例记录式发布：每条记录链接主分割、两个委员会分割、来源/许可溯源、原始 QC-7 测量、百分位风险、组合风险分 R 与置信层级；采用冻结协议做外部验证，并附 datasheet。
AI.result: 外部队列上 QC-7 风险越低对应生成标签质量越高；固定预算训练下低风险筛选相较随机选择提升配对 macro Dice +3.2~+3.7 个百分点；原始指标轴、委员会输出与溯源均可复核。
AI.conclusion: 贡献是大型开放式生成分割底座、可复用的案例级风险证据层及发布期 QC 的外部验证协议；不将生成标签等同于人工标注或临床级分割。

title: GSCV++: Lightweight 3D Gaussian Splatting Sequence Compression via Standard Video Codecs
summary: This paper presents GSCV++, a lightweight pipeline for 3D {G}aussian {S}platting (GS) sequences {C}ompression with standard {V}ideo codecs. To meet the requirements of low-complexity and hardware compatibility from the industry, GSCV++ jointly improves preprocessing, 3D-to-2D mapping, and practical video compression configuration of GS compression. First, for preprocessing, energy-adaptive inter-frame spherical harmonic (SH) alternative current (AC) dimensionality reduction (EA-SHDR) is proposed to produces a compact and stable temporal SH AC feature space. It can reduce the data volume of following mapping and practical compression, as well as less complexity while eliminating redundant information. Second, for 3D-to-2D mapping, prior-based Inter-MiniPLAS (P-MiniPLAS) is designed to generate smooth 2D feature maps through prior-based weighting factor inference and small scale remapping. Compared with vanilla Parallel Linear Assignment Sorting (PLAS) and Morton scan, P-MiniPLAS ensures the generated 2D maps are more suitable for the video codec while maintaining a low level of computational complexity. Third, for practical compression, content-aware generalized compression (CA-GC) is developed to use a non-uniform bit-depth split for coordinate map generation, and a coding unit size selection is introduced for efficient compression complexity control, which fully exploits the performance of video codecs without involving normative changes. Experiments demonstrate that GSCV++ reports over 20\% in intra- and 60\% in inter-prediction rate-distortion gains compared with state-of-the-art (SOTA) methods. GSCV++ also achieves faster 2D map generation, encoding, and decoding than other SOTA methods using the same type of video codecs. Ablation studies verify the effectiveness and robustness of the proposed modules and provide insights for subsequent research.

AI.tldr: GSCV++ 是一个基于标准视频编解码器的轻量级 3D Gaussian Splatting 序列压缩流水线，通过能量自适应 SH 交流分量降维、先验引导的 Inter-MiniPLAS 2D 映射和内容感知压缩配置，实现低复杂度、硬件兼容的高效压缩。
AI.motivation: 工业应用要求 3DGS 序列压缩同时具备低计算复杂度与硬件兼容性，现有方法（如直接并行线性分配排序 PLAS、Morton 扫描、原生视频编解码器配置）生成的 2D 特征图与编码器特性不匹配，压缩效率受限。
AI.method: 三方面改进：(1) 预处理阶段提出 EA-SHDR，按能量自适应地对帧间球谐交流分量降维，构造紧凑稳定的时序 SH 特征空间，去除冗余并降低后续复杂度；(2) 3D→2D 映射阶段提出 P-MiniPLAS，通过先验加权的因子推断与小尺度重映射生成平滑 2D 特征图，比 PLAS 和 Morton 扫描更适合视频编码器且复杂度低；(3) 压缩阶段提出 CA-GC，采用非均匀位深划分生成坐标图，并引入编码单元尺寸选择以控制复杂度，不涉及编解码器规范性改动。
AI.result: 相比 SOTA 方法，帧内预测率失真增益超过 20%，帧间预测增益超过 60%；2D 图生成、编码与解码速度均优于使用同类视频编解码器的其他 SOTA 方法；消融实验验证了各模块的有效性与鲁棒性。
AI.conclusion: GSCV++ 证明通过联合优化预处理、映射与编码配置，可在不改变视频编解码标准的前提下显著提升 3DGS 序列压缩的率失真性能并降低复杂度，具备良好的工业部署价值。

title: Visibility-Aware Reference Generation for Benchmarking Visual 3D Reconstruction in Vegetation-Rich Environments
comment: 20 pages, 12 figures
summary: Reliable evaluation of visual 3D reconstruction and depth estimation in vegetation-rich outdoor environments is limited by the scarcity of geometric ground-truth data and the cost of complete scanner surveys. We present a LiDARbased reference-generation pipeline for evaluating the zero-shot performance of feed-forward visual-geometry models alongside conventional structure-from-motion (SfM) methods. The pipeline reuses camera images, LiDAR scans, and reference poses from existing multi-sensor localization datasets to generate per-view depth maps and visible reference point clouds. To address visibility errors in accumulated LiDAR scans, we introduce the LargeDepth-Gap Visibility Score (LDGVS) for point-wise visibility filtering and automatic scale selection in Hidden Point Removal(HPR). Experiments on TartanAirV2 and TartanGround show that, compared with Poisson surface reconstruction, which is an approach suited to completed scan surveys, the combined HPR and LDGVS filtering retains approximately three times the point density at comparable absolute relative error. We also apply the pipeline to the BotanicGarden dataset to systematically compare depth estimation and 3D reconstruction methods. Feedforward methods produce dense depth predictions efficiently, but their 3D reconstructions can contain duplicated structures. Conventional SfM generally produces more coherent geometry, but its reconstructions remain sparse and more prone to failure in challenging vegetated scenes. The benchmark toolkit and datasets will be released.

AI.tldr: 提出基于LiDAR的参考数据生成流水线，用现有相机图像、LiDAR扫描与参考位姿生成逐视图深度图和可见参考点云，并提出LDGVS进行点级可见性过滤与HPR自动尺度选择，用于评测前馈视觉几何模型与SfM在植被户外场景的零样本性能。
AI.motivation: 植被密集的户外场景缺乏几何真值，完整扫描测量成本高，导致前馈式视觉几何模型与SfM在该类环境下的3D重建/深度估计评估不可靠。
AI.method: 复用多传感器定位数据集的图像、LiDAR与位姿；点级可见性过滤用LDGVS衡量深度间隙并自动选取HPR尺度，生成逐视图深度图与可见参考点云；与Poisson表面重建对比，并在TartanAirV2、TartanGround及BotanicGarden上系统评测前馈模型与SfM。
AI.result: 在相近绝对相对误差下，HPR+LDGVS过滤保留的点密度约为Poisson表面重建的3倍；前馈方法可高效产生稠密深度，但3D重建存在重复结构；传统SfM几何更连贯但稀疏，在困难植被场景易失败。
AI.conclusion: 该流水线为遮挡严重的户外植被场景提供了低成本、可扩展的几何参考真值与评测基准，揭示前馈与SfM方法的互补缺陷；基准工具与数据集将开源。

title: GUILD: Guided Iterative Data Collection for Imitation Learning
summary: Imitation learning policies in robotics are trained on datasets collected through costly real-world teleoperation. Often, the data-collection process is unguided, relying on the teleoperator's intuition, resulting in data that contributes little to overall policy performance. Recent work has shown that curating such unguided datasets can substantially improve policy performance, but these approaches operate by filtering existing datasets after collection and therefore do not prevent the acquisition of uninformative data. In this work, we propose GUILD, a novel Guided Data Collection (GDC) method that actively reasons about which data should be collected to maximize downstream policy performance. We introduce an iterative framework that alternates between 1) task proposal and data collection and 2) data evaluation to close the loop. For task proposal, we leverage semantic priors from vision-language models to identify relevant environments, object configurations, and goals for data collection. However, since semantic relevance does not imply policy improvement, we perform data evaluation. By leveraging predictive data attribution we approximate how the collected trajectories influence policy performance on a target deployment setting. This signal is then used as feedback to guide subsequent data collection, closing the data collection loop. We evaluate our approach in simulation and real robot settings, demonstrating that guided data collection substantially improves sample efficiency and deployment performance compared to passive data collection strategies, multiple baselines and experienced roboticists. More information at this https URL

AI.tldr: 提出GUILD，一种引导式数据采集(GDC)方法，通过"任务提议+数据评估"闭环迭代，主动决定采集哪些数据以最大化下游模仿学习策略性能。
AI.motivation: 机器人模仿学习依赖昂贵的真机遥操作采集，且采集过程无引导、凭操作者直觉，产生大量对策略性能贡献甚微的数据；现有数据筛选方法只能在采集后过滤，无法阻止无信息数据的获取。
AI.method: 构建迭代框架交替执行：(1)任务提议与数据采集——利用视觉语言模型的语义先验识别相关环境、物体配置与目标；(2)数据评估——用预测式数据归因(predictive data attribution)估计所采集轨迹对目标部署场景下策略性能的影响，并将该信号作为反馈指导后续采集，闭合数据采集回路。
AI.result: 在仿真与真实机器人上验证：相比被动采集策略、多种基线以及经验丰富的机器人专家，引导式数据采集显著提升样本效率与部署性能。
AI.conclusion: 将数据采集从被动过滤转为主动引导可有效提升模仿学习的样本效率与部署性能；语义相关性不等于策略提升，需以策略性能归因为反馈信号。

title: PolicyIK: High-Precision Inverse Kinematics for Robot Arms with Reinforcement Learning
summary: Inverse kinematics (IK) converts end-effector pose commands into joint motion, and many vision-language-action (VLA) policies rely on it to act on a given arm and to transfer across embodiments. Precise IK remains laborious: redundancy and singularities complicate the inverse mapping, execution depends on hand-tuned controllers, and training data on physical robots are costly to collect. We present PolicyIK, a goal-conditioned reinforcement learning policy for high-precision IK. It updates joint-position references from pose feedback and observes its accumulated reference relative to the measured joints, so it can retain the offset that the position controller needs at rest. Two-scale pose errors with an error-dependent action gain resolve millimeter residuals while preserving large motions. Progress and dwell rewards teach it to both reach the tolerance and stay within it. In simulation, a single attempt by the trained PPO policy keeps the mean errors over the final second within 1 mm and 0.2° on 93.5% of held-out tasks, and a deployment protocol raises success to 98.9%. When trained directly on a physical arm with an off-policy RL learner, PolicyIK achieves higher reaching and holding success than all four classical IK controllers under the same time budgets. In simulated pick-and-place, PolicyIK executes the end-effector commands of the $\pi_{0.5}$ VLA policy with 95.7% success. These results show that reinforcement learning can provide high-precision inverse kinematics for robot arms. Code is available at this https URL .

AI.tldr: 提出PolicyIK：以目标条件强化学习（PPO/off-policy）实现高精度逆运动学，通过双尺度位姿误差、误差相关动作增益与progress/dwell奖励，仿真中93.5%（单次）/98.9%（部署协议）达1mm/0.2°，实机上优于四类经典IK控制器，并驱动π0.5 VLA完成95.7%抓放。
AI.motivation: VLA策略与跨具身迁移依赖IK将末端位姿指令转为关节运动，但冗余与奇异使逆映射困难，实际执行依赖手调控制器，且实机数据采集昂贵；经典解析/数值IK精度与保持稳定性不足。
AI.method: 学习式goal-conditioned RL策略：以位姿反馈更新关节位置参考，并将累积参考相对于实测关节的偏移作为观测以保留静止时位置控制器所需偏置；采用双尺度位姿误差+误差相关动作增益（兼顾毫米级残差与大范围运动）；progress与dwell奖励促使达到并维持在容差内；仿真用PPO训练，实机用off-policy RL直接训练。
AI.result: 仿真中单次尝试在93.5%的held-out任务上末秒平均误差≤1mm/0.2°，部署协议提升至98.9%；实机直接训练时到达与保持成功率高于四种经典IK控制器（同等时间预算）；驱动π0.5 VLA完成仿真抓放，成功率95.7%。
AI.conclusion: 强化学习可为机械臂提供高精度逆运动学，替代手调控制器并增强VLA在具体本体上的执行精度与跨具身迁移能力。

title: DreamX: Video Diffusion Model is a Universal Latent Action Learner
comment: Project Page: this https URL
summary: Learning a universal action representation from video requires modeling dynamics that are consistent across different executions of the same action yet invariant to changes in embodiment and appearance. Existing latent action models infer actions from visual transitions, but their representations often entangle the underlying action with irrelevant visual variations, limiting transfer across embodiments. We introduce DreamX, which repurposes a pretrained video diffusion model as a universal latent action learner. Our approach extracts compact latent actions from the video model's rich spatiotemporal features, compressing each latent video frame by $\boldsymbol{300\times}$ ($\boldsymbol{1{,}200 \rightarrow 4}$ tokens). In addition, by leveraging the video model's generative prior, these latent actions capture action-relevant dynamics disentangled from visual appearance. The resulting latent space serves as a shared action interface across embodiments (human and robot), environments, and action parameterizations. On LARY-Bench, DreamX achieves state-of-the-art performance among latent action models. Moreover, actions encoded in one setting remain effective in another: the latent space supports any-to-any video transfer and zero-shot action transfer across diverse embodiments and environments. Furthermore, this shared interface also enables policy learning in a compact latent action space, reducing the computational cost of video-diffusion-based policies.

AI.tldr: DreamX 将预训练视频扩散模型改造为通用潜动作学习器，从视频模型时空特征中提取紧凑潜动作（每帧压缩至 4 token，300×），并借助生成先验将动作动态与外观解耦，形成跨载体（人/机器人）、跨环境、跨动作参数化的共享动作接口。
AI.motivation: 现有潜动作模型从视觉转移中推断动作时，常把动作与无关的视觉变化纠缠在一起，导致跨载体（embodiment）迁移受限。目标是学习一种在不同执行方式下一致、对载体与外观变化不变的通用动作表示。
AI.method: 复用预训练视频扩散模型的丰富时空特征作为潜动作提取来源；将每帧潜视频帧压缩为 4 个 token（1,200→4，约 300× 压缩）；利用视频模型的生成先验获得与视觉外观解耦的动作相关动态；所得潜空间作为跨载体、跨环境、跨参数化的共享动作接口，并可用于紧凑潜动作空间中的策略学习。
AI.result: 在 LARY-Bench 上，DreamX 在潜动作模型中取得 SOTA；潜空间支持任意到任意的视频迁移以及跨多样载体与环境的零样本动作迁移；共享接口还支持潜动作空间策略学习，降低基于视频扩散策略的计算开销。
AI.conclusion: 将视频扩散模型用作通用潜动作学习器是可行且有效的：生成先验有助于解耦动作与外观，紧凑潜动作可作为跨载体的共享接口，兼具表示质量与计算效率。
